chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Safwan al-Jammal, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding Allah (swt) saying, Mighty and Majestic: ‘And in their wealth there was a rightful share (fulfilled) for the beggar and the deprived.’ (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:19) Imam (a.s) said: "The ‘deprived’ is the unsuccessful one (muharaf), who has been deprived of the toil of his hand in buying and selling."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ اَلْجَمَّالِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» لِلسّٰائِلِ وَ اَلْمَحْرُومِ« قَالَ» اَلْمَحْرُومُ اَلْمُحَارَفُ اَلَّذِي قَدْ حُرِمَ كَدَّ يَدِهِ فِي اَلشِّرَاءِ وَاَلْبَيْعِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Safwan al-Jammal, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding Allah (swt) saying, Mighty and Majestic: ‘And in their wealth there was a rightful share (fulfilled) for the beggar and the deprived.’ (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:19) Imam (a.s) said: "The ‘deprived’ is the unsuccessful one (muharaf), who has been deprived of the toil of his hand in buying and selling."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 136

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And in another narration, from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said:
The Imams (a.s) said: "The ‘deprived one’ is the man whose intellect has no deficiency, yet provision is not expanded for him, and he is unsuccessful (muharaf)."
arabicText: وَ فِي رِوَايَةٍ أُخْرَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ:» اَلْمَحْرُومُ اَلرَّجُلُ اَلَّذِي لَيْسَ بِعَقْلِهِ بَأْسٌ وَ لاَ يُبْسَطُ لَهُ فِي اَلرِّزْقِ وَ هُوَ مُحَارَفٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And in another narration, from Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imams (a.s) said: "The ‘deprived one’ is the man whose intellect has no deficiency, yet provision is not expanded for him, and he is unsuccessful (muharaf)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 136

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Basir, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Part of the completion of fasting is giving zakat, just as sending blessings upon the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, is part of the completion of prayer. Whoever fasts and does not pay it, then there is no fast for him if he leaves it deliberately; and whoever prays and does not send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, and leaves that deliberately, then there is no prayer for him. Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, began with it before prayer, so He (swt) said: ‘Successful indeed are those who purify themselves, and remember the Name of their Lord (azj), and prays.'" (Surah al-A’la 87:14-15)
arabicText: اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» مِنْ تَمَامِ اَلصَّوْمِ إِعْطَاءُ اَلزَّكَاةِ كَالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مِنْ تَمَامِ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ مَنْ صَامَ وَ لَمْ يُؤَدِّهَا فَلاَ صَوْمَ لَهُ إِذَا تَرَكَهَا مُتَعَمِّداً وَ مَنْ صَلَّى وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَ تَرَكَ ذَلِكَ مُتَعَمِّداً فَلاَ صَلاَةَ لَهُ إِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بَدَأَ بِهَا قَبْلَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ» قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكّٰى` وَ ذَكَرَ اِسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلّٰى««.
thaqalaynSanad: Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Basir, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Part of the completion of fasting is giving zakat, just as sending blessings upon the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, is part of the completion of prayer. Whoever fasts and does not pay it, then there is no fast for him if he leaves it deliberately; and whoever prays and does not send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, and leaves that deliberately, then there is no prayer for him. Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, began with it before prayer, so He (swt) said: ‘Successful indeed are those who purify themselves, and remember the Name of their Lord (azj), and prays.'" (Surah al-A’la 87:14-15)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 137

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ajlan, who said:
I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: "Keep good company with blessings." I (narrator) asked: “And what is keeping good company with blessings?” Imam (a.s) said: "Gratitude to the One who bestowed them, and fulfilling their rights."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» أَحْسِنُوا جِوَارَ اَلنِّعَمِ« قُلْتُ وَ مَا حُسْنُ جِوَارِ اَلنِّعَمِ قَالَ» اَلشُّكْرُ لِمَنْ أَنْعَمَ بِهَا وَأَدَاءُ حُقُوقِهَا«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ajlan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: "Keep good company with blessings." I (narrator) asked: “And what is keeping good company with blessings?” Imam (a.s) said: "Gratitude to the One who bestowed them, and fulfilling their rights."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 137

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Mihran ibn Muhammad, from Sa'd ibn Tarif, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: “As for the one who is charitable, mindful (of Allah (swt)), and (firmly) believes in the finest reward,” (Surah al-Layl 92:5-6) Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt) gives for one, ten, up to one hundred thousand, and whatever is more.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease,” (Surah al-Layl 92:7) Imam (a.s) said: “He does not intend anything of good except that Allah (swt) makes it easy for him.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent (to Allah (swt)),” (Surah al-Layl 92:8) Imam (a.s) said: “He was stingy with what Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, had given him.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “And (staunchly) denies the finest reward,” (Surah al-Layl 92:9) Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), gives for one, ten, up to one hundred thousand, and whatever is more.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “We will facilitate for them the path of hardship,” (Surah al-Layl 92:10) Imam (a.s) said: “He does not intend anything of evil except that it is made easy for him.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble (into Hell),” (Surah al-Layl 92:11) Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, by Allah (swt), it is not a fall into a well, nor from a mountain, nor from a wall, but rather a fall into the Fire of Hell.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مِهْرَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ ظَرِيفٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» فَأَمّٰا مَنْ أَعْطىٰ وَاِتَّقىٰ` وَ صَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنىٰ« قَالَ» فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ يُعْطِي بِالْوَاحِدَةِ عَشْراً إِلَى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ فَمَا زَادَ«» فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرىٰ« قَالَ» لاَ يُرِيدُ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلْخَيْرِ إِلاَّ يَسَّرَهُ اَللَّهُ لَهُ«» وَ أَمّٰا مَنْ بَخِلَ وَ اِسْتَغْنىٰ« قَالَ» بَخِلَ بِمَا آتَاهُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ«» وَ كَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنىٰ«» فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى يُعْطِي بِالْوَاحِدِةِ عَشَرَةً إِلَى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ فَمَا زَادَ«» فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرىٰ« قَالَ» لاَ يُرِيدُ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلشَّرِّ إِلاَّ يُسِّرَ لَهُ«» وَ مٰا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مٰالُهُ إِذٰا تَرَدّٰى« قَالَ» أَمَا وَ اَللَّهِ مَا هُوَ تَرَدٍّ فِي بِئْرٍ وَ لاَ مِنْ جَبَلٍ وَ لاَ مِنْ حَائِطٍ وَلَكِنْ تَرَدٍّ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Mihran ibn Muhammad, from Sa'd ibn Tarif, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: “As for the one who is charitable, mindful (of Allah (swt)), and (firmly) believes in the finest reward,” (Surah al-Layl 92:5-6) Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt) gives for one, ten, up to one hundred thousand, and whatever is more.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease,” (Surah al-Layl 92:7) Imam (a.s) said: “He does not intend anything of good except that Allah (swt) makes it easy for him.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent (to Allah (swt)),” (Surah al-Layl 92:8) Imam (a.s) said: “He was stingy with what Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, had given him.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “And (staunchly) denies the finest reward,” (Surah al-Layl 92:9) Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), gives for one, ten, up to one hundred thousand, and whatever is more.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “We will facilitate for them the path of hardship,” (Surah al-Layl 92:10) Imam (a.s) said: “He does not intend anything of evil except that it is made easy for him.” And (Imam (a.s) was asked regarding the saying of Allah (swt)), “And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble (into Hell),” (Surah al-Layl 92:11) Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, by Allah (swt), it is not a fall into a well, nor from a mountain, nor from a wall, but rather a fall into the Fire of Hell.”

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Zurarah, from Salim ibn Abi Hafsah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), says: 'There is nothing except that I have entrusted to someone other than Me (swt) the one who receives it, except charity, for I take it with My (swt) hand, taking it directly, so much so that a man gives in charity a date or half a date, and I raise it as a man raises his foal and his young camel (fasil). Then he meets Me (swt) on the Day of Resurrection while it is like Mount Uhud, and greater than Uhud.'"
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ» مَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ كَفَّلْتُ بِهِ مَنْ يَقْبِضُهُ غَيْرِي إِلاَّ اَلصَّدَقَةَ فَإِنِّي أَتَلَقَّفُهَا بِيَدِي تَلَقُّفاً حَتَّى إِنَّ اَلرَّجُلَ لَيَتَصَدَّقُ بِالتَّمْرَةِ أَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ فَأُرَبِّيهَا كَمَا يُرَبِّي اَلرَّجُلُ فَلُوَّهُ وَفَصِيلَهُ فَيَلْقَانِي يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ وَ هِيَ مِثْلُ جَبَلِ أُحُدٍ وَ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ أُحُدٍ««.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Zurarah, from Salim ibn Abi Hafsah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), says: 'There is nothing except that I have entrusted to someone other than Me (swt) the one who receives it, except charity, for I take it with My (swt) hand, taking it directly, so much so that a man gives in charity a date or half a date, and I raise it as a man raises his foal and his young camel (fasil). Then he meets Me (swt) on the Day of Resurrection while it is like Mount Uhud, and greater than Uhud.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 138

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Among the most beloved deeds to Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, are satisfying the hunger of a believer, relieving his distress, and paying off his debt."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع قَالَ:» مِنْ أَحَبِّ اَلْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ إِشْبَاعُ جَوْعَةِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِ وَتَنْفِيسُ كُرْبَتِهِ وَ قَضَاءُ دَيْنِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Among the most beloved deeds to Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, are satisfying the hunger of a believer, relieving his distress, and paying off his debt."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 138

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, Ali ibn al-Hakam, Aban ibn Uthman, Misma', from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: "The best charity is cooling a burning liver." (providing water to drink)
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مِسْمَعٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» أَفْضَلُ اَلصَّدَقَةِ إِبْرَادُ كَبِدٍ حَرَّى«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, Ali ibn al-Hakam, Aban ibn Uthman, Misma', from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The best charity is cooling a burning liver." (providing water to drink)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 138

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfali, from Ismail ibn Abi Ziyad al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said: ‘Do not cut off the beggar in his asking, for were it not that the needy lie, the one who turned them away would not succeed.’"
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:» لاَ تَقْطَعُوا عَلَى اَلسَّائِلِ مَسْأَلَتَهُ فَلَوْلاَ أَنَّ اَلْمَسَاكِينَ يَكْذِبُونَ مَا أَفْلَحَ مَنْ رَدَّهُمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfali, from Ismail ibn Abi Ziyad al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said: ‘Do not cut off the beggar in his asking, for were it not that the needy lie, the one who turned them away would not succeed.’"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 139

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Give to the beggar, even if he is on the back of a horse." (meaning, even if he outwardly appears to possess some means)
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» أَعْطِ اَلسَّائِلَ وَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ فَرَسٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Give to the beggar, even if he is on the back of a horse." (meaning, even if he outwardly appears to possess some means)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 139

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from al-Nawfali, from Isa ibn Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘Whoever does a favor to any one of the people of my household (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)), I shall recompense him on the Day of Resurrection."
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:» مَنْ صَنَعَ إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي يَداً كَافَيْتُهُ يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from al-Nawfali, from Isa ibn Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘Whoever does a favor to any one of the people of my household (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)), I shall recompense him on the Day of Resurrection."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 139

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said: ‘Indeed, I will be an intercessor on the Day of Resurrection for four categories, even if they come with the sins of the people of the world: A man who supports my progeny (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)), A man who gives his wealth to my progeny (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) at the time of hardship, A man who loves my progeny (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) with the tongue and the heart, And a man who strives in the needs of my progeny (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) when they are driven away and scattered."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:» إِنِّي شَافِعٌ يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ لِأَرْبَعَةِ أَصْنَافٍ وَ لَوْ جَاءُوا بِذُنُوبِ أَهْلِ اَلدُّنْيَا رَجُلٌ نَصَرَ ذُرِّيَّتِي وَ رَجُلٌ بَذَلَ مَالَهُ لِذُرِّيَّتِي عِنْدَ اَلضِّيقِ وَ رَجُلٌ أَحَبَّ ذُرِّيَّتِي بِاللِّسَانِ وَ اَلْقَلْبِ وَ رَجُلٌ سَعَى فِي حَوَائِجِ ذُرِّيَّتِي إِذَا طُرِدُوا وَشُرِّدُوا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said: ‘Indeed, I will be an intercessor on the Day of Resurrection for four categories, even if they come with the sins of the people of the world: A man who supports my progeny (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)), A man who gives his wealth to my progeny (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) at the time of hardship, A man who loves my progeny (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) with the tongue and the heart, And a man who strives in the needs of my progeny (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) when they are driven away and scattered."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 139

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from some of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Yazid, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First):
Imam (a.s) said: "Whoever is not able to maintain ties with us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)), let him maintain ties with the poor of our Shia; and whoever is not able to visit our graves, let him visit the righteous among our brothers (Shia)."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» مَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَصِلَنَا فَلْيَصِلْ فُقَرَاءَ شِيعَتِنَا وَ مَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَزُورَ قُبُورَنَا فَلْيَزُرْ صُلَحَاءَ إِخْوَانِنَا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from some of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Yazid, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Whoever is not able to maintain ties with us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)), let him maintain ties with the poor of our Shia; and whoever is not able to visit our graves, let him visit the righteous among our brothers (Shia)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 140

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, in mursal form, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Whoever withholds a ‘qirat’ (a tiny fraction of wealth) from the zakat is neither a believer nor a Muslim, and this is His (azj) saying, Mighty and Majestic: 'My Lord (azj), return me, so that I may do righteousness in what I left behind.'" (Surah al-Mu’minun 23:99-100)
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ مُرْسَلاً عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» مَنْ مَنَعَ قِيرَاطاً مِنَ اَلزَّكَاةِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلاَ مُسْلِمٍ وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» رَبِّ اِرْجِعُونِ` لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صٰالِحاً فِيمٰا تَرَكْتُ««.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, in mursal form, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Whoever withholds a ‘qirat’ (a tiny fraction of wealth) from the zakat is neither a believer nor a Muslim, and this is His (azj) saying, Mighty and Majestic: 'My Lord (azj), return me, so that I may do righteousness in what I left behind.'" (Surah al-Mu’minun 23:99-100)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 140

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And in another narration:
(Regarding whoever withholds from the zakat), Imam (a.s) said: "And no prayer is accepted from him."
arabicText: وَ فِي رِوَايَةٍ أُخْرَى: وَ لاَ تُقْبَلُ لَهُ صَلاَةٌ.
thaqalaynSanad: And in another narration:
thaqalaynMatn: (Regarding whoever withholds from the zakat), Imam (a.s) said: "And no prayer is accepted from him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 141

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from a man, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “While the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, was in the mosque, He (saws) suddenly said, "Stand, O ‘so-and-so’; stand, O ‘so-and-so’; stand, O ‘so-and-so’," until the blessed Prophet (saws) expelled five individuals. Prophet (saws) said: "Leave our mosque. Do not pray in it while you do not give zakat."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: بَيْنَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ إِذْ قَالَ» قُمْ يَا فُلاَنُ قُمْ يَا فُلاَنُ قُمْ يَا فُلاَنُ« حَتَّى أَخْرَجَ خَمْسَةَ نَفَرٍ فَقَالَ» اُخْرُجُوا مِنْ مَسْجِدِنَا لاَ تُصَلُّوا فِيهِ وَ أَنْتُمْ لاَ تُزَكُّونَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from a man, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “While the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, was in the mosque, He (saws) suddenly said, "Stand, O ‘so-and-so’; stand, O ‘so-and-so’; stand, O ‘so-and-so’," until the blessed Prophet (saws) expelled five individuals. Prophet (saws) said: "Leave our mosque. Do not pray in it while you do not give zakat."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 141

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “There is no man who withholds a dirham from where it is due except that he spends two dirhams where they are not due; And there is no man who withholds a due right from his wealth except that Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, will encircle him with a serpent of fire on the Day of Resurrection."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَمْنَعُ دِرْهَماً فِي حَقِّهِ إِلاَّ أَنْفَقَ اِثْنَيْنِ فِي غَيْرِ حَقِّهِ وَ مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَمْنَعُ حَقّاً فِي مَالِهِ إِلاَّ طَوَّقَهُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَيَّةً مِنْ نَارٍ يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “There is no man who withholds a dirham from where it is due except that he spends two dirhams where they are not due; And there is no man who withholds a due right from his wealth except that Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, will encircle him with a serpent of fire on the Day of Resurrection."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 141

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said: ‘No servant has ever withheld zakat and had it increase in his wealth.’”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:» مَا حَبَسَ عَبْدٌ اَلزَّكَاةَ فَزَادَتْ فِي مَالِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah’s (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said: ‘No servant has ever withheld zakat and had it increase in his wealth.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 141

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "One prescribed prayer is better than twenty pilgrimages, and one pilgrimage is better than a house full of gold which he spends in righteousness until it is exhausted." He (narrator) said: “Then Imam (a.s) said: ‘And he has not succeeded who wastes twenty houses of gold for twenty-five dirhams.’" He (narrator) said: “So I asked: ‘And what is the meaning of twenty-five?’ Imam (a.s) said: "Whoever withholds zakat, his prayer is suspended until he gives zakat."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» صَلاَةٌ مَكْتُوبَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عِشْرِينَ حَجَّةً وَ حَجَّةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ بَيْتٍ مَمْلُوٍّ ذَهَباً يُنْفِقُهُ فِي بِرٍّ حَتَّى يَنْفَدَ« قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ» وَ لاَ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ ضَيَّعَ عِشْرِينَ بَيْتاً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ بِخَمْسَةٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَماً« قَالَ فَقُلْتُ وَ مَا مَعْنَى خَمْسَةٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ قَالَ» مَنْ مَنَعَ اَلزَّكَاةَ وُقِفَتْ صَلاَتُهُ حَتَّى يُزَكِّيَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "One prescribed prayer is better than twenty pilgrimages, and one pilgrimage is better than a house full of gold which he spends in righteousness until it is exhausted." He (narrator) said: “Then Imam (a.s) said: ‘And he has not succeeded who wastes twenty houses of gold for twenty-five dirhams.’" He (narrator) said: “So I asked: ‘And what is the meaning of twenty-five?’ Imam (a.s) said: "Whoever withholds zakat, his prayer is suspended until he gives zakat."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 141

chapter: Chapter on Additions Regarding Zakat
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Treat your sick through charity, repel calamity through supplication, and seek the descent of sustenance through charity, for it is released from between the jaws of seven hundred devils. And there is nothing heavier upon Satan than charity given to a believer, and it falls into the hand of the Lord (azj), Exalted is He (swt), before it falls into the hand of the servant."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» دَاوُوا مَرْضَاكُمْ بِالصَّدَقَةِ وَاِدْفَعُوا اَلْبَلاَءَ بِالدُّعَاءِ وَاِسْتَنْزِلُوا اَلرِّزْقَ بِالصَّدَقَةِ فَإِنَّهَا تُفَكُّ مِنْ بَيْنِ لَحْيَيْ سَبْعِمِائَةِ شَيْطَانٍ وَ لَيْسَ شَيْ ءٌأَثْقَلَ عَلَى اَلشَّيْطَانِ مِنَ اَلصَّدَقَةِ عَلَى اَلْمُؤْمِنِ وَ هِيَ تَقَعُ فِي يَدِ اَلرَّبِّ تَعَالَى قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقَعَ فِي يَدِ اَلْعَبْدِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Treat your sick through charity, repel calamity through supplication, and seek the descent of sustenance through charity, for it is released from between the jaws of seven hundred devils. And there is nothing heavier upon Satan than charity given to a believer, and it falls into the hand of the Lord (azj), Exalted is He (swt), before it falls into the hand of the servant."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 142

chapter: Chapter on Poll Tax; Jizyah
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Yahya al-Wasiti, from some of our companions, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘the Magians, did they have a prophet?’ Imam (a.s) said: "Yes. Has the letter of the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, to the people of Makkah not reached you: 'Accept Islam, otherwise I shall declare war against you'? So they (Magians) wrote to the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family: ‘Take the jizyah from us and leave us upon the worship of idols’. So the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, wrote to them: 'I do not take the jizyah except from the People of the Book.' So they (Magians) wrote to Him (saws), intending by that to accuse the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, of lying: ‘You claimed that you do not take the jizyah except from the People of the Book, then you took the jizyah from the Magians of Hajar’. So the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, wrote to them: 'The Magians had a prophet, but they killed him, and a book, but they burned it. Their prophet came to them (Magians) with their book in twelve thousand ox-hides.'"
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى اَلْوَاسِطِيِّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَجُوسِ أَ كَانَ لَهُمْ نَبِيٌّ فَقَالَ» نَعَمْ أَ مَا بَلَغَكَ كِتَابُ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إِلَى أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ» أَنْ أَسْلِمُوا وَ إِلاَّ نَابَذْتُكُمْ بِالْحَرْبِ« فَكَتَبُوا إِلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَنْ خُذْ مِنَّا اَلْجِزْيَةَ وَدَعْنَا عَلَى عِبَادَةِ اَلْأَوْثَانِ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِمُ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» أَنِّي لَسْتُ آخُذُ اَلْجِزْيَةَ إِلاَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلْكِتَابِ« فَكَتَبُوا إِلَيْهِ يُرِيدُونَ بِذَلِكَ تَكْذِيبَهُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ زَعَمْتَ أَنَّكَ لاَ تَأْخُذُ اَلْجِزْيَةَ إِلاَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلْكِتَابِ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتَ اَلْجِزْيَةَ مِنْ مَجُوسِ هَجَرَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِمُ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» أَنَّ اَلْمَجُوسَ كَانَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّ فَقَتَلُوهُ وَ كِتَابٌ أَحْرَقُوهُ أَتَاهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ بِكِتَابِهِمْ فِي اِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ أَلْفَ جِلْدِ ثَوْرٍ««.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Yahya al-Wasiti, from some of our companions, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘the Magians, did they have a prophet?’ Imam (a.s) said: "Yes. Has the letter of the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, to the people of Makkah not reached you: 'Accept Islam, otherwise I shall declare war against you'? So they (Magians) wrote to the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family: ‘Take the jizyah from us and leave us upon the worship of idols’. So the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, wrote to them: 'I do not take the jizyah except from the People of the Book.' So they (Magians) wrote to Him (saws), intending by that to accuse the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, of lying: ‘You claimed that you do not take the jizyah except from the People of the Book, then you took the jizyah from the Magians of Hajar’. So the Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, wrote to them: 'The Magians had a prophet, but they killed him, and a book, but they burned it. Their prophet came to them (Magians) with their book in twelve thousand ox-hides.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 143

chapter: Chapter on Poll Tax; Jizyah
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the charities of the people of dhimmah (protected non-Muslim citizens). And what is taken from their jizyah (per-capita poll tax) from the price of their wines, the flesh of their pigs, and their carrion.’ Imam (a.s) said: "Upon them (Ahlul Dhimmah) is the jizyah in their wealth; it is taken from them from the price of the flesh of the pig or wine. So whatever they take from them of that, then the burden of that is upon them, and its price is lawful for the Muslims; they take it in their jizyah."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَدَقَاتِ أَهْلِ اَلذِّمَّةِ وَ مَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ جِزْيَتِهِمْ مِنْ ثَمَنِ خُمُورِهِمْ وَلَحْمِ خَنَازِيرِهِمْ وَمَيْتَتِهِمْ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِمُ اَلْجِزْيَةُ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ ثَمَنِ لَحْمِ اَلْخِنْزِيرِ أَوْ خَمْرٍ فَكُلُّمَا أَخَذُوا مِنْهُمْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَوِزْرُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ ثَمَنُهُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ حَلاَلٌ يَأْخُذُونَهُ فِي جِزْيَتِهِمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the charities of the people of dhimmah (protected non-Muslim citizens). And what is taken from their jizyah (per-capita poll tax) from the price of their wines, the flesh of their pigs, and their carrion.’ Imam (a.s) said: "Upon them (Ahlul Dhimmah) is the jizyah in their wealth; it is taken from them from the price of the flesh of the pig or wine. So whatever they take from them of that, then the burden of that is upon them, and its price is lawful for the Muslims; they take it in their jizyah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 144

chapter: Chapter on Poll Tax; Jizyah
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, all of them from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "The Sunnah has proceeded that jizyah (per-capita poll tax) is not taken from the mentally deficient person (ma'tuh), nor from the one overcome in his intellect."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» جَرَتِ اَلسُّنَّةُ أَنْ لاَ تُؤْخَذَ اَلْجِزْيَةُ مِنَ اَلْمَعْتُوهِ وَ لاَ مِنَ اَلْمَغْلُوبِ عَلَى عَقْلِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, all of them from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The Sunnah has proceeded that jizyah (per-capita poll tax) is not taken from the mentally deficient person (ma'tuh), nor from the one overcome in his intellect."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 144

chapter: Chapter on Poll Tax; Jizyah
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Sindi ibn al-Rabi, from Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s), from his father (a.s), who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘Fighting is of two kinds: fighting against the people of polytheism, from whom one does not withdraw until they accept Islam or pay the jizyah (per-capita poll tax) by hand while they are humbled; And fighting against the people of deviation, from whom one does not withdraw until they return to the command of Allah (swt), or are killed."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ بْنِ اَلرَّبِيعِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» اَلْقِتَالُ قِتَالاَنِ قِتَالٌ لِأَهْلِ اَلشِّرْكِ لاَ يُنْفَرُ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّى يُسْلِمُوا أَوْ يُؤَدُّوا» اَلْجِزْيَةَ عَنْ يَدٍ وَ هُمْ صٰاغِرُونَ« وَ قِتَالٌ لِأَهْلِ اَلزَّيْغِ لاَ يُنْفَرُ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّى يَفِيئُوا »إِلىٰ أَمْرِ اللهَِ« أَوْ يُقْتَلُوا« .

chapter: Chapter on Mentioning the Categories of the People of the Poll Tax; Jizyah
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Minqari, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: "A man asked my father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s) about ‘the wars of the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, and the questioner was from among those who loved us (muhib).’ So Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said to him: “Allah (swt) sent Muhammad (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, with five swords. Three of them are drawn, not to be sheathed until ‘war lays down its burdens,’ (Surah Muhammad 47:4) and war will never lay down its burdens until the sun rises from its place of setting. When the sun rises from its place of setting, all people will believe on that day, and on that day ‘no soul will benefit from its faith if it had not believed before, or had earned good through its faith.’ (Surah Al-An'am 6:158) And one of them is a restrained sword, and one of them is a sheathed sword; drawing it belongs to other than us, and its judgement belongs to us. As for the three drawn swords; One sword is against the polytheists of the Arabs. Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said: ‘(But once the Sacred Months have passed), kill the polytheists (who violated their treaties) wherever you find them, capture them, besiege them, and lie in wait for them on every way. But if they repent, (meaning if the polytheists believe) perform prayers, and pay alms-tax, then set them free. Indeed, Allah (swt) is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.’ (Surah At-Tawbah 9:5) From these (polytheists), nothing is accepted except being killed or entering into Islam. Their wealth and their offspring are taken captive according to what the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, took captive, for the Prophet (saws) took captives, pardoned, and accepted ransom. And the second sword is against the people of dhimmah (protected non-Muslim residents). Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said: ‘And speak good to people.’ (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:83) It was revealed concerning the people of dhimmah, then the saying of Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), abrogated it: ‘Fight those who do not believe in Allah (swt) and the Last Day, nor comply with what Allah (swt) and His Messenger (saws) have forbidden, nor embrace the religion of truth from among those who were given the Scripture, until they pay the tax, willingly submitting, fully humbled.’ (Surah At-Tawbah 9:29) So whoever among them (people of dhimmah) is in the abode of Islam, nothing is accepted from him except the jizyah or being killed, and their wealth is ‘fay’, and their offspring are captives. Then when they accept the jizyah, taking them captive and their wealth becomes forbidden to us (muslims), and marrying their women becomes lawful for us. And whoever among them (people of dhimmah) is in the abode of war, taking them captive becomes lawful for us, but marrying their women does not become lawful for us, and nothing is accepted from them except the jizyah or being killed. And the third sword is a sword against the polytheists of the non-Arabs, meaning the Turks, the Khazars, and the Daylam. Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said at the beginning of the surah in which Allah (swt) mentions those who disbelieved, and He (swt) narrated their story. Allah (swt) had said, ‘(So when you meet the disbelievers in battle), strike their necks until you have thoroughly subdued them, then bind them firmly (captives). Later (free them either as) an act of grace or by ransom until the war comes to an end.’ meaning mutual ransom between them (polytheists of the non-Arabs) and the people of Islam. (Surah Muhammad 47:4) From these (polytheists of the non-Arabs), nothing will ever be accepted except being killed or entering into Islam, and marrying their women is not lawful for us as long as they are in the abode of war. As for the restrained sword, it is the sword of the people of rebellion and interpretation. Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said, ‘And if two groups of believers fight each other, then make peace between them. But if one of them transgresses against the other, then fight against the transgressing group until they submit to the rule of Allah (swt).’ (Surah Al-Hujurat 49:9) When this verse was revealed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said, "Indeed, among you is one who will fight after me upon interpretation, just as I fought upon revelation." The Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, was asked: “Who is he?” (meaning who will fight upon interpretation) Prophet (saws) said, "He is the mender of the sandal," meaning the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him. And Ammar ibn Yasir, may Allah (swt) have mercy on him, said: “I fought with this banner alongside the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, three times, and this is the fourth. By Allah (swt), if they struck us until they drove us to the palm-branches of Hajar, we would know that we are upon the truth and that they are upon falsehood. And the conduct among them from the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, was like what was from the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, regarding the people of Makkah on the day of the conquest of Makkah, for he (Imam Ali (a.s)) did not take their offspring captive, and he (Imam Ali (a.s)) said, ‘Whoever closes his door, or lays down his weapon, or enters the house of Abu Sufyan, may Allah (swt) curse him, is safe.’ Likewise, the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding them, ‘Do not take their offspring captive, do not finish off a wounded person, do not pursue one who turns away, and whoever closes his door or lays down his weapon is safe.’" As for the sheathed sword, it is the sword by which retaliation is carried out. Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said, ‘A life for a life,’ the verse (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:45). Its drawing belongs to the guardians of the murdered one, and its judgement belongs to us (the Imams (a.s)). These are the swords with which Allah (swt) sent His Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family. Whoever denies them, or denies one of them, or anything of their practices and rulings, has disbelieved in what Allah (swt) sent down upon Muhammad (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْقَاسَانِيِّ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ اَلْمِنْقَرِيِّ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ أَبِي عَنْ حُرُوبِ أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ كَانَ اَلسَّائِلُ مِنْ مُحِبِّينَا فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» بَعَثَ اَللَّهُ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِخَمْسَةِ أَسْيَافٍ ثَلاَثَةٌ مِنْهَا شَاهِرَةٌ لاَ تُغْمَدُ إِلَى أَنْ» تَضَعَ اَلْحَرْبُ أَوْزٰارَهٰا« وَ لَنْ تَضَعَ اَلْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ اَلشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا فَإِذَا طَلَعَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا آمَنَ اَلنَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ فَيَوْمَئِذٍ» لاٰ يَنْفَعُ نَفْساً إِيمٰانُهٰا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِي إِيمٰانِهٰا خَيْراً« وَ سَيْفٌ مِنْهَا مَكْفُوفٌ وَ سَيْفٌ مِنْهَا مَغْمُودٌ سَلُّهُ إِلَى غَيْرِنَا وَ حُكْمُهُ إِلَيْنَا' فَأَمَّا اَلسُّيُوفُ اَلثَّلاَثَةُ اَلشَّاهِرَةُ فَسَيْفٌ عَلَى مُشْرِكِي اَلْعَرَبِ قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى» فَاقْتُلُوا اَلْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدْتُمُوهُمْ وَخُذُوهُمْ وَاُحْصُرُوهُمْ وَاُقْعُدُوا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ فَإِنْ تٰابُوا« يَعْنِي فَإِنْ آمَنُوا» وَأَقٰامُوا اَلصَّلاٰةَ وَ آتَوُا اَلزَّكٰاةَ فَإِخْوٰانُكُمْ فِي اَلدِّينِ« فَهَؤُلاَءِ لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ اَلْقَتْلُ أَوِ اَلدُّخُولُ فِي اَلْإِسْلاَمِ فَأَمْوَالُهُمْ وَذَرَارِيُّهُمْ تُسْبَى عَلَى مَا سَبَى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَإِنَّهُ سَبَى وَ عَفَا وَ قَبِلَ اَلْفِدَاءَ وَ اَلسَّيْفُ اَلثَّانِي عَلَى أَهْلِ اَلذِّمَّةِ قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى» وَقُولُوا لِلنّٰاسِ حُسْناً« نَزَلَتْ فِي أَهْلِ اَلذِّمَّةِ ثُمَّ نَسَخَهَا قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى» قٰاتِلُوا اَلَّذِينَ لاٰ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ لاٰ بِالْيَوْمِ اَلْآخِرِ وَ لاٰ يُحَرِّمُونَ مٰا حَرَّمَ اللهَُ وَ رَسُولُهُ وَ لاٰ يَدِينُونَ دِينَ اَلْحَقِّ مِنَ اَلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا اَلْكِتٰابَ حَتّٰى يُعْطُوا اَلْجِزْيَةَ عَنْ يَدٍ وَ هُمْ صٰاغِرُونَ« فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْهُمْ فِي دَارِ اَلْإِسْلاَمِ فَلَمْ يُقْبَلْ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ اَلْجِزْيَةُ أَوِ اَلْقَتْلُ وَ مَا لُهُمْ فَيْءٌ وَذَرَارِيُّهُمْ سَبْيٌ فَإِذَا قَبِلُوا اَلْجِزْيَةَ حَرُمَ عَلَيْنَا سَبْيُهُمْ وَ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَ حَلَّتْ لَنَا مُنَاكَحَتُهُمْ وَ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْهُمْ فِي دَارِ اَلْحَرْبِ حَلَّ لَنَا سَبْيُهُمْ وَ لَمْ تَحِلَّ لَنَا مُنَاكَحَتُهُمْ وَ لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ اَلْجِزْيَةُ أَوِ اَلْقَتْلُ وَ اَلسَّيْفُ اَلثَّالِثُ سَيْفٌ عَلَى مُشْرِكِي اَلْعَجَمِ يَعْنِي اَلتُّرْكَ وَاَلْخَزَرَ وَاَلدَّيْلَمَ قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي أَوَّلِ اَلسُّورَةِ اَلَّتِي يَذْكُرُ فِيهَا اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَقَصَّ قِصَّتَهُمْ قَالَ» فَضَرْبَ اَلرِّقٰابِ حَتّٰى إِذٰا أَثْخَنْتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا اَلْوَثٰاقَ فَإِمّٰا مَنًّا بَعْدُ« يَعْنِي اَلسَّبْيَ» وَ إِمّٰا فِدٰاءً« يَعْنِي اَلْمُفَادَاةَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِ اَلْإِسْلاَمِ فَهَؤُلاَءِ لَنْ يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ اَلْقَتْلُ أَوِ اَلدُّخُولُ فِي اَلْإِسْلاَمِ وَ لاَ تَحِلُّ لَنَا مُنَاكَحَتُهُمْ مَا دَامُوا فِي دَارِ اَلْحَرْبِ وَ أَمَّا اَلسَّيْفُ اَلْمَكْفُوفُ فَسَيْفُ أَهْلِ اَلْبَغْيِ وَ اَلتَّأْوِيلِ قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى »وَ إِنْ طٰائِفَتٰانِ مِنَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ اِقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمٰا« اَلْآيَةَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ »حَتّٰى تَفِيءَ إِلىٰ أَمْرِ اللهَِ« فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ اَلْآيَةُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» إِنَّ مِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُقَاتِلُ بَعْدِي عَلَى اَلتَّأْوِيلِ كَمَا قَاتَلْتُ عَلَى اَلتَّنْزِيلِ« فَسُئِلَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مَنْ هُوَ فَقَالَ» هُوَ خَاصِفُ اَلنَّعْلِ« يَعْنِي أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ قَالَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ ره قَاتَلْتُ بِهَذِهِ اَلرَّايَةِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ثَلاَثاً فَهَذِهِ اَلرَّابِعَةُ وَ اَللَّهِ لَوْ ضَرَبُونَا حَتَّى يَبْلُغُوا بِنَا اَلسَّعَفَاتِ مِنْ هَجَرَ لَعَلِمْنَا أَنَّنَا عَلَى اَلْحَقِّ وَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَى اَلْبَاطِلِ وَ كَانَتِ اَلسِّيرَةُ فِيهِمْ مِنْ أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَا كَانَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْبِ لَهُمْ ذُرِّيَّةً وَ قَالَ» مَنْ أَغْلَقَ بَابَهُ أَوْ أَلْقَى سِلاَحَهُ أَوْ دَخَلَ دَارَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ لع فَهُوَ آمِنٌ« وَ كَذَلِكَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِيهِمْ» لاَ تَسْبُوا لَهُمْ ذُرِّيَّةً وَ لاَ تُتِمُّوا عَلَى جَرِيحٍ وَ لاَ تَتْبَعُوا مُدْبِراً وَ مَنْ أَغْلَقَ بَابَهُ أَوْ أَلْقَى سِلاَحَهُ فَهُوَ آمِنٌ« وَأَمَّا اَلسَّيْفُ اَلْمَغْمُودُ فَالسَّيْفُ اَلَّذِي يُقَامُ بِهِ اَلْقِصَاصُ قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى» اَلنَّفْسَ بِالنَّفْسِ« اَلْآيَةَ فَسَلُّهُ إِلَى أَوْلِيَاءِ اَلْمَقْتُولِ وَ حُكْمُهُ إِلَيْنَا فَهَذِهِ اَلسُّيُوفُ اَلَّتِي بَعَثَ اَللَّهُ بِهَا إِلَى نَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَمَنْ جَحَدَهَا أَوْ جَحَدَ وَاحِداً مِنْهَا أَوْ شَيْئاً مِنْ سِيَرِهَا وَأَحْكَامِهَا فَقَدْ كَفَرَ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اَللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ««.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Minqari, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: "A man asked my father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s) about ‘the wars of the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, and the questioner was from among those who loved us (muhib).’ So Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said to him: “Allah (swt) sent Muhammad (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, with five swords. Three of them are drawn, not to be sheathed until ‘war lays down its burdens,’ (Surah Muhammad 47:4) and war will never lay down its burdens until the sun rises from its place of setting. When the sun rises from its place of setting, all people will believe on that day, and on that day ‘no soul will benefit from its faith if it had not believed before, or had earned good through its faith.’ (Surah Al-An'am 6:158) And one of them is a restrained sword, and one of them is a sheathed sword; drawing it belongs to other than us, and its judgement belongs to us. As for the three drawn swords; One sword is against the polytheists of the Arabs. Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said: ‘(But once the Sacred Months have passed), kill the polytheists (who violated their treaties) wherever you find them, capture them, besiege them, and lie in wait for them on every way. But if they repent, (meaning if the polytheists believe) perform prayers, and pay alms-tax, then set them free. Indeed, Allah (swt) is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.’ (Surah At-Tawbah 9:5) From these (polytheists), nothing is accepted except being killed or entering into Islam. Their wealth and their offspring are taken captive according to what the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, took captive, for the Prophet (saws) took captives, pardoned, and accepted ransom. And the second sword is against the people of dhimmah (protected non-Muslim residents). Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said: ‘And speak good to people.’ (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:83) It was revealed concerning the people of dhimmah, then the saying of Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), abrogated it: ‘Fight those who do not believe in Allah (swt) and the Last Day, nor comply with what Allah (swt) and His Messenger (saws) have forbidden, nor embrace the religion of truth from among those who were given the Scripture, until they pay the tax, willingly submitting, fully humbled.’ (Surah At-Tawbah 9:29) So whoever among them (people of dhimmah) is in the abode of Islam, nothing is accepted from him except the jizyah or being killed, and their wealth is ‘fay’, and their offspring are captives. Then when they accept the jizyah, taking them captive and their wealth becomes forbidden to us (muslims), and marrying their women becomes lawful for us. And whoever among them (people of dhimmah) is in the abode of war, taking them captive becomes lawful for us, but marrying their women does not become lawful for us, and nothing is accepted from them except the jizyah or being killed. And the third sword is a sword against the polytheists of the non-Arabs, meaning the Turks, the Khazars, and the Daylam. Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said at the beginning of the surah in which Allah (swt) mentions those who disbelieved, and He (swt) narrated their story. Allah (swt) had said, ‘(So when you meet the disbelievers in battle), strike their necks until you have thoroughly subdued them, then bind them firmly (captives). Later (free them either as) an act of grace or by ransom until the war comes to an end.’ meaning mutual ransom between them (polytheists of the non-Arabs) and the people of Islam. (Surah Muhammad 47:4) From these (polytheists of the non-Arabs), nothing will ever be accepted except being killed or entering into Islam, and marrying their women is not lawful for us as long as they are in the abode of war. As for the restrained sword, it is the sword of the people of rebellion and interpretation. Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said, ‘And if two groups of believers fight each other, then make peace between them. But if one of them transgresses against the other, then fight against the transgressing group until they submit to the rule of Allah (swt).’ (Surah Al-Hujurat 49:9) When this verse was revealed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, said, "Indeed, among you is one who will fight after me upon interpretation, just as I fought upon revelation." The Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, was asked: “Who is he?” (meaning who will fight upon interpretation) Prophet (saws) said, "He is the mender of the sandal," meaning the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him. And Ammar ibn Yasir, may Allah (swt) have mercy on him, said: “I fought with this banner alongside the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, three times, and this is the fourth. By Allah (swt), if they struck us until they drove us to the palm-branches of Hajar, we would know that we are upon the truth and that they are upon falsehood. And the conduct among them from the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, was like what was from the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, regarding the people of Makkah on the day of the conquest of Makkah, for he (Imam Ali (a.s)) did not take their offspring captive, and he (Imam Ali (a.s)) said, ‘Whoever closes his door, or lays down his weapon, or enters the house of Abu Sufyan, may Allah (swt) curse him, is safe.’ Likewise, the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding them, ‘Do not take their offspring captive, do not finish off a wounded person, do not pursue one who turns away, and whoever closes his door or lays down his weapon is safe.’" As for the sheathed sword, it is the sword by which retaliation is carried out. Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), said, ‘A life for a life,’ the verse (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:45). Its drawing belongs to the guardians of the murdered one, and its judgement belongs to us (the Imams (a.s)). These are the swords with which Allah (swt) sent His Prophet (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family. Whoever denies them, or denies one of them, or anything of their practices and rulings, has disbelieved in what Allah (swt) sent down upon Muhammad (saws), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 145

chapter: Chapter on Amount of the Poll Tax (Jizyah)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What is the limit of the jizyah (per-capita poll tax) upon the People of the Book, and is there any fixed amount upon them in that which should not be exceeded?” Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to the Imam. He takes from each person among them whatever he wishes, according to his wealth and according to what he can bear. They are only a people who ransomed themselves from being enslaved or killed, so the jizyah is taken from them according to what they can bear, and he may burden them with it until they accept Islam. For Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, said: ‘Until they pay the tax, willingly submitting, fully humbled.’ (Surah At-Tawbah 9:29) And how can one of them (People of the Book) be humbled while he does not care about what is taken from him, until he feels humiliation because of what has been taken from him, feels pain because of that, and then accepts Islam?” And Ibn Muslim said: “I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s): ‘What do you think of what these people take of the fifth from the land of jizyah, while the jizyah upon their heads is taken from the dihqans (dahaqin), is there any fixed amount upon them in that?’” Imam (a.s) said: “There was upon them whatever they had agreed upon against themselves, and the Imam has nothing beyond the jizyah. If the Imam wishes, he places that upon their heads, and there is nothing upon their wealth; and if the Imam wishes, he places it upon their wealth, and there is nothing upon their heads.” So I (narrator) said: “And this fifth?” Imam (a.s) said: “This is only something upon which the blessed Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, made a settlement with them."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَا حَدُّ اَلْجِزْيَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ هَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي ذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ مُوَظَّفٌ لاَ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَجُوزُوا إِلَى غَيْرِهِ فَقَالَ» ذَلِكَ إِلَى اَلْإِمَامِ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ مِنْهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَالِهِ بِمَا يُطِيقُ إِنَّمَا هُمْ قَوْمٌ فَدَوْا أَنْفُسَهُمْ مِنْ أَنْ يُسْتَعْبَدُوا أَوْ يُقْتَلُوا فَالْجِزْيَةُ تُؤْخَذُ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا يُطِيقُونَ لَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ بِهِ حَتَّى يُسْلِمُوا فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قَالَ» حَتّٰى يُعْطُوا اَلْجِزْيَةَ عَنْ يَدٍ وَهُمْ صٰاغِرُونَ« وَكَيْفَ يَكُونُ صَاغِراً وَلاَ يَكْتَرِثُ لِمَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَجِدَ ذُلاًّ لِمَا أُخِذَ مِنْهُ فَيَأْلَمَ لِذَلِكَ فَيُسْلِمَ« قَالَ وَ قَالَ اِبْنُ مُسْلِمٍ قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ رَأَيْتَ مَا يَأْخُذُ هَؤُلاَءِ مِنَ اَلْخُمُسِ مِنْ أَرْضِ اَلْجِزْيَةِ وَ يُؤْخَذُ مِنَ اَلدَّهَاقِينِ جِزْيَةُ رُءُوسِهِمْ أَمَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِي ذَلِكَ شَيْءٌ مُوَظَّفٌ فَقَالَ» كَانَ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا أَجَازُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ لَيْسَ لِلْإِمَامِ أَكْثَرُ مِنَ اَلْجِزْيَةِ إِنْ شَاءَ اَلْإِمَامُ وَضَعَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ شَيْءٌ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ فَعَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ شَيْءٌ« فَقُلْتُ وَ هَذَا اَلْخُمُسُ فَقَالَ» إِنَّمَا هَذَا شَيْءٌ كَانَ صَالَحَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What is the limit of the jizyah (per-capita poll tax) upon the People of the Book, and is there any fixed amount upon them in that which should not be exceeded?” Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to the Imam. He takes from each person among them whatever he wishes, according to his wealth and according to what he can bear. They are only a people who ransomed themselves from being enslaved or killed, so the jizyah is taken from them according to what they can bear, and he may burden them with it until they accept Islam. For Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, said: ‘Until they pay the tax, willingly submitting, fully humbled.’ (Surah At-Tawbah 9:29) And how can one of them (People of the Book) be humbled while he does not care about what is taken from him, until he feels humiliation because of what has been taken from him, feels pain because of that, and then accepts Islam?” And Ibn Muslim said: “I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s): ‘What do you think of what these people take of the fifth from the land of jizyah, while the jizyah upon their heads is taken from the dihqans (dahaqin), is there any fixed amount upon them in that?’” Imam (a.s) said: “There was upon them whatever they had agreed upon against themselves, and the Imam has nothing beyond the jizyah. If the Imam wishes, he places that upon their heads, and there is nothing upon their wealth; and if the Imam wishes, he places it upon their wealth, and there is nothing upon their heads.” So I (narrator) said: “And this fifth?” Imam (a.s) said: “This is only something upon which the blessed Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, made a settlement with them."

chapter: Chapter on Amount of the Poll Tax (Jizyah)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the people of dhimmah (protected non-Muslim residents). What is upon them by which they preserve their blood and their wealth?’ Imam (a.s) said: "The land-tax (kharaj). So if the jizyah is taken from their heads, then there is no way against their lands; and if it is taken from their lands, then there is no way against their heads."
arabicText: حَرِيزٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَهْلِ اَلذِّمَّةِ مَاذَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِمَّا يَحْقُنُونَ بِهِ دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ قَالَ» اَلْخَرَاجُ فَإِنْ أُخِذَ مِنْ رُءُوسِهِمُ اَلْجِزْيَةُ فَلاَ سَبِيلَ عَلَى أَرَاضِيهِمْ وَ إِنْ أُخِذَ مِنْ أَرَاضِيهِمْ فَلاَ سَبِيلَ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ«.

chapter: Chapter on Amount of the Poll Tax (Jizyah)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘the people of jizyah, Is anything taken from their wealth and their livestock besides the jizyah (per-capita poll tax)?’ Imam (a.s) said: "No."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي أَهْلِ اَلْجِزْيَةِ أَ يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَمَوَاشِيهِمْ شَيْءٌ سِوَى اَلْجِزْيَةِ قَالَ» لاَ«.

chapter: Chapter on One Entitled to the Giving of the Poll Tax (Jizyah) Among the Muslims
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the conduct of the Imam regarding the land that was conquered after the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family.’ Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, conducted himself among the people of Iraq with a conduct, and it is an example for all other lands." And Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, the land of jizyah (per-capita poll tax), the jizyah is not lifted from them. Rather, the jizyah is the stipend of the emigrants, and the charities are for their people whom Allah (swt) named in His (swt) Book (Quran), they have no share in the jizyah." Then Imam (a.s) said: "How expansive justice is. Indeed, people become spacious when justice is carried out among them, And the sky sends down its provision, and the earth brings forth its blessing by the permission of Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ سِيرَةِ اَلْإِمَامِ فِي اَلْأَرْضِ اَلَّتِي فُتِحَتْ بَعْدَ رَ سُ و لِ اَ ل لَّ هِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالَ »إِنَّ أَمِيرَ اَ لْ مُ ؤْ مِ نِ ي نَ عَ لَ يْ هِ اَ ل سَّ ل اَ مُ قَ دْ سَ ا رَ فِ ي أَ هْ لِ اَ لْ عِ رَ ا قِ بِ سِ ي رَ ةٍ فَ هِ يَ إِ مَ ا مٌ لِ سَ ا ئِ رِ اَ لْ أَ رَ ضِ ي نَ«وَقَالَ»إِ نَّ أَ رْ ضَ اَ لْ جِ زْ يَ ةِ ل اَ تُرْفَعُ عَنْهُمُ اَلْجِزْيَةُ وَ إِنَّمَا اَلْجِزْيَةُ عَطَاءُ اَلْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَ اَلصَّدَقَاتُ لِأَهْلِهَا اَلَّذِينَ سَمَّى اَللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي اَلْجِزْيَةِ شَيْءٌ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» مَا أَوْسَعَ اَلْعَدْلَ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَتَّسِعُونَ إِذَا عُدِلَ فِيهِمْ وَ تُنْزِلُ اَلسَّمَاءُ رِزْقَهَا وَ تُخْرِجُ اَلْأَرْضُ بَرَكَتَهَا بِإِذْنِ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the conduct of the Imam regarding the land that was conquered after the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family.’ Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, conducted himself among the people of Iraq with a conduct, and it is an example for all other lands." And Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, the land of jizyah (per-capita poll tax), the jizyah is not lifted from them. Rather, the jizyah is the stipend of the emigrants, and the charities are for their people whom Allah (swt) named in His (swt) Book (Quran), they have no share in the jizyah." Then Imam (a.s) said: "How expansive justice is. Indeed, people become spacious when justice is carried out among them, And the sky sends down its provision, and the earth brings forth its blessing by the permission of Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt)."

chapter: Chapter on Land Tax (Kharaj) and the Cultivation of Lands
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashim, from Safwan ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
We mentioned Kufa to him, and what had been placed upon it of land-tax (kharaj), and what the people of his Household (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) had followed regarding it. He said: “Whoever embraced Islam willingly, his land was left in his hand, and from him was taken the tenth from what was watered by the sky and the rivers, and half of the tenth from what was watered by ropes (al-risha), from what they cultivated of it. As for what they did not cultivate of it, the Imam takes it and leases it to whoever cultivates it, and it belongs to the Muslims. Upon those who take it on lease, in their shares, is the tenth and half of the tenth. There is no zakat on less than five wasqs (awsaq). As for what was taken by the sword, that belongs to the Imam; he leases it for whatever he sees fit, just as the Messenger of Allah (swt), did with Khaybar. He (saws) leased its black and its white, meaning its land and its palm-trees. The people say, ‘leasing of land and palm-trees is not valid,’ while the Prophet (saws), leased Khaybar. Upon those who take it on lease, besides the lease-payment (qabalah) of the land, is the tenth and half of the tenth in their shares.” Then he said: “The people of Taif embraced Islam, and He (saws) placed upon them the tenth and half of the tenth. As for the people of Makkah, the Prophet (saws), entered it by force, and they were captives in his hand, so He (saws) freed them and said: ‘Go, for you are the freed ones.’”

chapter: Chapter on Land Tax (Kharaj) and the Cultivation of Lands
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I mentioned to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the land-tax (kharaj) and what the people of his Household (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) followed concerning it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “The tenth and half of the tenth are upon one who accepts Islam voluntarily. His land is left in his hand, and the tenth and half of the tenth are taken from him from what he cultivates of it. As for what he does not cultivate of it, the governor takes it and leases it to one who will cultivate it, and it belongs to the Muslims. And there is no zakat on anything less than five awsaq. And whatever is taken by the sword, that belongs to the Imam; he leases it according to what he sees fit, just as the Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, did with Khaybar. The Prophet (saws) leased its land and its palm-trees. And the people say: ‘Leasing land and palm-trees is not valid when the uncultivated land (bayad) is greater than the cultivated land (sawad),’ yet Messenger of Allah (swt), Allah's (swt) blessings be upon him and his family, leased Khaybar, and upon them in their shares is the tenth and half of the tenth.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: ذَكَرْتُ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلْخَرَاجَ وَ مَا سَارَ بِهِ أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ فَقَالَ» اَلْعُشْرُ وَ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ عَلَى مَنْ أَسْلَمَ تَطَوُّعاً تُرِكَتْ أَرْضُهُ فِي يَدِهِ وَ أُخِذَ مِنْهُ اَلْعُشْرُ وَ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ فِيمَا عَمَرَ مِنْهَا وَ مَا لَمْ يَعْمُرْ مِنْهَا أَخَذَهُ اَلْوَالِي فَقَبَّلَهُ مِمَّنْ يَعْمُرُهُ وَكَانَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ لَيْسَ فِيمَا كَانَ أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ شَيْءٌ وَ مَا أُخِذَ بِالسَّيْفِ فَذَلِكَ لِلْإِمَامِ يُقَبِّلُهُ بِالَّذِي يَرَى كَمَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِخَيْبَرَ قَبَّلَ أَرْضَهَا وَنَخْلَهَا وَ اَلنَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ لاَ تَصْلُحُ قَبَالَةُ اَلْأَرْضِ وَاَلنَّخْلِ إِذَا كَانَ اَلْبَيَاضُ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ اَلسَّوَادِ وَ قَدْ قَبَّلَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ خَيْبَرَ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي حِصَصِهِمُ اَلْعُشْرُ وَ نِصْفُ اَلْعُشْرِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I mentioned to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the land-tax (kharaj) and what the people of his Household (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) followed concerning it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “The tenth and half of the tenth are upon one who accepts Islam voluntarily. chapter: Chapter on Land Tax (Kharaj) and the Cultivation of Lands
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ibrahim ibn Imran al-Shaybani, from Yunus ibn Ibrahim, from Yahya ibn Ash'ath al-Kindi, from Mus'ab ibn Yazid al-Ansari, who said:
The Commander of the Believers, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s), peace be upon him, appointed me (Mus'ab ibn Yazid) over four districts (rasatiq) of al-Mada'in: al-Bahqubadhat, Bahurasir, Nahr Juwayr, and Nahr al-Malik. The Imam (a.s) commanded me to place upon every jarib (roughly equating to 0.5 to 1 acre) of heavy crop one and a half dirhams, Upon every jarib of medium crop one dirham, Upon every jarib of light crop two-thirds of a dirham, Upon every jarib of vineyard ten dirhams, Upon every jarib of palm-trees ten dirhams, And upon every jarib of gardens that combine palm-trees and other trees ten dirhams. Imam (a.s) commanded me to leave every isolated palm-tree outside the villages for passers-by on the road and the wayfarer, and not to take anything from it. Imam (a.s) commanded me to place upon the dihqans (dahaqin) who ride fine horses (baradhin) and wear gold rings, upon each man among them, forty-eight dirhams; And upon their middle class and merchants, upon each man, twenty-four dirhams; And upon their lower class and poor, twelve dirhams upon every person among them.” He (Mus'ab) said: “So I collected from it eighteen million dirhams in one year.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ اَلشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَشْعَثَ اَلْكِنْدِيِّ عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اَلْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ: اِسْتَعْمَلَنِي أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى أَرْبَعَةِ رَسَاتِيقِ اَلْمَدَائِنِ اَلْبِهْقُبَاذَاتِ وَبَهُرَ سِيرَ وَ نَهَرِ جُوَيْرٍ وَ نَهَرِ اَلْمَلِكِ وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَضَعَ عَلَى كُلِّ جَرِيبِ زَرْعٍ غَلِيظٍ دِرْهَماً وَنِصْفاً وَ عَلَى كُلِّ جَرِيبٍ وَسَطٍ دِرْهَماً عَلَى كُلِّ جَرِيبِ زَرْعٍ رَقِيقٍ ثُلُثَيْ دِرْهَمٍ وَ عَلَى كُلِّ جَرِيبِ كَرْمٍ عَشَرَةَ دَرَاهِمَ وَ عَلَى كُلِّ جَرِيبِ نَخْلٍ عَشَرَةَ دَرَاهِمَ وَ عَلَى كُلِّ جَرِيبِ اَلْبَسَاتِينِ اَلَّتِي تَجْمَعُ اَلنَّخْلَ وَ اَلشَّجَرَ عَشَرَةَ دَرَاهِمَ وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُلْقِيَ كُلَّ نَخْلٍ شَاذٍّ عَنِ اَلْقُرَى لِمَارَّةِ اَلطَّرِيقِ وَ اِبْنِ اَلسَّبِيلِ وَ لاَ آخُذَ مِنْهُ شَيْئاً وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَضَعَ عَلَى اَلدَّهَاقِينِ اَلَّذِينَ يَرْكَبُونَ اَلْبَرَاذِينَ وَيَتَخَتَّمُونَ بِالذَّهَبِ عَلَى كُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ ثَمَانِيَةً وَ أَرْبَعِينَ دِرْهَماً وَ عَلَى أَوْسَاطِهِمْ وَاَلتُّجَّارِ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى كُلِّ رَجُلٍ أَرْبَعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَماً وَ عَلَى سَفِلَتِهِمْ وَ فُقَرَائِهِمْ اِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ دِرْهَماً عَلَى كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ مِنْهُمْ قَالَ فَجَبَيْتُهَا ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ فِي سَنَةٍ.

The Imam (a.s) commanded me to place upon every jarib (roughly equating to 0.5 to 1 acre) of heavy crop one and a half dirhams, Upon every jarib of medium crop one dirham, Upon every jarib of light crop two-thirds of a dirham, Upon every jarib of vineyard ten dirhams, Upon every jarib of palm-trees ten dirhams, And upon every jarib of gardens that combine palm-trees and other trees ten dirhams. Imam (a.s) commanded me to leave every isolated palm-tree outside the villages for passers-by on the road and the wayfarer, and not to take anything from it. Imam (a.s) commanded me to place upon the dihqans (dahaqin) who ride fine horses (baradhin) and wear gold rings, upon each man among them, forty-eight dirhams; And upon their middle class and merchants, upon each man, twenty-four dirhams; And upon their lower class and poor, twelve dirhams upon every person among them.” He (Mus'ab) said: “So I collected from it eighteen million dirhams in one year.”
