chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abd al-Samad ibn Bashir, from Hukaym, the mu'adhdhin of Banu Abs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): "And know that whatever thing you gain, then indeed for Allah (swt) is its fifth, and for the Messenger (saws)." (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) Imam (a.s) said: "It is, by Allah (swt), the gain day by day, except that my father (a.s), peace be upon him, made our Shia free of liability from that, so that they may become pure."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يُوسُفَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلصَّمَدِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حُكَيْمٍ مُؤَذِّنِ بَنِي عَبْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ» وَاِعْلَمُوا أَنَّمٰا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلّٰهِ خُمُسَهُ وَ لِلرَّسُولِ« قَالَ» هِيَ وَ اَللَّهِ اَلْإِفَادَةُ يَوْماً بِيَوْمٍ إِلاَّ أَنَّ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جَعَلَ شِيعَتَنَا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فِي حِلٍّ لِيَزْكُوا«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abd al-Samad ibn Bashir, from Hukaym, the mu'adhdhin of Banu Abs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): "And know that whatever thing you gain, then indeed for Allah (swt) is its fifth, and for the Messenger (saws)." (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) Imam (a.s) said: "It is, by Allah (swt), the gain day by day, except that my father (a.s), peace be upon him, made our Shia free of liability from that, so that they may become pure."

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadalah and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘mines of gold, silver, brass (sufr), iron, and lead.’ Imam (a.s) said: "Upon all of them is the fifth (khums)."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ مَعَادِنِ اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْفِضَّةِ وَاَلصُّفْرِ وَاَلْحَدِيدِ وَ اَلرَّصَاصِ فَقَالَ» عَلَيْهَا اَلْخُمُسُ جَمِيعاً«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadalah and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘mines of gold, silver, brass (sufr), iron, and lead.’ Imam (a.s) said: "Upon all of them is the fifth (khums)."

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘ambergris and diving for pearls.’ Imam (a.s) said: "Upon it is the fifth." He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘treasure, how much is in it?’” – meaning khums. Imam (a.s) said: "The fifth." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘mines, how much is in them?’ Imam (a.s) said: "The fifth." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘lead, brass (sufr), iron, and whatever is in the mines, how much is in them?’ Imam (a.s) said: "It is taken from them just as it is taken from the mines of gold and silver."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْعَنْبَرِ وَغَوْصِ اَللُّؤْلُؤِ فَقَالَ» عَلَيْهِ اَلْخُمُسُ« قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْكَنْزِ كَمْ فِيهِ قَالَ» اَلْخُمُسُ« وَ عَنِ اَلْمَعَادِنِ كَمْ فِيهَا قَالَ» اَلْخُمُسُ« وَ عَنِ اَلرَّصَاصِ وَاَلصُّفْرِ وَاَلْحَدِيدِ وَمَا كَانَ بِالْمَعَادِنِ كَمْ فِيهَا قَالَ» يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا كَمَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ مَعَادِنِ اَلذَّهَبِ وَاَلْفِضَّةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘ambergris and diving for pearls.’ Imam (a.s) said: "Upon it is the fifth." He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘treasure, how much is in it?’” – meaning khums. Imam (a.s) said: "The fifth." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘mines, how much is in them?’ Imam (a.s) said: "The fifth." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘lead, brass (sufr), iron, and whatever is in the mines, how much is in them?’ Imam (a.s) said: "It is taken from them just as it is taken from the mines of gold and silver."

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘mines, what is in them?’ – meaning khums. Imam (a.s) said: "Everything that is rikaz (precious items buried inside the ground), then in it is the fifth (for khums)." And Imam (a.s) said: "Whatever you process with your wealth, then in what Allah (swt) brings out from it, from its stones, purified, there is the fifth (for khums)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَعَادِنِ مَا فِيهَا فَقَالَ »كُلُّمَا كَانَ رِكَازاً فَفِيهِ اَلْخُمُسُ« وَ قَالَ »مَا عَالَجْتَهُ بِمَالِكَ فَفِيهِ مِمَّا أَخْرَجَ اَللَّهُ مِنْهُ مِنْ حِجَارَتِهِ مُصَفًّى اَلْخُمُسُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘mines, what is in them?’ – meaning khums. Imam (a.s) said: "Everything that is rikaz (precious items buried inside the ground), then in it is the fifth (for khums)." And Imam (a.s) said: "Whatever you process with your wealth, then in what Allah (swt) brings out from it, from its stones, purified, there is the fifth (for khums)."

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim al-Hadrami, from Abdullah ibn Sinan:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Upon every person who gains or earns is the fifth (khums) from what he acquires, for Sayyidah Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, and for whoever undertakes her affair after Her (s.a) from Her (s.a) progeny, the proofs over the people (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)). That (khums) is especially for them; they place it wherever they wish, for charity has been forbidden to them (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)). Even the tailor who sews a shirt for five daniqs (dawaniq), then for us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) from it is one daniq, except for those among our Shia for whom we have made it lawful, so that their birth may be pure through it (receiving khums). Indeed, there is nothing greater with Allah (swt) on the Day of Resurrection than fornication. Indeed, the possessor of the fifth (khums) will stand and say: ‘O Lord (azj), ask these people about what was made permissible for them.’”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» عَلَى كُلِّ اِمْرِئٍ غَنِمَ أَوِ اِكْتَسَبَ اَلْخُمُسُ مِمَّا أَصَابَ لِفَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ لِمَنْ يَلِي أَمْرَهَا مِنْ بَعْدِهَا مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهَا اَلْحُجَجِ عَلَى اَلنَّاسِ فَذَاكَ لَهُمْ خَاصَّةً يَضَعُونَهُ حَيْثُ شَاءُوا إِذْ حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلصَّدَقَةُ حَتَّى اَلْخَيَّاطُ لَيَخِيطُ قَمِيصاً بِخَمْسَةِ دَوَانِيقَ فَلَنَا مِنْهَا دَانِقٌ إِلاَّ مَنْ أَحْلَلْنَا مِنْ شِيعَتِنَا لِتَطِيبَ لَهُمْ بِهِ اَلْوِلاَدَةُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَ اَللَّهِ يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ أَعْظَمَ مِنَ اَلزِّنَا إِنَّهُ لَيَقُومُ صَاحِبُ اَلْخُمُسِ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ سَلْ هَؤُلاَءِ بِمَا أُبِيحُوا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim al-Hadrami, from Abdullah ibn Sinan:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Upon every person who gains or earns is the fifth (khums) from what he acquires, for Sayyidah Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, and for whoever undertakes her affair after Her (s.a) from Her (s.a) progeny, the proofs over the people (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)). That (khums) is especially for them; they place it wherever they wish, for charity has been forbidden to them (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)). Even the tailor who sews a shirt for five daniqs (dawaniq), then for us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) from it is one daniq, except for those among our Shia for whom we have made it lawful, so that their birth may be pure through it (receiving khums). Indeed, there is nothing greater with Allah (swt) on the Day of Resurrection than fornication. Indeed, the possessor of the fifth (khums) will stand and say: ‘O Lord (azj), ask these people about what was made permissible for them.’”

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the salt-marsh (mallahah).’ Imam (a.s) said: "And what is the salt-marsh?" So he (narrator) said: “It is barren saline land (ard sabikha) and salty, in which water gathers and then becomes salt.” Imam (a.s) said: "This is a mineral (ma'din); in it is the fifth (khums)." So I (narrator) asked: “And sulphur and oil which are extracted from the earth?” He (narrator) said: “Imam (a.s) said, ‘This and its likes, in them is the fifth (khums).’"
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَلاَّحَةِ فَقَالَ» وَ مَا اَلْمَلاَّحَةُ« فَقَالَ أَرْضٌ سَبِخَةٌ مَالِحَةٌ يَجْتَمِعُ فِيهَا اَلْمَاءُ فَيَصِيرُ مِلْحاً فَقَالَ» هَذَا اَلْمَعْدِنُ فِيهِ اَلْخُمُسُ« فَقُلْتُ وَاَلْكِبْرِيتُ وَاَلنِّفْطُ يُخْرَجُ مِنَ اَلْأَرْضِ قَالَ فَقَالَ» هَذَا وَأَشْبَاهُهُ فِيهِ اَلْخُمُسُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the salt-marsh (mallahah).’ Imam (a.s) said: "And what is the salt-marsh?" So he (narrator) said: “It is barren saline land (ard sabikha) and salty, in which water gathers and then becomes salt.” Imam (a.s) said: "This is a mineral (ma'din); in it is the fifth (khums)." So I (narrator) asked: “And sulphur and oil which are extracted from the earth?” He (narrator) said: “Imam (a.s) said, ‘This and its likes, in them is the fifth (khums).’"

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "Take the wealth of the ‘hostile opponent’ (nasibi) wherever you find it, and give the fifth (khums) to us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s))."
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» خُذْ مَالَ اَلنَّاصِبِ حَيْثُ مَا وَجَدْتَهُ وَ اِدْفَعْ إِلَيْنَا اَلْخُمُسَ
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Take the wealth of the ‘hostile opponent’ (nasibi) wherever you find it, and give the fifth (khums) to us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s))."

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Sayf ibn Amirah, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, from al-Mu'alla:
Imam (a.s) said: "Take the wealth of the ‘hostile opponent’ (nasibi) wherever you find it, and send to us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) the fifth (khums)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنِ اَلْمُعَلَّى قَالَ:» خُذْ مَالَ اَلنَّاصِبِ حَيْثُ مَا وَجَدْتَهُ وَاِبْعَثْ إِلَيْنَا بِالْخُمُسِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Sayf ibn Amirah, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, from al-Mu'alla:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "Take the wealth of the ‘hostile opponent’ (nasibi) wherever you find it, and send to us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) the fifth (khums)."

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Abu Ja'far, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Ash'ari, who said:
Some of our companions wrote to Abu Ja'far the Second (a.s), peace be upon him: “Inform us about ‘the fifth (khums), Is it upon everything that a man gains, whether little or much, from all types, and upon craftsmen? And how is that?’” Imam (a.s) wrote in his handwriting: "The fifth (khums) is after the expenses."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ اَلثَّانِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنِ اَلْخُمُسِ أَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ مَا يَسْتَفِيدُ اَلرَّجُلُ مِنْ قَلِيلٍ وَ كَثِيرٍ مِنْ جَمِيعِ اَلضُّرُوبِ وَ عَلَى اَلصُّنَّاعِ وَ كَيْفَ ذَلِكَ فَكَتَبَ بِخَطِّهِ» اَلْخُمُسُ بَعْدَ اَلْمَئُونَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Abu Ja'far, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Ash'ari, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Some of our companions wrote to Abu Ja'far the Second (a.s), peace be upon him: “Inform us about ‘the fifth (khums), Is it upon everything that a man gains, whether little or much, from all types, and upon craftsmen? And how is that?’” Imam (a.s) wrote in his handwriting: "The fifth (khums) is after the expenses."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 158

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar said: Abu Ali ibn Rashid said to me:
I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “You commanded me to undertake your affair and to take your right (khums), so I informed your followers of that. Then some of them said to me, ‘And what thing is his right?’ But I did not know what to answer him. Imam (a.s) said: "The fifth (khums) is obligatory upon them." So I (narrator) asked: “In what thing?” Imam (a.s) said: "In their goods and their estates." He (narrator) said: “And is it upon the merchant and the craftsman who works with his hand?” Imam (a.s) said: "That is when it is possible for them after their expenses."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَلِيِّ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَمَرْتَنِي بِالْقِيَامِ بِأَمْرِكَ وَ أَخْذِ حَقِّكَ فَأَعْلَمْتُ مَوَالِيَكَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لِي بَعْضُهُمْ وَأَيُّ شَيْءٍ حَقُّهُ فَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا أُجِيبُهُ فَقَالَ» يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلْخُمُسُ« فَقُلْتُ فَفِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ فَقَالَ» فِي أَمْتِعَتِهِمْ وَضِيَاعِهِمْ« قَالَ وَاَلتَّاجِرُ عَلَيْهِ وَاَلصَّانِعُ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ» ذَلِكَ إِذَا أَمْكَنَهُمْ بَعْدَ مَئُونَتِهِمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar said: Abu Ali ibn Rashid said to me:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “You commanded me to undertake your affair and to take your right (khums), so I informed your followers of that. Then some of them said to me, ‘And what thing is his right?’ But I did not know what to answer him. Imam (a.s) said: "The fifth (khums) is obligatory upon them." So I (narrator) asked: “In what thing?” Imam (a.s) said: "In their goods and their estates." He (narrator) said: “And is it upon the merchant and the craftsman who works with his hand?” Imam (a.s) said: "That is when it is possible for them after their expenses."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 158

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar said: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Hamdani wrote to him:
Ali (ibn Mahziyar) read to me your father's (Imam al-Jawad (a.s)) letter concerning what He (a.s) had made obligatory upon the owners of estates: "That He (Imam al-Jawad (a.s)) made obligatory upon them half of one-sixth after the expenses (maunah), and that there is not upon one whose estate does not cover his expenses half of one-sixth, nor anything other than that." So those before us differed concerning that and said: “The fifth is obligatory upon estates after the expenses, meaning the expenses of the estate and its land-tax, not the expenses of the man and his dependants.” Imam al-Hadi (a.s) wrote, and Ali ibn Mahziyar read it: "Upon him is the fifth (khums) after his expenses, the expenses of his dependants, and after the tax of the ruler."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْهَمْدَانِيُّ أَقْرَأَنِي عَلِيٌّ كِتَابَ أَبِيكَ فِيمَا أَوْجَبَهُ عَلَى أَصْحَابِ اَلضِّيَاعِ» أَنَّهُ أَوْجَبَ عَلَيْهِمْ نِصْفَ اَلسُّدُسِ بَعْدَ اَلْمَئُونَةِ وَأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَى مَنْ لَمْ تَقُمْ ضَيْعَتُهُ بِمَئُونَتِهِ نِصْفُ اَلسُّدُسِ وَلاَ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ« فَاخْتَلَفَ مَنْ قِبَلَنَا فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالُوا يَجِبُ عَلَى اَلضِّيَاعِ اَلْخُمُسُ بَعْدَ اَلْمَئُونَةِ مَئُونَةِ اَلضَّيْعَةِ وَخَرَاجِهَا لاَ مَئُونَةِ اَلرَّجُلِ وَ عِيَالِهِ فَكَتَبَ وَقَرَأَهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ» عَلَيْهِ اَلْخُمُسُ بَعْدَ مَئُونَتِهِ وَ مَئُونَةِ عِيَالِهِ وَ بَعْدَ خَرَاجِ اَلسُّلْطَانِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar said: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Hamdani wrote to him:
thaqalaynMatn: Ali (ibn Mahziyar) read to me your father's (Imam al-Jawad (a.s)) letter concerning what He (a.s) had made obligatory upon the owners of estates: "That He (Imam al-Jawad (a.s)) made obligatory upon them half of one-sixth after the expenses (maunah), and that there is not upon one whose estate does not cover his expenses half of one-sixth, nor anything other than that." So those before us differed concerning that and said: “The fifth is obligatory upon estates after the expenses, meaning the expenses of the estate and its land-tax, not the expenses of the man and his dependants.” Imam al-Hadi (a.s) wrote, and Ali ibn Mahziyar read it: "Upon him is the fifth (khums) after his expenses, the expenses of his dependants, and after the tax of the ruler."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 159

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman, from Abu Ubaydah al-Hadhdha, who said:
I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: "Whichever dhimmi (protected non-Muslim resident) buys land from a Muslim, then upon him is the fifth (khums)."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ اَلْحَذَّاءِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» أَيُّمَا ذِمِّيٍّ اِشْتَرَى مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ أَرْضاً فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ اَلْخُمُسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman, from Abu Ubaydah al-Hadhdha, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: "Whichever dhimmi (protected non-Muslim resident) buys land from a Muslim, then upon him is the fifth (khums)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 159

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘what is brought out from the sea, of pearls, rubies, and emeralds, and about mines of gold and silver. Is their zakat upon them?’ Imam (a.s) said: "When its value reaches a dinar, then in it is the fifth (khums)."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَمَّا يُخْرَجُ مِنَ اَلْبَحْرِ مِنَ اَللُّؤْلُؤِ وَاَلْيَاقُوتِ وَاَلزَّبَرْجَدِ وَ عَنْ مَعَادِنِ اَلذَّهَبِ وَ اَلْفِضَّةِ هَلْ عَلَيْهِ زَكَاتُهَا فَقَالَ» إِذَا بَلَغَ قِيمَتُهُ دِينَاراً فَفِيهِ اَلْخُمُسُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘what is brought out from the sea, of pearls, rubies, and emeralds, and about mines of gold and silver. Is their zakat upon them?’ Imam (a.s) said: "When its value reaches a dinar, then in it is the fifth (khums)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 160

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ismail, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘a man from among our companions who is under their banner, and is with them, and obtains spoils.’ Imam (a.s) said: "He pays its fifth (khums), and it (spoils) becomes lawful for him."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا يَكُونُ فِي لِوَائِهِمْ فَيَكُونُ مَعَهُمْ فَيُصِيبُ غَنِيمَةً قَالَ» يُؤَدِّي خُمُسَهَا وَيَطِيبُ لَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ismail, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘a man from among our companions who is under their banner, and is with them, and obtains spoils.’ Imam (a.s) said: "He pays its fifth (khums), and it (spoils) becomes lawful for him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 160

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from al-Hakam ibn Buhlul, from Abu Hammam, from al-Hasan ibn Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: "A man came to the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, and said: ‘O Commander of the Believers (a.s), I have acquired wealth whose lawful from its unlawful I do not know.’ Imam Ali (a.s) said: “Take out the fifth (khums) from that wealth, for Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), has been pleased with the fifth (khums) from wealth, and avoid what its owner used to do."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَكَمِ بْنِ بُهْلُولٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَى أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ مَالاً لاَ أَعْرِفُ حَلاَلَهُ مِنْ حَرَامِهِ فَقَالَ» أَخْرِجِ اَلْخُمُسَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ اَلْمَالِ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى قَدْ رَضِيَ مِنَ اَلْمَالِ بِالْخُمُسِ وَ اِجْتَنِبْ مَا كَانَ صَاحِبُهُ يَعْمَلُ««.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from al-Hakam ibn Buhlul, from Abu Hammam, from al-Hasan ibn Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: "A man came to the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, and said: ‘O Commander of the Believers (a.s), I have acquired wealth whose lawful from its unlawful I do not know.’ Imam Ali (a.s) said: “Take out the fifth (khums) from that wealth, for Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt), has been pleased with the fifth (khums) from wealth, and avoid what its owner used to do."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 160

chapter: Chapter on Khums and Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: "The fifth (khums) is only in spoils specifically."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» لَيْسَ اَلْخُمُسُ إِلاَّ فِي اَلْغَنَائِمِ خَاصَّةً«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: "The fifth (khums) is only in spoils specifically."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 161

chapter: Chapter on Distinguishing the People of Khums and Those Entitled to It from Those Whom Allah Mentioned in the Quran
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, who said: Zakariyya ibn Malik al-Ju'fi narrated to us, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
He (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: ‘Whatever thing you gain, then indeed for Allah (swt) is its fifth, and for Messenger (saws), and for the near relative, and the orphans, and the needy, and the wayfarer.’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) Imam (a.s) said: "As for the fifth of Allah (swt), the Majestic, it is for the Messenger (saws); he places it in the way of Allah (swt). As for the ‘fifth of the Messenger (saws)’, it is for His (saws) relatives. And the ‘fifth of those of near kin’, they are His (saws) relatives. And the ‘orphans’ are the orphans of the people of His (saws) household. So the Prophet (saws) made these four into four shares among them. As for the needy and the wayfarer, you already know that we (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) do not eat charity, and it is not lawful for us, so it is for the needy and the wayfarers."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ مَالِكٍ اَلْجُعْفِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» وَاِعْلَمُوا أَنَّمٰا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلّٰهِ خُمُسَهُ وَ لِلرَّسُولِ وَ لِذِي اَلْقُرْبىٰ وَ اَلْيَتٰامىٰ وَ اَلْمَسٰاكِينِ وَ اِبْنِ اَلسَّبِيلِ« فَقَالَ» أَمَّا خُمُسُ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَلِلرَّسُولِ يَضَعُهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اَللَّهِ وَأَمَّا خُمُسُ اَلرَّسُولِ فَلِأَقَارِبِهِ وَخُمُسُ ذَوِي اَلْقُرْبَى فَهُمْ أَقْرِبَاؤُهُ وَاَلْيَتَامَى يَتَامَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ فَجَعَلَ هَذِهِ اَلْأَرْبَعَةَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَسْهُمٍ فِيهِمْ وَ أَمَّا اَلْمَسَاكِينُ وَ اِبْنُ اَلسَّبِيلِ فَقَدْ عَرَفْتَ أَنَّا لاَ نَأْكُلُ اَلصَّدَقَةَ وَ لاَ تَحِلُّ لَنَا فَهِيَ لِلْمَسَاكِينِ وَ أَبْنَاءِ اَلسَّبِيلِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, who said: Zakariyya ibn Malik al-Ju'fi narrated to us, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: He (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: ‘Whatever thing you gain, then indeed for Allah (swt) is its fifth, and for Messenger (saws), and for the near relative, and the orphans, and the needy, and the wayfarer.’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) Imam (a.s) said: "As for the fifth of Allah (swt), the Majestic, it is for the Messenger (saws); he places it in the way of Allah (swt). As for the ‘fifth of the Messenger (saws)’, it is for His (saws) relatives. And the ‘fifth of those of near kin’, they are His (saws) relatives. And the ‘orphans’ are the orphans of the people of His (saws) household. So the Prophet (saws) made these four into four shares among them. As for the needy and the wayfarer, you already know that we (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) do not eat charity, and it is not lawful for us, so it is for the needy and the wayfarers."

And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from some of his companions, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding the saying of Allah (swt), Exalted is He (swt): ‘And know that whatever thing you gain, then indeed for Allah (swt) is its fifth, and for the Messenger (saws), and for the near relative, and the orphans, and the needy, and the wayfarer.’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) Imam (a.s) said: "The fifth of Allah (swt) and the fifth of the Messenger (saws) are for the Imam (a.s), And the fifth of ‘near relative’ is for the relatives of Messenger (saws) and the Imam (a.s), And the ‘orphans’ are the orphans of the family of the Messenger (saws), And the ‘needy’ are from them, and the ‘wayfarers’ are from them, so it is not taken out from them to others."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى» وَاِعْلَمُوا أَنَّمٰا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلّٰهِ خُمُسَهُ وَ لِلرَّسُولِ وَ لِذِي اَلْقُرْبىٰ وَ اَلْيَتٰامىٰ وَاَلْمَسٰاكِينِ وَاِبْنِ اَلسَّبِيلِ« قَالَ» خُمُسُ اَللَّهِ وَخُمُسُ اَلرَّسُولِ لِلْإِمَامِ وَخُمُسُ ذِي اَلْقُرْبَى لِقَرَابَةِ اَلرَّسُولِ وَ اَلْإِمَامِ وَ اَلْيَتَامَى يَتَامَى آلِ اَلرَّسُولِ وَ اَلْمَسَاكِينُ مِنْهُمْ وَ أَبْنَاءُ اَلسَّبِيلِ مِنْهُمْ فَلاَ يُخْرَجُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى غَيْرِهِمْ«.

chapter: Chapter on Distinguishing the People of Khums and Those Entitled to It from Those Whom Allah Mentioned in the Quran
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Za'farani, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Sulaym ibn Qays al-Hilali, from the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) heard Imam Ali (a.s) speaking many words, then Imam (a.s) said: "And give them, from all of that, the share of the near relative. Allah (swt), the Exalted, said: ‘If you have believed in Allah (swt) and what We revealed to Our servant on that decisive day when the two armies met (at Badr).’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) We (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)), by Allah (swt), are those meant by the ‘near relative’, and they are those whom Allah (swt) joined with Himself (swt) and with His blessed Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Then indeed, for Allah (swt) is its fifth, and for the Messenger (saws), and for the near relative, and the orphans, and the needy, and the wayfarer, from us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) specifically. And Allah (swt) did not appoint for us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) any share in the share of charity. Allah (swt) honored His Prophet (saws) and honored us by keeping us away from being fed from the filth of what is in the people's hands.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلزَّعْفَرَانِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ اَلْهِلاَلِيِّ عَنْ أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ كَلاَماً كَثِيراً ثُمَّ قَالَ:» وَ أَعْطِهِمْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ سَهْمَ ذِي اَلْقُرْبَى قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى» إِنْ كُنْتُمْ آمَنْتُمْ بِاللّٰهِ وَ مٰا أَنْزَلْنٰا عَلىٰ عَبْدِنٰا يَوْمَ اَلْفُرْقٰانِ يَوْمَ اِلْتَقَى اَلْجَمْعٰانِ« نَحْنُ وَ اَللَّهِ عُنِيَ بِذِي اَلْقُرْبَى وَ هُمُ اَلَّذِينَ قَرَنَهُمُ اَللَّهُ بِنَفْسِهِ وَبِنَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَقَالَ» فَأَنَّ لِلّٰهِ خُمُسَهُ وَ لِلرَّسُولِ وَ لِذِي اَلْقُرْبىٰ وَ اَلْيَتٰامىٰ وَ اَلْمَسٰاكِينِ وَ اِبْنِ اَلسَّبِيلِ« مِنَّا خَاصَّةً وَ لَمْ يَجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي سَهْمِ اَلصَّدَقَةِ نَصِيباً أَكْرَمَ اَللَّهُ نَبِيَّهُ وَ أَكْرَمَنَا أَنْ يُطْعِمَنَا أَوْسَاخَ أَيْدِي اَلنَّاسِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Za'farani, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Aban ibn Abi Ayyash, from Sulaym ibn Qays al-Hilali, from the Commander of the Believers (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:

Allah (swt), the Exalted, said: ‘If you have believed in Allah (swt) and what We revealed to Our servant on that decisive day when the two armies met (at Badr).’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) We (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)), by Allah (swt), are those meant by the ‘near relative’, and they are those whom Allah (swt) joined with Himself (swt) and with His blessed Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Then indeed, for Allah (swt) is its fifth, and for the Messenger (saws), and for the near relative, and the orphans, and the needy, and the wayfarer, from us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) specifically. And Allah (swt) did not appoint for us (Ahlul Bayt (a.s)) any share in the share of charity. Allah (swt) honored His Prophet (saws) and honored us by keeping us away from being fed from the filth of what is in the people's hands.”

chapter: Chapter on Distinguishing the People of Khums and Those Entitled to It from Those Whom Allah Mentioned in the Quran
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad said to Imam (a.s): “Zakat has become obligatory upon you.” Imam (a.s) said: “No, rather, we give extra and we give in this manner.” And Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted, ‘And know that whatever you gain of anything, then indeed, for Allah (swt) is one-fifth of it, and for the Messenger (saws), and for the near relative, and the orphans, and the needy.’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) It was said to Imam (a.s): “Then that which belongs to Allah (swt), to whom does it go?” Imam (a.s) said: “It is for the Messenger (saws), and whatever belongs to the blessed Messenger (saws), then it belongs to the Imam (a.s).” It was said to Imam (a.s): “What is your view if one category is greater in number than another, while another category is fewer in number? How should it be dealt with?” Imam (a.s) said: “That is left to the Imam (a.s). Do you not see how the blessed Messenger of Allah (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, acted? The Prophet (saws) would only give according to what He (saws) deemed appropriate. The Imam (a.s) is likewise.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَبِي اَلْبِلاَدِ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْكَ زَكَاةٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ وَ لَكِنْ نُفْضِلُ وَ نُعْطِي هَكَذَا« وَ سُئِلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى» وَاِعْلَمُوا أَنَّمٰا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلّٰهِ خُمُسَهُ وَ لِلرَّسُولِ وَ لِذِي اَلْقُرْبىٰ وَ اَلْيَتٰامىٰ وَ اَلْمَسٰاكِينِ« فَقِيلَ لَهُ فَمَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ فَلِمَنْ هُوَ قَالَ» لِلرَّسُولِ وَ مَا كَانَ لِلرَّسُولِ فَهُوَ لِلْإِمَامِ« فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ صِنْفٌ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ صِنْفٍ وَ صِنْفٌ أَقَلَّ مِنْ صِنْفٍ فَكَيْفَ نَصْنَعُ بِهِ فَقَالَ» ذَاكَ إِلَى اَلْإِمَامِ أَرَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ كَيْفَ صَنَعَ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يُعْطِي عَلَى مَا يَرَى هُوَ كَذَلِكَ اَلْإِمَامُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Ibrahim ibn Abi al-Bilad said to Imam (a.s): “Zakat has become obligatory upon you.” Imam (a.s) said: “No, rather, we give extra and we give in this manner.” And Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted, ‘And know that whatever you gain of anything, then indeed, for Allah (swt) is one-fifth of it, and for the Messenger (saws), and for the near relative, and the orphans, and the needy.’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) It was said to Imam (a.s): “Then that which belongs to Allah (swt), to whom does it go?” Imam (a.s) said: “It is for the Messenger (saws), and whatever belongs to the blessed Messenger (saws), then it belongs to the Imam (a.s).” It was said to Imam (a.s): “What is your view if one category is greater in number than another, while another category is fewer in number? How should it be dealt with?” Imam (a.s) said: “That is left to the Imam (a.s). Do you not see how the blessed Messenger of Allah (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, acted? The Prophet (saws) would only give according to what He (saws) deemed appropriate. The Imam (a.s) is likewise.”

chapter: Chapter on Distinguishing the People of Khums and Those Entitled to It from Those Whom Allah Mentioned in the Quran
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said:
Some of our companions narrated to us, raising the hadith, saying: “The fifth (khums) is taken from five things: treasures (kunuz), minerals (ma‘adin), diving (ghaws), the booty (maghnam) over which fighting takes place, and he did not remember the fifth (category). And whatever comes from a conquest over which fighting did not take place, and against which neither horses nor riding camels were driven forward, except that our companions come to him and make a transaction with him concerning it, then whatever he makes a transaction with them upon, whether half, or a third, or a quarter, or whatever share is assigned specifically to him, then no one has any right in it except what he gives from it. And the depths of valleys, the tops of mountains, and every dead land, they belong to him. And this is the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted: ‘They ask you concerning the spoils (al-anfal),’ meaning that you should give them from it. (Surah Al-Anfal 8:1) He said: ‘Say: The spoils (al-anfal) belong to Allah (swt) and the Messenger (saws).’ And it is not: ‘They ask you about the spoils (al-anfal).’ And whatever belongs to the towns, and the inheritance of one who has no heir, then it belongs specifically to him. And this is the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: ‘As for gains granted by Allah (swt) to His Messenger (saws) from the people of (other) lands.’ (Surah Al-Hashr 59:7) As for the fifth (khums), it is divided into six shares: (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) A share for Allah (swt), A share for the Messenger (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, A share for the near relative, A share for the orphans, A share for the needy, And a share for the sons of the road (wayfarers). So that which belongs to Allah (swt) and to the Messenger of Allah (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, the Messenger of Allah (saws) has the greatest right to it, and therefore it belongs specifically to him. And that which belongs to the Messenger (saws) belongs to the near relative and the proof (al-hujjah) in his time; therefore, half belongs specifically to him, meaning the Imam (a.s). And the other half is for the orphans, the needy, and the sons of the road (wayfarers) from the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them, those for whom charity and zakat are not lawful. Allah (swt) compensated them, in place of that, with the fifth (khums), so he gives it to them according to the measure of their sufficiency. If anything remains after their needs have been met, then it belongs to him. And if it falls short for them and does not suffice them, he completes it for them from himself. Just as the surplus belongs to him, likewise the shortfall becomes binding upon him.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا رَفَعَ اَلْحَدِيثَ قَالَ:» اَلْخُمُسُ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَشْيَاءَ مِنَ اَلْكُنُوزِ وَاَلْمَعَادِنِ وَاَلْغَوْصِ وَاَلْمَغْنَمِ اَلَّذِي يُقَاتَلُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَحْفَظِ اَلْخَامِسَ وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ فَتْحٍ لَمْ يُقَاتَلْ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يُوجَفْ عَلَيْهِ بِ»خَيْلٍ وَ لاٰ رِكٰابٍ« إِلاَّ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا يَأْتُونَهُ فَيُعَامِلُونَ عَلَيْهِ فَكَيْفَ مَا عَامَلَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَلنِّصْفُ أَوِ اَلثُّلُثُ أَوِ اَلرُّبُعُ أَوْ مَا كَانَ يُسْهَمُ لَهُ خَاصَّةً وَ لَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ إِلاَّ مَا أَعْطَاهُ هُوَ مِنْهُ وَ بُطُونُ اَلْأَوْدِيَةِ وَ رُءُوسُ اَلْجِبَالِ وَ اَلْمَوَاتُ كُلُّهَا هِيَ لَهُ وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى» يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ اَلْأَنْفٰالِ« أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُمْ مِنْهُ قَالَ» قُلِ اَلْأَنْفٰالُ لِلّٰهِ وَ اَلرَّسُولِ« وَ لَيْسَ هُوَ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ اَلْأَنْفَالِ وَ مَا كَانَ مِنَ اَلْقُرَى وَمِيرَاثُ مَنْ لاَ وَارِثَ لَهُ فَهُوَ لَهُ خَاصَّةً وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ »مٰا أَفٰاءَ اللهَُ عَلىٰ رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلْقُرىٰ« فَأَمَّا اَلْخُمُسُ فَيُقْسَمُ عَلَى سِتَّةِ أَسْهُمٍ سَهْمٌ لِلَّهِ وَ سَهْمٌ لِلرَّسُولِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَ سَهْمٌ لِذِي اَلْقُرْبَى وَ سَهْمٌ لِلْيَتَامَى وَ سَهْمٌ لِلْمَسَاكِينِ وَ سَهْمٌ لِأَبْنَاءِ اَلسَّبِيلِ فَالَّذِي لِلَّهِ وَ لِرَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَرَسُولُ اَللَّهِ أَحَقُّ بِهِ فَهُوَ لَهُ خَاصَّةً وَ اَلَّذِي لِلرَّسُولِ هُوَ لِذِي اَلْقُرْبَى وَ اَلْحُجَّةِ فِي زَمَانِهِ فَالنِّصْفُ لَهُ خَاصَّةً وَ اَلنِّصْفُ لِلْيَتَامَى وَ اَلْمَسَاكِينِ وَ أَبْنَاءِ اَلسَّبِيلِ مِنْ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلَّذِينَ لاَ تَحِلُّ لَهُمُ اَلصَّدَقَةُ وَلاَ اَلزَّكَاةُ عَوَّضَهُمُ اَللَّهُ مَكَانَ ذَلِكَ بِالْخُمُسِ فَهُوَ يُعْطِيهِمْ عَلَى قَدْرِ كِفَايَتِهِمْ فَإِنْ فَضَلَ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ فَهُوَ لَهُ وَ إِنْ نَقَصَ عَنْهُمْ وَ لَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَتَمَّهُ لَهُمْ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ كَمَا صَارَ لَهُ اَلْفَضْلُ كَذَلِكَ يَلْزَمُهُ اَلنُّقْصَانُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Some of our companions narrated to us, raising the hadith, saying: “The fifth (khums) is taken from five things: treasures (kunuz), minerals (ma‘adin), diving (ghaws), the booty (maghnam) over which fighting takes place, and he did not remember the fifth (category). And whatever comes from a conquest over which fighting did not take place, and against which neither horses nor riding camels were driven forward, except that our companions come to him and make a transaction with him concerning it, then whatever he makes a transaction with them upon, whether half, or a third, or a quarter, or whatever share is assigned specifically to him, then no one has any right in it except what he gives from it. And the depths of valleys, the tops of mountains, and every dead land, they belong to him. And this is the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted: ‘They ask you concerning the spoils (al-anfal),’ meaning that you should give them from it. (Surah Al-Anfal 8:1) He said: ‘Say: The spoils (al-anfal) belong to Allah (swt) and the Messenger (saws).’ And it is not: ‘They ask you about the spoils (al-anfal).’ And whatever belongs to the towns, and the inheritance of one who has no heir, then it belongs specifically to him. And this is the saying of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: ‘As for gains granted by Allah (swt) to His Messenger (saws) from the people of (other) lands.’ (Surah Al-Hashr 59:7) As for the fifth (khums), it is divided into six shares: (Surah Al-Anfal 8:41) A share for Allah (swt), A share for the Messenger (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, A share for the near relative, A share for the orphans, A share for the needy, And a share for the sons of the road (wayfarers). So that which belongs to Allah (swt) and to the Messenger of Allah (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, the Messenger of Allah (saws) has the greatest right to it, and therefore it belongs specifically to him. And that which belongs to the Messenger (saws) belongs to the near relative and the proof (al-hujjah) in his time; therefore, half belongs specifically to him, meaning the Imam (a.s). And the other half is for the orphans, the needy, and the sons of the road (wayfarers) from the family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them, those for whom charity and zakat are not lawful. Allah (swt) compensated them, in place of that, with the fifth (khums), so he gives it to them according to the measure of their sufficiency. If anything remains after their needs have been met, then it belongs to him. And if it falls short for them and does not suffice them, he completes it for them from himself. Just as the surplus belongs to him, likewise the shortfall becomes binding upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 163

chapter: Chapter on Division of Spoils of War (Ghanaim)
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib'i ibn Abdullah ibn al-Jarud, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “When the war booty (maghnam) came to the Messenger of Allah (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, He (saws) would take its chosen portion, and that belonged to him (saws). Then the Prophet (saws) would divide what remained into five fifths and take one fifth from it. Then the Prophet (saws) would divide the four fifths among the people who had fought over it. Then the Prophet (saws) would divide the khums that he (saws) had taken into five fifths. The Prophet (saws) would take the fifth of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, for himself (saws); then he (saws) would divide the four fifths among the near relatives, the orphans, the needy, and the sons of the road (wayfarers). The Prophet (saws) would give each of them their full share. And likewise, the Imam (a.s) takes as the Messenger of Allah (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, took.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْجَارُودِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إِذَا أَتَاهُ اَلْمَغْنَمُ أَخَذَ صَفْوَهُ وَ كَانَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ ثُمَّ يَقْسِمُ مَا بَقِيَ خَمْسَةَ أَخْمَاسٍ وَ يَأْخُذُ خُمُسَهُ ثُمَّ يَقْسِمُ أَرْبَعَةَ أَخْمَاسٍ بَيْنَ اَلنَّاسِ اَلَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوا عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَسَمَ اَلْخُمُسَ اَلَّذِي أَخَذَهُ خَمْسَةَ أَخْمَاسٍ يَأْخُذُ خُمُسَ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لِنَفْسِهِ ثُمَّ يَقْسِمُ اَلْأَرْبَعَةَ اَلْأَخْمَاسَ بَيْنَ ذَوِي اَلْقُرْبَى وَ اَلْيَتَامَى وَ اَلْمَسَاكِينِ وَ أَبْنَاءِ اَلسَّبِيلِ يُعْطِي كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ جَمِيعاً وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلْإِمَامُ يَأْخُذُ كَمَا أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib'i ibn Abdullah ibn al-Jarud, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:

Then the Prophet (saws) would divide what remained into five fifths and take one fifth from it. Then the Prophet (saws) would divide the four fifths among the people who had fought over it. Then the Prophet (saws) would divide the khums that he (saws) had taken into five fifths. The Prophet (saws) would take the fifth of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, for himself (saws); then he (saws) would divide the four fifths among the near relatives, the orphans, the needy, and the sons of the road (wayfarers). The Prophet (saws) would give each of them their full share. And likewise, the Imam (a.s) takes as the Messenger of Allah (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, took.”
