chapter: Chapter on Obligation of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Fadl ibn Muhammad al-Umawi, from Ribi ibn Abdullah ibn al-Jarud, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said, ‘Allah (swt), the Majestic, has said, ‘Fasting is for Me (swt), and I (swt) reward for it.’”

And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ubayd, from Abdullah ibn Musa, who said: Nasr ibn Ali narrated to us, from al-Nadr ibn Sinan, from Abu Salamah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from his father, who said:

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ubayd ibn Utbah, from al-Fadl ibn Dukayn Abu Nuaym, who said: Abd al-Salam ibn Harb narrated to us, from Ayyub al-Sijistani, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: “The month of Ramadan has come to you, a blessed month, a month in which the almighty Allah (swt) has made fasting obligatory upon you. In it the gates of the Gardens are opened, and in it the devils are shackled. In it is ‘the Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.’ (Surah Al-Qadr 97:3) Whoever is deprived of it (Night of Decree) has indeed been deprived.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ دُكَيْنٍ أَبِي نُعَيْمٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اَلسَّلاَمِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ اَلسِّجِسْتَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:» قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ شَهْرٌ مُبَارَكٌ شَهْرٌ فَرَضَ اَللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ صِيَامَهُ تُفَتَّحُ فِيهِ أَبْوَابُ اَلْجِنَانِ وَتُغَلُّ فِيهِ اَلشَّيَاطِينُ فِيهِ» لَيْلَةُ اَلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ« مَنْ حُرِمَهَا فَقَدْ حُرِمَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ubayd ibn Utbah, from al-Fadl ibn Dukayn Abu Nuaym, who said: Abd al-Salam ibn Harb narrated to us, from Ayyub al-Sijistani, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said:

chapter: Chapter on Obligation of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Amr ibn Uthman, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu al-Ward, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, delivered a sermon on the last Friday of the month of Shaban. The Prophet (saws) praised Allah (swt) and extolled Him (swt), then said: ‘O people, indeed a month has now cast its shade over you, in which there is a night ‘better than a thousand months’, it is the month of Ramadan. (Surah Al-Qadr 97:3) Allah (swt), the majestic, has made its fasting obligatory, and Allah (swt) has made the standing of one night in it voluntarily like the voluntary prayer of seventy nights in other months besides it. And Allah (swt) has made for whoever performs in it voluntarily one trait from the traits of good and righteousness the like of the reward of one who has performed an obligation from the obligations of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic. And whoever performs in it an obligation from the obligations of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, is like one who has performed seventy obligations from the obligations of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, in other months besides it. And it is the month of patience, and indeed the reward of patience is Paradise. And it is the month of mutual support. And it is a month in which Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, increases the provision of the believer. And whoever gives a believer food with which to break his fast in it, there will be for him, by that, with Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, the freeing of a neck, and forgiveness for his sins that have passed.’” It was said to the Prophet (saws): “O Messenger of Allah (swt), not all of us are able to give a fasting person food with which to break his fast in it.” So the Prophet (saws) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, is Generous. Allah (swt) gives this reward to one who is not able except to give a fasting person a small amount of milk (madhqah), or a drink of fresh water, or some dates, and is not able to give more than that. And whoever lightens the burden of his owned servant in it, Allah (swt) will lighten his reckoning for him. And you have no independence in it from four traits: two traits by which you please Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, and two traits from which you have no independence. صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي آخِرِ جُمُعَةٍ مِنْ شَهْرِ شَعْبَانَ فَحَمِدَ اَللَّهَ وَ أَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ» أَيُّهَا اَلنَّاسُ إِنَّهُ قَدْ أَظَلَّكُمْ شَهْرٌ فِيهِ لَيْلَةٌ» خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ« شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ فَرَضَ اَللَّهُ صِيَامَهُ وَ جَعَلَ قِيَامَ لَيْلَةٍ فِيهِ بِتَطَوُّعٍ كَتَطَوُّعِ صَلاَةِ سَبْعِينَ لَيْلَةً فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ اَلشُّهُورِ وَ جَعَلَ لِمَنْ يَتَطَوَّعُ فِيهِ بِخَصْلَةٍ مِنْ خِصَالِ اَلْخَيْرِ وَ اَلْبِرِّ كَأَجْرِ مَنْ أَدَّى فَرِيضَةً مِنْ فَرَائِضِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَ مَنْ أَدَّى فِيهِ فَرِيضَةً مِنْ فَرَائِضِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ كَمَنْ أَدَّى سَبْعِينَ فَرِيضَةً مِنْ فَرَائِضِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ اَلشُّهُورِ وَ هُوَ شَهْرُ اَلصَّبْرِ وَ إِنَّ اَلصَّبْرَ ثَوَابُهُ اَلْجَنَّةُ وَ هُوَ شَهْرُ اَلْمُوَاسَاةِ وَ هُوَ شَهْرٌ يَزِيدُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِيهِ فِي رِزْقِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِ وَ مَنْ فَطَّرَ فِيهِ مُؤْمِناً كَانَ لَهُ بِذَلِكَ عِنْدَ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ وَ مَغْفِرَةٌ لِذُنُوبِهِ فِيمَا مَضَى« قِيلَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ لَيْسَ كُلُّنَا نَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ نُفَطِّرَ فِيهِ صَائِماً فَقَالَ» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ كَرِيمٌ يُعْطِي هَذَا اَلثَّوَابَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ إِلاَّ عَلَى مَذْقَةٍ مِنْ لَبَنٍ يُعْطِيهَا صَائِماً أَوْ شَرْبَةٍ مِنْ مَاءِ عَذْبٍ أَوْ تَمَرَاتٍ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَ مَنْ خَفَّفَ فِيهِ عَنْ مَمْلُوكِهِ خَفَّفَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُ حِسَابَهُ وَ هُوَ شَهْرٌ أَوَّلُهُ رَحْمَةٌ وَوَسَطُهُ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَ آخِرُهُ إِجَابَةٌ وَ اَلْعِتْقُ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ وَ لاَ غِنَى بِكُمْ فِيهِ عَنْ أَرْبَعِ خِصَالٍ خَصْلَتَيْنِ تُرْضُونَ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِهِمَا وَ خَصْلَتَيْنِ لاَ غِنَى بِكُمْ عَنْهُمَا فَأَمَّا اَللَّتَانِ تُرْضُونَ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِهِمَا فَشَهَادَةُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ وَأَمَّا اَللَّتَانِ لاَ غِنَى بِكُمْ عَنْهُمَا فَتَسْأَلُونَ اَللَّهَ فِيهِ حَوَائِجَكُمْ وَاَلْجَنَّةَ وَتَسْأَلُونَ اَللَّهَ اَلْعَافِيَةَ وَتَعُوذُونَ بِهِ مِنَ اَلنَّارِ««.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Amr ibn Uthman, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu al-Ward, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:

And it is the month of patience, and indeed the reward of patience is Paradise. And it is the month of mutual support. And whoever gives a believer food with which to break his fast in it, there will be for him, by that, with Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, the freeing of a neck, and forgiveness for his sins that have passed.’” It was said to the Prophet (saws): “O Messenger of Allah (swt), not all of us are able to give a fasting person food with which to break his fast in it.” So the Prophet (saws) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, is Generous. chapter: Chapter on Obligation of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Asamm, from Thalabah ibn Maymun, from Mammar ibn Yahya, that he heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying:
Imam (a.s) said: “Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, does not ask a servant about a prayer after the obligatory prayer, nor about charity after zakat, nor about fasting after the month of Ramadan.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْأَصَمِّ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: »لاَ يَسْأَلُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَبْداً عَنْ صَلاَةٍ بَعْدَ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ وَ لاَ عَنْ صَدَقَةٍ بَعْدَ اَلزَّكَاةِ وَ لاَ عَنْ صَوْمٍ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Asamm, from Thalabah ibn Maymun, from Mammar ibn Yahya, that he heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, does not ask a servant about a prayer after the obligatory prayer, nor about charity after zakat, nor about fasting after the month of Ramadan.”

chapter: Chapter on Obligation of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Sabih, from al-Husayn ibn Ulwan, from Abdullah ibn al-Hasan, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: “The month of Ramadan abrogated every fast, and sacrifice (al-nahr) abrogated every slaughtered offering, and zakat abrogated every charity, and the ritual bath of janabah abrogated every ritual bath.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ صَبِيحٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُلْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:» شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ نَسَخَ كُلَّ صَوْمٍ وَاَلنَّحْرُ نَسَخَ كُلَّ ذَبِيحَةٍ وَاَلزَّكَاةُ نَسَخَتْ كُلَّ صَدَقَةٍ وَغُسْلُ اَلْجَنَابَةِ نَسَخَ كُلَّ غُسْلٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Sabih, from al-Husayn ibn Ulwan, from Abdullah ibn al-Hasan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: “The month of Ramadan abrogated every fast, and sacrifice (al-nahr) abrogated every slaughtered offering, and zakat abrogated every charity, and the ritual bath of janabah abrogated every ritual bath.”

chapter: Chapter on Obligation of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Rabi al-Aqra, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam (a.s) saying: “Allah (swt) has not burdened the servants beyond what they are able to bear.” Then Imam (a.s) mentioned the obligations and said: “Allah (swt) only burdened them with fasting one month of the year, while they are able to bear more than that.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلرَّبِيعِ اَلْأَقْرَعِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» مَا كَلَّفَ اَللَّهُ اَلْعِبَادَ فَوْقَ مَا يُطِيقُونَ« فَذَكَرَ اَلْفَرَائِضَ وَ قَالَ» إِنَّمَا كَلَّفَهُمْ صِيَامَ شَهْرٍ مِنَ اَلسَّنَةِ وَ هُمْ يُطِيقُونَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Rabi al-Aqra, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam (a.s) saying: “Allah (swt) has not burdened the servants beyond what they are able to bear.” Then Imam (a.s) mentioned the obligations and said: “Allah (swt) only burdened them with fasting one month of the year, while they are able to bear more than that.”

chapter: Chapter on Obligation of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Safwan, from al-Qasim ibn al-Fudayl, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever performs the five prayers, fasts the month of Ramadan, performs Hajj to the Sacred House, observes our rites (nusukana), and is guided to us, Allah (swt) accepts from him just as He (swt) accepts from the angels.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» مَنْ صَلَّى اَلْخَمْسَ وَ صَامَ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَ حَجَّ اَلْبَيْتَ اَلْحَرَامَ وَ نَسَكَ نُسُكَنَا وَاِهْتَدَى إِلَيْنَا قَبِلَ اَللَّهُ مِنْهُ كَمَا يَقْبَلُ مِنَ اَلْمَلاَئِكَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Safwan, from al-Qasim ibn al-Fudayl, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever performs the five prayers, fasts the month of Ramadan, performs Hajj to the Sacred House, observes our rites (nusukana), and is guided to us, Allah (swt) accepts from him just as He (swt) accepts from the angels.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 208

chapter: Chapter on Obligation of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Mammar ibn Yahya, who said:
I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Allah (swt) does not ask a servant about a prayer after the five (daily prayers), nor about a fast after (month of) Ramadan.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: »لاَ يَسْأَلُ اَللَّهُ عَبْداً عَنْ صَلاَةٍ بَعْدَ اَلْخَمْسِ وَ لاَ عَنْ صَوْمٍ بَعْدَ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Mammar ibn Yahya, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Allah (swt) does not ask a servant about a prayer after the five (daily prayers), nor about a fast after (month of) Ramadan.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Among them is what Abu Ghalib al-Zurari narrated. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad informed us, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, meaning Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said:
The Imams (a.s) said: “The month of Ramadan is affected by what affects the months of deficiency (in days). So when you have fasted twenty-nine days, then the sky becomes cloudy, complete the number as thirty (days).”
arabicText: فَمِنْهَا مَا رَوَاهُ أَبُو غَالِبٍ اَلزُّرَارِيُّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ عَلاَءٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا يَعْنِي أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ وَأَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ يُصِيبُهُ مَا يُصِيبُ اَلشُّهُورَ مِنَ اَلنُّقْصَانِ فَإِذَا صُمْتَ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً ثُمَّ تَغَيَّمَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ فَأَتِمَّ اَلْعِدَّةَ ثَلاَثِينَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Among them is what Abu Ghalib al-Zurari narrated. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad informed us, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, meaning Abu Ja’far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, said:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imams (a.s) said: “The month of Ramadan is affected by what affects the months of deficiency (in days). So when you have fasted twenty-nine days, then the sky becomes cloudy, complete the number as thirty (days).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 209

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Amr ibn Uthman, from al-Mufaddal, and from Zayd al-Shahham:
All (companions) together narrated from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘the crescents.’ Imam (a.s) said: “They are the crescents of the months. So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” I (narrator) asked: “What do you think, if the month is twenty-nine days, should I make up that day?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless upright witnesses testify for you (for the moon sighting). So if they testify that they saw the crescent before that, then make up that day.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْمُفَضَّلِ وَ عَنْ زَيْدٍ اَلشَّحَّامِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْأَهِلَّةِ فَقَالَ» هِيَ أَهِلَّةُ اَلشُّهُورِ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ اَلْهِلاَلَ فَصُمْ وَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُ فَأَفْطِرْ« قُلْتُ أَ رَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ اَلشَّهْرُ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً أَقْضِي ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ فَقَالَ» لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ لَكَ بَيِّنَةٌ عُدُولٌ فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا أَنَّهُمْ رَأَوُا اَلْهِلاَلَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَاقْضِ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Amr ibn Uthman, from al-Mufaddal, and from Zayd al-Shahham:
thaqalaynMatn: All (companions) together narrated from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘the crescents.’ Imam (a.s) said: “They are the crescents of the months. So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” I (narrator) asked: “What do you think, if the month is twenty-nine days, should I make up that day?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless upright witnesses testify for you (for the moon sighting). So if they testify that they saw the crescent before that, then make up that day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 210

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from al-Qasim ibn Urwah, from Abu al-Abbas, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting is by sighting (the moon), and breaking the fast is by sighting (the moon). And sighting is not that one person sees it, nor two, nor fifty.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلصَّوْمُ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ وَ اَلْفِطْرُ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ وَ لَيْسَ اَلرُّؤْيَةُ أَنْ يَرَاهُ وَاحِدٌ وَ لاَ اِثْنَانِ وَ لاَ خَمْسُونَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan, from al-Qasim ibn Urwah, from Abu al-Abbas, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting is by sighting (the moon), and breaking the fast is by sighting (the moon). And sighting is not that one person sees it, nor two, nor fifty.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 210

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: And from him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said: “The fasting of the month of Ramadan is by sighting (the moon), and not by assumption. And the month of Ramadan may be twenty-nine, and it may be thirty, and it is affected by what affects the months of completion and deficiency.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ:» صِيَامُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِالرُّؤْيَةِ وَ لَيْسَ بِالظَّنِّ وَقَدْ يَكُونُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ وَ يَكُونُ ثَلاَثِينَ وَ يُصِيبُهُ مَا يُصِيبُ اَلشُّهُورَ مِنَ اَلتَّمَامِ وَ اَلنُّقْصَانِ«.
thaqalaynMatn: And from him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said: “The fasting of the month of Ramadan is by sighting (the moon), and not by assumption. And the month of Ramadan may be twenty-nine, and it may be thirty, and it is affected by what affects the months of completion and deficiency.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 210

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “When you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast. It is not by opinion, nor by conjecture, but by sighting. And sighting is not that ten people stand and look, then one says, ‘Here it is,’ while nine look and do not see it. If one sees it, ten and a thousand see it. And if there is an obstruction, then complete Shaban as thirty (days).” And Hammad added in this narration: “And it is not that a man says, ‘Here it is.’ I do not know except that he (Imam (a.s)) said, ‘nor fifty.’”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ اَلْهِلاَلَ فَصُومُوا وَ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُ فَأَفْطِرُوا وَ لَيْسَ بِالرَّأْيِ وَ لاَ بِالتَّظَنِّي وَلَكِنْ بِالرُّؤْيَةِ وَ اَلرُّؤْيَةُ لَيْسَ أَنْ يَقُومَ عَشَرَةٌ فَيَنْظُرُوا فَيَقُولَ وَاحِدٌ هُوَ ذَا هُوَ وَ يَنْظُرُ تِسْعَةٌ فَلاَ يَرَوْنَهُ إِذَا رَآهُ وَاحِدٌ رَآهُ عَشَرَةٌ وَ أَلْفٌ وَ إِذَا كَانَتْ عِلَّةٌ فَأَتِمَّ شَعْبَانَ ثَلاَثِينَ« وَ زَادَ حَمَّادٌ فِيهِ» وَ لَيْسَ أَنْ يَقُولَ رَجُلٌ هُوَ ذَا هُوَ لاَ أَعْلَمُ إِلاَّ قَالَ وَ لاَ خَمْسُونَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast. It is not by opinion, nor by conjecture, but by sighting. And sighting is not that ten people stand and look, then one says, ‘Here it is,’ while nine look and do not see it. If one sees it, ten and a thousand see it. And if there is an obstruction, then complete Shaban as thirty (days).” And Hammad added in this narration: “And it is not that a man says, ‘Here it is.’ I do not know except that he (Imam (a.s)) said, ‘nor fifty.’”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi:
All together, they narrate from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘the crescent moons (ahilla).’ Imam (a.s) said: “They are the crescent moons of the months. So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” I (narrator) asked: “What do you think if the month was twenty-nine days; should I make up that day?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless just witnesses testify for you. So if they testify that they saw the crescent before that, then make up that day.”
arabicText: الحسين بن سعيد عن محمد بن الفضيل عن ابي الصباح عن ابن مسكان عن الحلبي جميعا عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام انه سئل عن الاهلة فقال: هي اهلة الشهور فإذا رأيت الهلال فصم وإذا رأيته فافطر، قلت أرأيت إن كان الشهر تسعة وعشرين يوما اقضي ذلك اليوم؟ فقال: لا إلا ان تشهد لك بينة عدول فان شهدوا أنهم رأوا الهلال قبل ذلك فاقض ذلك اليوم
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: All together, they narrate from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘the crescent moons (ahilla).’ Imam (a.s) said: “They are the crescent moons of the months. So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” I (narrator) asked: “What do you think if the month was twenty-nine days; should I make up that day?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless just witnesses testify for you. So if they testify that they saw the crescent before that, then make up that day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 211

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad al-Ashari Abu Khalid, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The month of Ramadan is affected by what affects the months of increase and deficiency. So if the sky becomes cloudy one day, then complete the number (of the month).”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ يُصِيبُهُ مَا يُصِيبُ اَلشُّهُورَ مِنَ اَلزِّيَادَةِ وَ اَلنُّقْصَانِ فَإِنْ تَغَيَّمَتِ اَلسَّمَاءُ يَوْماً فَأَتِمُّوا اَلْعِدَّةَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad al-Ashari Abu Khalid, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The month of Ramadan is affected by what affects the months of increase and deficiency. So if the sky becomes cloudy one day, then complete the number (of the month).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 211

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Fast upon the sighting of the crescent, and break the fast upon its sighting. So if two approved witnesses testify before you that they saw it, then make it up.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» صُمْ لِرُؤْيَةِ اَلْهِلاَلِ وَ أَفْطِرْ لِرُؤْيَتِهِ فَإِنْ شَهِدَ عِنْدَكُمْ شَاهِدَانِ مَرْضِيَّانِ بِأَنَّهُمَا رَأَيَاهُ فَاقْضِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Fast upon the sighting of the crescent, and break the fast upon its sighting. So if two approved witnesses testify before you that they saw it, then make it up.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 211

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Safwan, from al-Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the crescent, when all the people see it and agree that it is for two nights, is that permissible?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْهِلاَلِ إِذَا رَآهُ اَلْقَوْمُ جَمِيعاً فَاتَّفَقُوا عَلَى أَنَّهُ لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ أَ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ» نَعَمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Safwan, from al-Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the crescent, when all the people see it and agree that it is for two nights, is that permissible?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 212

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Hammad, from Shuayb, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘the day that is made up from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Do not make it up unless two just witnesses from all the people of prayer establish when the beginning of the month was.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Do not fast that day which is made up unless the people of the cities make it up. So if they do so, then fast it.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي يُقْضَى مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» لاَ تَقْضِهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُثْبِتَ شَاهِدَانِ عَدْلاَنِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ اَلصَّلاَةِ مَتَى كَانَ رَأْسُ اَلشَّهْرِ« وَ قَالَ »لاَ تَصُمْ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ اَلَّذِي يُقْضَى إِلاَّ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ أَهْلُ اَلْأَمْصَارِ فَإِنْ فَعَلُوا فَصُمْهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Hammad, from Shuayb, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘the day that is made up from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Do not make it up unless two just witnesses from all the people of prayer establish when the beginning of the month was.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Do not fast that day which is made up unless the people of the cities make it up. So if they do so, then fast it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 212

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Qasim, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the crescent of (month of) Ramadan, when it is obscured from us on the twenty-ninth of Shaban.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Do not fast unless you see it (the moon). Then if the people of another town testify, then make it up.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ هِلاَلِ رَمَضَانَ يُغَمُّ عَلَيْنَا فِي تِسْعٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَقَالَ» لاَ تَصُمْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنْ شَهِدَ أَهْلُ بَلَدٍ آخَرَ فَاقْضِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Qasim, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the crescent of (month of) Ramadan, when it is obscured from us on the twenty-ninth of Shaban.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Do not fast unless you see it (the moon). Then if the people of another town testify, then make it up.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 212

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘When you see the crescent, then break the fast, or when a just person from the Muslims testifies to it. And if you do not see the crescent except in the middle of the day or at its end, then ‘complete the fast until the night.’ So if it is obscured from you, then count thirty nights, then break the fast.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ :»إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ اَلْهِلاَلَ فَأَفْطِرُوا أَوْ شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِ عَدْلٌ مِنَ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَرَوُا اَلْهِلاَلَ إِلاَّ مِنْ وَسَطِ اَلنَّهَارِ أَوْ آخِرِهِ فَ »أَتِمُّوا اَلصِّيٰامَ إِلَى اَللَّيْلِ« فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ فَعُدُّوا ثَلاَثِينَ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ أَفْطِرُوا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘When you see the crescent, then break the fast, or when a just person from the Muslims testifies to it. And if you do not see the crescent except in the middle of the day or at its end, then ‘complete the fast until the night.’ So if it is obscured from you, then count thirty nights, then break the fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 212

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Sayf ibn Amirah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said in the Book of Ali (a.s), peace be upon him: “Fast upon its sighting, and break the fast upon its sighting, and beware of doubt and assumption. So if it is hidden from you, then complete the first month as thirty.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» صُمْ لِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَأَفْطِرْ لِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَإِيَّاكَ وَاَلشَّكَّ وَاَلظَّنَّ فَإِنْ خَفِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَتِمُّوا اَلشَّهْرَ اَلْأَوَّلَ ثَلاَثِينَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Sayf ibn Amirah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said in the Book of Ali (a.s), peace be upon him: “Fast upon its sighting, and break the fast upon its sighting, and beware of doubt and assumption. So if it is hidden from you, then complete the first month as thirty.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 213

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Sayf ibn Amirah, from al-Fudayl ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon the people of the qiblah except sighting (of the moon). There is nothing upon the Muslims except sighting (of the moon).”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» لَيْسَ عَلَى أَهْلِ اَلْقِبْلَةِ إِلاَّ اَلرُّؤْيَةُ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلاَّ اَلرُّؤْيَةُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Sayf ibn Amirah, from al-Fudayl ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon the people of the qiblah except sighting (of the moon). There is nothing upon the Muslims except sighting (of the moon).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 213

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
The Imam (a.s) was asked regarding ‘one who fasted twenty-nine (days).’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he has just evidence concerning the people of a city that they fasted thirty based on a sighting, he makes up one day.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِيمَنْ صَامَ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ قَالَ» إِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ بَيِّنَةٌ عَادِلَةٌ عَلَى أَهْلِ مِصْرٍ أَنَّهُمْ صَامُوا ثَلاَثِينَ عَلَى رُؤْيَةٍ قَضَى يَوْماً«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imam (a.s) was asked regarding ‘one who fasted twenty-nine (days).’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he has just evidence concerning the people of a city that they fasted thirty based on a sighting, he makes up one day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 213

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from a man whose name Hammad ibn Isa had forgotten, who said:
“Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, fasted in Kufa for twenty-eight days of the month of Ramadan, then they saw the crescent. Imam Ali (a.s) ordered a caller to call out: ‘Make up one day, for the month is twenty-nine days.’”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ حَمَّادُ بْنُ عِيسَى اِسْمَهُ قَالَ: صَامَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِالْكُوفَةِ ثَمَانِيَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فَرَأَوُا اَلْهِلاَلَ فَأَمَرَ مُنَادِياً أَنْ يُنَادِيَ» اِقْضُوا يَوْماً فَإِنَّ اَلشَّهْرَ تِسْعَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ يَوْماً«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from a man whose name Hammad ibn Isa had forgotten, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, fasted in Kufa for twenty-eight days of the month of Ramadan, then they saw the crescent. Imam Ali (a.s) ordered a caller to call out: ‘Make up one day, for the month is twenty-nine days.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 214

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, who said:
I (narrator) wrote to Imam (a.s) while I was in Madinah about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt from the month of Ramadan, should it be fasted or not?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “Certainty is not entered into by doubt. Fast upon sighting (the moon), and break the fast upon sighting (the moon).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْقَاسَانِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ وَ أَنَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ عَنِ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ هَلْ يُصَامُ أَمْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» اَلْيَقِينُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ فِيهِ اَلشَّكُّ صُمْ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ وَ أَفْطِرْ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) wrote to Imam (a.s) while I was in Madinah about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt from the month of Ramadan, should it be fasted or not?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “Certainty is not entered into by doubt. Fast upon sighting (the moon), and break the fast upon sighting (the moon).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 214

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said:
Abu Amr wrote to Imam (a.s): “Inform me, my master, for sometimes the crescent of the month of Ramadan becomes unclear to us, so we do not see it, while we see that there is no obstruction in the sky. Then the people break the fast, and we break the fast with them. And some people from the calculators (al-hussab) before us say that it is seen on that very night in Egypt, Africa, and Andalus. So is what the calculators have said in this matter permissible, my master, such that the obligation differs upon the people of the cities, so that their fasting is contrary to our fasting and their breaking of the fast is contrary to our breaking of the fast?” So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “Do not fast (when in) doubt at all. Break the fast upon its sighting (of the moon), and fast upon its sighting (of the moon).”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ أَبُو عَمْرٍو أَخْبِرْنِي يَا مَوْلاَيَ أَنَّهُ رُبَّمَا أَشْكَلَ عَلَيْنَا هِلاَلُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلاَ نَرَاهُ وَ نَرَى اَلسَّمَاءَ لَيْسَتْ فِيهَا عِلَّةٌ فَيُفْطِرُ اَلنَّاسُ وَ نُفْطِرُ مَعَهُمْ وَ يَقُولُ قَوْمٌ مِنَ اَلْحُسَّابِ قِبَلَنَا إِنَّهُ يُرَى فِي تِلْكَ اَللَّيْلَةِ بِعَيْنِهَا بِمِصْرَ وَ إِفْرِيقِيَةَ وَ اَلْأُنْدُلُسِ فَهَلْ يَجُوزُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ مَا قَالَ اَلْحُسَّابُ فِي هَذَا اَلْبَابِ حَتَّى يَخْتَلِفَ اَلْفَرْضُ عَلَى أَهْلِ اَلْأَمْصَارِ فَيَكُونَ صَوْمُهُمْ خِلاَفَ صَوْمِنَا وَفِطْرُهُمْ خِلاَفَ فِطْرِنَا فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ تَصُومَنَّ اَلشَّكَّ أَفْطِرْ لِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَ صُمْ لِرُؤْيَتِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Amr wrote to Imam (a.s): “Inform me, my master, for sometimes the crescent of the month of Ramadan becomes unclear to us, so we do not see it, while we see that there is no obstruction in the sky. Then the people break the fast, and we break the fast with them. And some people from the calculators (al-hussab) before us say that it is seen on that very night in Egypt, Africa, and Andalus. So is what the calculators have said in this matter permissible, my master, such that the obligation differs upon the people of the cities, so that their fasting is contrary to our fasting and their breaking of the fast is contrary to our breaking of the fast?” So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “Do not fast (when in) doubt at all. Break the fast upon its sighting (of the moon), and fast upon its sighting (of the moon).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 214

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Bakr, from Hafs, from Umar ibn Salim and Muhammad ibn Ziyad ibn Isa, from Harun ibn Kharijah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Count Shaban as twenty-nine days. Then if it is cloudy, enter the morning fasting, and if it is clear and you looked carefully and did not see anything (of the moon), then enter the morning not fasting.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَالِمٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» عُدَّ شَعْبَانَ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً فَإِنْ كَانَتْ مُتَغَيِّمَةً فَأَصْبِحْ صَائِماً وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُصْحِيَةً وَتَبَصَّرْتَ وَ لَمْ تَرَ شَيْئاً فَأَصْبِحْ مُفْطِراً«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Bakr, from Hafs, from Umar ibn Salim and Muhammad ibn Ziyad ibn Isa, from Harun ibn Kharijah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Count Shaban as twenty-nine days. Then if it is cloudy, enter the morning fasting, and if it is clear and you looked carefully and did not see anything (of the moon), then enter the morning not fasting.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 214

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Habib al-Khuzai, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Testimony concerning the sighting of the crescent is not accepted with fewer than fifty men, the number required for qasamah. The testimony of two men is only accepted when they are from outside the city, while there is an obstruction in the city, and they report that they both saw it, and that they know of a people who fasted based on the sighting.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ حَبِيبٍ اَلْخُزَاعِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» لاَ تَجُوزُ اَلشَّهَادَةُ فِي رُؤْيَةِ اَلْهِلاَلِ دُونَ خَمْسِينَ رَجُلاً عَدَدِ اَلْقَسَامَةِ وَ إِنَّمَا تَجُوزُ شَهَادَةُ رَجُلَيْنِ إِذَا كَانَا مِنْ خَارِجِ اَلْمِصْرِ وَ كَانَ بِالْمِصْرِ عِلَّةٌ فَأَخْبَرَا أَنَّهُمَا رَأَيَاهُ وَ أَخْبَرَا عَنْ قَوْمٍ صَامُوا لِلرُّؤْيَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Habib al-Khuzai, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Testimony concerning the sighting of the crescent is not accepted with fewer than fifty men, the number required for qasamah. The testimony of two men is only accepted when they are from outside the city, while there is an obstruction in the city, and they report that they both saw it, and that they know of a people who fasted based on the sighting.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 215

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Shar, from Harun ibn Hamzah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “When you fast upon the sighting of the crescent and break the fast upon its sighting, then you have completed the fasting of a month, even if you have not fasted except twenty-nine days. For the Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘The month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers),’” And then Imam (a.s) pointed with his hand to ten (fingers) , and ten (fingers), and nine (fingers, but lowering down his thumb).”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» إِذَا صُمْتَ لِرُؤْيَةِ اَلْهِلاَلِ وَ أَفْطَرْتَ لِرُؤْيَتِهِ فَقَدْ أَكْمَلْتَ صِيَامَ شَهْرٍ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَصُمْ إِلاَّ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ قَالَ» اَلشَّهْرُ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا« وَ أَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى عَشَرَةٍ وَ عَشَرَةٍ وَ تِسْعَةٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Shar, from Harun ibn Hamzah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “When you fast upon the sighting of the crescent and break the fast upon its sighting, then you have completed the fasting of a month, even if you have not fasted except twenty-nine days. For the Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘The month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers),’” And then Imam (a.s) pointed with his hand to ten (fingers) , and ten (fingers), and nine (fingers, but lowering down his thumb).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 215

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Yunus ibn Yaqub:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I fasted the month of Ramadan upon a sighting for twenty-nine days, and I did not make it up.” He (narrator) said: “So I asked: ‘And I have fasted it and did not make it up.’” Then Imam (a.s) said to me: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘The months are a month like ‘this’ and like ‘this’, and a month like ‘this’ and like ‘this’.’” – meaning the Imam (a.s) pointed with his hand to ten, and ten, and nine.
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي صُمْتُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ عَلَى رُؤْيَةٍ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً وَ مَا قَضَيْتُ قَالَ فَقَالَ» وَ أَنَا قَدْ صُمْتُهُ وَ مَا قَضَيْتُ« ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي» قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» اَلشُّهُورُ شَهْرٌ كَذَا وَ كَذَا وَ شَهْرٌ كَذَا وَ كَذَا««.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Yunus ibn Yaqub:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I fasted the month of Ramadan upon a sighting for twenty-nine days, and I did not make it up.” He (narrator) said: “So I asked: ‘And I have fasted it and did not make it up.’” Then Imam (a.s) said to me: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘The months are a month like ‘this’ and like ‘this’, and a month like ‘this’ and like ‘this’.’” – meaning the Imam (a.s) pointed with his hand to ten, and ten, and nine.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 216

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sad, from al-Abbas ibn Musa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman al-Khazzaz, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam (a.s): “How much suffices regarding the sighting of the crescent?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed the month of Ramadan is an obligation from the obligations of Allah (swt), so do not perform it by conjecture. And the sighting of the crescent is not that a group stands, then one says, ‘I have seen it,’ while the others say, ‘We did not see it.’ When one sees it, one hundred see it, and when one hundred see it, one thousand see it. And regarding the sighting of the crescent, when there is no obstruction in the sky, less than the testimony of fifty does not suffice. And when there is an obstruction in the sky, the testimony of two men who enter and leave a city is accepted.”
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ كَمْ يُجْزِي فِي رُؤْيَةِ اَلْهِلاَلِ فَقَالَ» إِنَّ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فَرِيضَةٌ مِنْ فَرَائِضِ اَللَّهِ فَلاَ تُؤَدُّوا بِالتَّظَنِّي وَ لَيْسَ رُؤْيَةُ اَلْهِلاَلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ عِدَّةٌ فَيَقُولَ وَاحِدٌ قَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ وَ يَقُولَ اَلْآخَرُونَ لَمْ نَرَهُ إِذَا رَآهُ وَاحِدٌ رَآهُ مِائَةٌ وَإِذَا رَآهُ مِائَةٌ رَآهُ أَلْفٌ وَلاَ يُجْزِي فِي رُؤْيَةِ اَلْهِلاَلِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي اَلسَّمَاءِ عِلَّةٌ أَقَلُّ مِنْ شَهَادَةِ خَمْسِينَ وَإِذَا كَانَتْ فِي اَلسَّمَاءِ عِلَّةٌ قُبِلَتْ شَهَادَةُ رَجُلَيْنِ يَدْخُلاَنِ وَيَخْرُجَانِ مِنْ مِصْرٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sad, from al-Abbas ibn Musa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman al-Khazzaz, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): “How much suffices regarding the sighting of the crescent?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed the month of Ramadan is an obligation from the obligations of Allah (swt), so do not perform it by conjecture. And the sighting of the crescent is not that a group stands, then one says, ‘I have seen it,’ while the others say, ‘We did not see it.’ When one sees it, one hundred see it, and when one hundred see it, one thousand see it. And regarding the sighting of the crescent, when there is no obstruction in the sky, less than the testimony of fifty does not suffice. And when there is an obstruction in the sky, the testimony of two men who enter and leave a city is accepted.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 216

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
The Imam (a.s) said regarding the month of Ramadan: “It is a month from among the months; what affects the months of deficiency affects it (in the number of days).”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ »هُوَ شَهْرٌ مِنَ اَلشُّهُورِ يُصِيبُهُ مَا يُصِيبُ اَلشُّهُورَ مِنَ اَلنُّقْصَانِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imam (a.s) said regarding the month of Ramadan: “It is a month from among the months; what affects the months of deficiency affects it (in the number of days).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 216

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Yunus ibn Yaqub, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I fasted the month of Ramadan upon a sighting for twenty-nine days, and I did not make it up.” He (narrator) said: “So he said to Imam (a.s): ‘And I fasted it and did not make it up.’” Then Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘The month is a month like ‘this’ (showing fingers twenty nine times),’” And Imam (a.s) indicated with the fingers of both his hands together, so Imam (a.s) spread out his fingers like ‘this’ (ten fingers) and like ‘this’ (ten fingers) and like ‘this’ (ten fingers)” – meaning it totalled to thirty fingers. (Imam (a.s) continued) “And like ‘this’ (ten fingers) and like ‘this’ (ten fingers) and like ‘this’ (nine fingers), then the Imam (a.s) folded the thumb and joined it.” – meaning it totalled to twenty nine fingers, but lowering down his thumb. He (narrator) said: “And a servant of Imam (a.s), who was ‘Muattib’, said to Imam (a.s), ‘I have indeed seen the crescent.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Go and inform them (of the moon sighting).”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ صُمْتُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ عَلَى رُؤْيَةٍ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً وَ مَا قَضَيْتُ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي» وَ أَنَا صُمْتُهُ وَ مَا قَضَيْتُ« قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي» قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» اَلشَّهْرُ شَهْرٌ كَذَا« وَ قَالَ بِأَصَابِعِهِ بِيَدَيْهِ جَمِيعاً فَبَسَطَ أَصَابِعَهُ كَذَا وَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَقَبَضَ اَلْإِبْهَامَ وَضَمَّهَا قَالَ وَقَالَ لَهُ غُلاَمٌ لَهُ وَهُوَ مُعَتِّبٌ إِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُ اَلْهِلاَلَ قَالَ» اِذْهَبْ فَأَعْلِمْهُمْ««.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Yunus ibn Yaqub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I fasted the month of Ramadan upon a sighting for twenty-nine days, and I did not make it up.” He (narrator) said: “So he said to Imam (a.s): ‘And I fasted it and did not make it up.’” Then Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘The month is a month like ‘this’ (showing fingers twenty nine times),’” And Imam (a.s) indicated with the fingers of both his hands together, so Imam (a.s) spread out his fingers like ‘this’ (ten fingers) and like ‘this’ (ten fingers) and like ‘this’ (ten fingers)” – meaning it totalled to thirty fingers. (Imam (a.s) continued) “And like ‘this’ (ten fingers) and like ‘this’ (ten fingers) and like ‘this’ (nine fingers), then the Imam (a.s) folded the thumb and joined it.” – meaning it totalled to twenty nine fingers, but lowering down his thumb. He (narrator) said: “And a servant of Imam (a.s), who was ‘Muattib’, said to Imam (a.s), ‘I have indeed seen the crescent.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Go and inform them (of the moon sighting).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 216

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Hasan ibn Nasr, from his father, from Abu Khalid al-Wasiti, who said:
We (narrators) came to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, on a day concerning which there was doubt whether it was from (month of) Ramadan, and behold, his dining table had been laid out and the Imam (a.s) was eating, while we wanted to ask him. So the Imam (a.s) said: “Bring the lunch near. When there is a day like this day, and evidence of the sighting of the crescent has not come to you in it, then do not fast.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “My father Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon them both, narrated to me from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, that when the Messenger of Allah (swt), became gravely ill, the Prophet (saws) said, ‘O people, indeed the year is twelve months, of which four are sacred.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Then Prophet (saws) said with his hand: ‘So that is Rajab, separate, and Dhu al-Qadah, Dhu al-Hijjah, and Muharram, the three consecutive ones (months). Indeed, this obligatory month is Ramadan, so fast upon its sighting and break the fast upon its sighting. Then when the month is hidden (crescent is not visible), complete the number of Shaban as thirty days, and fast the thirty-first.’” And Imam (a.s) said with his hand: “One, two, and three; one, two, and three,” while folding his thumb. Then the Imam (a.s) said: “‘O people, a month is like ‘this’ (showing fingers thirty times), and a month is like ‘this’ (twenty nine fingers, but lowering down his thumb).’ And Imam Ali (a.s) said: ‘We fasted with the Messenger of Allah (swt), twenty-nine days, and we did not make it up, and He (saws) regarded it as complete.” And Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘Whoever deliberately attaches to (month of) Ramadan a day from other than it is not a believer in Allah (swt) nor in me (saws).’”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ اَلْوَاسِطِيِّ قَالَ: أَتَيْنَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ع فِي يَوْمٍ يُشَكُّ فِيهِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَإِذَا مَائِدَتُهُ مَوْضُوعَةٌ وَ هُوَ يَأْكُلُ وَ نَحْنُ نُرِيدُ أَنْ نَسْأَلَهُ فَقَالَ» اُدْنُوا اَلْغَدَاءَ إِذَا كَانَ مِثْلُ هَذَا اَلْيَوْمِ وَ لَمْ تَجِئْكُمْ فِيهِ بَيِّنَةُ رُؤْيَةِ اَلْهِلاَلِ فَلاَ تَصُومُوا« ثُمَّ قَالَ» حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ ع عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ع »أَ نَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ص لَمَّا ثَقُلَ فِي مَرَضِهِ قَالَ »أَيُّهَا اَلنَّاسُ إِنَّ اَلسَّنَةَ اِثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْراً مِنْهَا أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ« قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ» فَذَاكَ رَجَبٌ مُفْرَدٌ وَ ذُو اَلْقَعْدَةِ وَ ذُو اَلْحِجَّةِ وَ اَلْمُحَرَّمُ ثَلاَثَةٌ مُتَوَالِيَاتٌ أَلاَ وَ هَذَا اَلشَّهْرُ اَلْمَفْرُوضُ رَمَضَانُ فَصُومُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَأَفْطِرُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ فَإِذَا خَفِيَ اَلشَّهْرُ فَأَتِمُّوا اَلْعِدَّةَ شَعْبَانَ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً وَصُومُوا اَلْوَاحِدَ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ« وَ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ» اَلْوَاحِدُ وَ اِثْنَانِ وَ ثَلاَثَةٌ وَاحِدٌ وَ اِثْنَانِ وَ ثَلاَثَةٌ وَيَزْوِي إِبْهَامَهُ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» أَيُّهَا اَلنَّاسُ شَهْرٌ كَذَا وَ شَهْرٌ كَذَا«« وَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ ع» صُمْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ ص تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً وَ لَمْ نَقْضِهِ وَ رَآهُ تَامّاً« وَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ص» مَنْ أَلْحَقَ فِي رَمَضَانَ يَوْماً مِنْ غَيْرِهِ مُتَعَمِّداً فَلَيْسَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ بِاللَّهِ وَ لاَ بِي««.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Hasan ibn Nasr, from his father, from Abu Khalid al-Wasiti, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: We (narrators) came to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, on a day concerning which there was doubt whether it was from (month of) Ramadan, and behold, his dining table had been laid out and the Imam (a.s) was eating, while we wanted to ask him. So the Imam (a.s) said: “Bring the lunch near. When there is a day like this day, and evidence of the sighting of the crescent has not come to you in it, then do not fast.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “My father Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon them both, narrated to me from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, that when the Messenger of Allah (swt), became gravely ill, the Prophet (saws) said, ‘O people, indeed the year is twelve months, of which four are sacred.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Then Prophet (saws) said with his hand: ‘So that is Rajab, separate, and Dhu al-Qadah, Dhu al-Hijjah, and Muharram, the three consecutive ones (months). Indeed, this obligatory month is Ramadan, so fast upon its sighting and break the fast upon its sighting. Then when the month is hidden (crescent is not visible), complete the number of Shaban as thirty days, and fast the thirty-first.’” And Imam (a.s) said with his hand: “One, two, and three; one, two, and three,” while folding his thumb. Then the Imam (a.s) said: “‘O people, a month is like ‘this’ (showing fingers thirty times), and a month is like ‘this’ (twenty nine fingers, but lowering down his thumb).’ And Imam Ali (a.s) said: ‘We fasted with the Messenger of Allah (swt), twenty-nine days, and we did not make it up, and He (saws) regarded it as complete.” And Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), said: ‘Whoever deliberately attaches to (month of) Ramadan a day from other than it is not a believer in Allah (swt) nor in me (saws).’”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the crescent moons (ahilla).’ Imam (a.s) said: “They are the crescent moons of the months. So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘What do you think if the month was twenty-nine days; should I make up that day?’” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless just witnesses testify to that. So if they testify that they saw the crescent before that, then make up that day.”
arabicText: علي بن الحسن بن فضال قال: حدثني محمد بن عبد الله ابن زرارة عن محمد بن ابي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان عن عبد الله بن علي الحلبي عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: سألته عن الاهلة قال: هي أهلة الشهور فإذا رأيت الهلال فصم وإذا رأيته فافطر، قال: قلت أرأيت ان كان الشهر تسعة وعشرين يوما اقضي ذلك اليوم؟ قال: لا إلا ان تشهد بذلك بينة عدول فان شهدوا أنهم رأوا الهلال قبل ذلك فاقض ذلك اليوم
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the crescent moons (ahilla).’ Imam (a.s) said: “They are the crescent moons of the months. So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘What do you think if the month was twenty-nine days; should I make up that day?’” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless just witnesses testify to that. So if they testify that they saw the crescent before that, then make up that day.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Fadl, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Husayn ibn Nasr ibn Muzahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “I do not know that I fasted thirty (days) or more, or that I fasted twenty-nine days. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘A month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and a month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and a month is like ‘this’ (nine fingers),’ counting with his hand twenty-nine days.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ نَصْرِ بْنِ مُزَاحِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» مَا أَدْرِي مَا صُمْتُ ثَلاَثِينَ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ أَوْ مَا صُمْتُ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ قَالَ» شَهْرٌ كَذَا وَ شَهْرٌ كَذَا وَ شَهْرٌ كَذَا« يَعْقِدُ بِيَدِهِ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Fadl, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Husayn ibn Nasr ibn Muzahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “I do not know that I fasted thirty (days) or more, or that I fasted twenty-nine days. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘A month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and a month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and a month is like ‘this’ (nine fingers),’ counting with his hand twenty-nine days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 218

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ghalib al-Zurari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding the day of doubt, whoever fasts it must make it up, even if it is so,” Meaning whoever fasts it on the basis that it is from the month of Ramadan without a sighting must make it up, even if it is a day from the month of Ramadan, because the sunnah has come regarding fasting it on the basis that it is from Shaban, and whoever opposes it, making it up is upon him.
arabicText: أَبُو غَالِبٍ اَلزُّرَارِيُّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» فِي يَوْمِ اَلشَّكِّ مَنْ صَامَهُ قَضَاهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ كَذَلِكَ« يَعْنِي مَنْ صَامَهُ عَلَى أَنَّهُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِغَيْرِ رُؤْيَةٍ قَضَاهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ لِأَنَّ اَلسُّنَّةَ جَاءَتْ فِي صِيَامِهِ عَلَى أَنَّهُ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ وَ مَنْ خَالَفَهَا كَانَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْقَضَاءُ
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ghalib al-Zurari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding the day of doubt, whoever fasts it must make it up, even if it is so,” Meaning whoever fasts it on the basis that it is from the month of Ramadan without a sighting must make it up, even if it is a day from the month of Ramadan, because the sunnah has come regarding fasting it on the basis that it is from Shaban, and whoever opposes it, making it up is upon him.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 218

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi Ghalib, from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Ishaq ibn Jarir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said, ‘Indeed the month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers),” joining his palms together and spreading them out. Then the Prophet (a.s) said: “And like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers),” then the Prophet (saws) folded one finger at the end of the spreading out with his hands, and it was the thumb. So I (narrator) asked: “Is the month of Ramadan always complete, or is it a month from among the months?” Imam (a.s) said: “It is a month from among the months.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, fasted among you for twenty-nine days, then they came to him and said: ‘O Commander of the Faithful, we have seen the crescent.’ Imam Ali (a.s) said: ‘Break the fast.’”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي غَالِبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلطَّاطَرِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ قَالَ:» إِنَّ اَلشَّهْرَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا« يُلْصِقُ كَفَّيْهِ وَيَبْسُطُهُمَا ثُمَّ قَالَ» وَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا« ثُمَّ يَقْبِضُ إِصْبَعاً وَاحِداً فِي آخِرِ بَسْطَةٍ بِيَدَيْهِ وَ هِيَ اَلْإِبْهَامُ« فَقُلْتُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ تَامٌّ أَبَداً أَمْ شَهْرٌ مِنَ اَلشُّهُورِ فَقَالَ» هُوَ شَهْرٌ مِنَ اَلشُّهُورِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» إِنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ صَامَ عِنْدَكُمْ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً فَأَتَوْهُ فَقَالُوا يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَدْ رَأَيْنَا اَلْهِلاَلَ فَقَالَ» أَفْطِرُوا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi Ghalib, from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Ishaq ibn Jarir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said, ‘Indeed the month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers),” joining his palms together and spreading them out. Then the Prophet (a.s) said: “And like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers),” then the Prophet (saws) folded one finger at the end of the spreading out with his hands, and it was the thumb. So I (narrator) asked: “Is the month of Ramadan always complete, or is it a month from among the months?” Imam (a.s) said: “It is a month from among the months.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, fasted among you for twenty-nine days, then they came to him and said: ‘O Commander of the Faithful, we have seen the crescent.’ Imam Ali (a.s) said: ‘Break the fast.’”

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud al-Qummi said: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Fadl informed us, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqub al-Kisai, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:

thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud al-Qummi said: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Fadl informed us, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqub al-Kisai, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:

So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” I (narrator) asked: “If the month is twenty-nine days, should I make up that day?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless just evidence testifies. So if they testify that they saw the crescent before that, then make up that day.”

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud, from Abdullah ibn Ali ibn al-Qasim al-Bazzaz, who said: Jafar ibn Abdullah al-Muhammadi narrated to us, who said: al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, who said: Abu Ahmad Umar ibn al-Rabi al-Basri narrated to us, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘the crescents.’ Imam (a.s) said: “They are the crescents of the months. So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” So I (narrator) asked: “What do you think, if the month is twenty-nine days, should I make up that day?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless just persons testify for you that they saw it. So if they testify, then make up that day.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ اَلْبَزَّازِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْمُحَمَّدِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ عُمَرُ بْنُ اَلرَّبِيعِ اَلْبَصْرِيُّ قَالَ: سُئِلَ اَلصَّادِقُ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْأَهِلَّةِ قَالَ» هِيَ أَهِلَّةُ اَلشُّهُورِ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ اَلْهِلاَلَ فَصُمْ وَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُ فَأَفْطِرْ« فَقُلْتُ أَ رَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ اَلشَّهْرُ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً أَقْضِي ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ قَالَ» لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ لَكَ عُدُولٌ أَنَّهُمْ رَأَوْهُ فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا فَاقْضِ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud, from Abdullah ibn Ali ibn al-Qasim al-Bazzaz, who said: Jafar ibn Abdullah al-Muhammadi narrated to us, who said: al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, who said: Abu Ahmad Umar ibn al-Rabi al-Basri narrated to us, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘the crescents.’ Imam (a.s) said: “They are the crescents of the months. So when you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see it, then break the fast.” So I (narrator) asked: “What do you think, if the month is twenty-nine days, should I make up that day?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, unless just persons testify for you that they saw it. So if they testify, then make up that day.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud said: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Fadl and Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqub informed us, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, who said: Mammar ibn Khallad narrated to me, from Muawiyah ibn Wahb, from Abd al-Hamid al-Azdi, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I may be in the mountain, in a village in which there are five hundred people.” Imam (a.s) said: “When it is like that, then fast with their fasting, and break the fast with their breaking of the fast.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ وَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَمَّرُ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ اَلْأَزْدِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَكُونُ فِي اَلْجَبَلِ فِي اَلْقَرْيَةِ فِيهَا خَمْسُمِائَةٍ مِنَ اَلنَّاسِ فَقَالَ» إِذَا كَانَ كَذَلِكَ فَصُمْ بِصِيَامِهِمْ وَ أَفْطِرْ بِفِطْرِهِمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud said: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Fadl and Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqub informed us, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, who said: Mammar ibn Khallad narrated to me, from Muawiyah ibn Wahb, from Abd al-Hamid al-Azdi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I may be in the mountain, in a village in which there are five hundred people.” Imam (a.s) said: “When it is like that, then fast with their fasting, and break the fast with their breaking of the fast.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu al-Jarud Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir al-Abdi, who said:
I (narrator) heard Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Fast when the people fast, and break the fast when the people break the fast, for Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has made the crescents appointed times.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْجَارُودِ زِيَادِ بْنِ اَلْمُنْذِرِ اَلْعَبْدِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» صُمْ حِينَ يَصُومُ اَلنَّاسُ وَ أَفْطِرْ حِينَ يُفْطِرُ اَلنَّاسُ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ جَعَلَ اَلْأَهِلَّةَ مَوَاقِيتَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu al-Jarud Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir al-Abdi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Fast when the people fast, and break the fast when the people break the fast, for Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has made the crescents appointed times.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Kasula, from Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Shadhakuni, from Abd al-Razzaq, from Mammar, from Muhammad ibn Shihab al-Zuhri, who said:
I (narrator) heard Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon them both, saying: “The day of doubt: we were commanded to fast it and forbidden from it. We were commanded that a person fast it on the basis that it is from Shaban, and we were forbidden from fasting it on the basis that it is from the month of Ramadan while he has not seen the crescent.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْقَاسَانِيِّ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَاسُولاَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ اَلشَّاذَكُونِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّزَّاقِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ اَلزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» يَوْمُ اَلشَّكِّ أُمِرْنَا بِصِيَامِهِ وَنُهِينَا عَنْهُ أُمِرْنَا أَنْ يَصُومَهُ اَلْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى أَنَّهُ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ وَنُهِينَا عَنْ أَنْ يَصُومَهُ عَلَى أَنَّهُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ لَمْ يَرَ اَلْهِلاَلَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad Kasula, from Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Shadhakuni, from Abd al-Razzaq, from Mammar, from Muhammad ibn Shihab al-Zuhri, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon them both, saying: “The day of doubt: we were commanded to fast it and forbidden from it. We were commanded that a person fast it on the basis that it is from Shaban, and we were forbidden from fasting it on the basis that it is from the month of Ramadan while he has not seen the crescent.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from his two brothers, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr ibn Ayan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Fast upon sighting, and break the fast upon sighting. And the sighting of the crescent is not that a man and two men come and say, ‘We saw it.’ Rather, sighting is that the one who says says, ‘I saw it,’ and the people say, ‘You have spoken the truth.’”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَخَوَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »صُمْ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ وَ أَفْطِرْ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ وَ لَيْسَ رُؤْيَةُ اَلْهِلاَلِ أَنْ يَجِيءَ اَلرَّجُلُ وَاَلرَّجُلاَنِ فَيَقُولاَنِ رَأَيْنَا إِنَّمَا اَلرُّؤْيَةُ أَنْ يَقُولَ اَلْقَائِلُ رَأَيْتُ فَيَقُولَ اَلْقَوْمُ صَدَقْتَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from his two brothers, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr ibn Ayan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Fast upon sighting, and break the fast upon sighting. And the sighting of the crescent is not that a man and two men come and say, ‘We saw it.’ Rather, sighting is that the one who says says, ‘I saw it,’ and the people say, ‘You have spoken the truth.’”
