chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud al-Qummi said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Said informed us, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ghalib, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abd al-Salam ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “When you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see the crescent, then break the fast.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ اَلْقُمِّيُّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ غَالِبٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلسَّلاَمِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» إِذَا رَأَيْتَ اَلْهِلاَلَ فَصُمْ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ اَلْهِلاَلَ فَأَفْطِرْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud al-Qummi said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Said informed us, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ghalib, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abd al-Salam ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When you see the crescent, then fast, and when you see the crescent, then break the fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 221

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ghalib al-Zurari, from Muhammad ibn Jafar al-Razzaz, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya al-Lului, from Yazid ibn Ishaq, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Ala ibn Ayun, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “If you fast because of sighting the crescent (al-hilal) and break the fast because of sighting it, then you have completed the month, even if you only fast twenty-nine days. For the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), And He (saws) pointed with his hand: ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and ten (fingers); And like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers): ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and nine (fingers, but lowering down his thumb).’”
arabicText: أبو غالب الزراري عن محمد بن جعفر الرزاز عن يحيى بن زكريا اللؤلؤي عن يزيد بن اسحاق عن حماد بن عثمان عن عبد الاعلى بن اعين عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: سمعته يقول إذا: صمت لرؤية الهلال وافطرت لرؤيته فقد أكملت الشهر وان لم تصم إلا تسعة وعشرين يوما، فان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله قال :الشهر هكذا وهكذا وهكذا واشار بيده عشرا وعشرا وعشرا، وهكذا وهكذا وهكذا عشرة وعشرة وتسع
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ghalib al-Zurari, from Muhammad ibn Jafar al-Razzaz, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya al-Lului, from Yazid ibn Ishaq, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Ala ibn Ayun, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “If you fast because of sighting the crescent (al-hilal) and break the fast because of sighting it, then you have completed the month, even if you only fast twenty-nine days. For the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), And He (saws) pointed with his hand: ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and ten (fingers); And like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers): ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and nine (fingers, but lowering down his thumb).’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 221

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Shar, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi, who said:
I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “When you fast upon its sighting and break the fast upon its sighting, then you have completed the fasting of the month of Ramadan.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ اَلْغَنَوِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» إِذَا صُمْتَ لِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَأَفْطَرْتَ لِرُؤْيَتِهِ فَقَدْ أَكْمَلْتَ صِيَامَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Shar, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “When you fast upon its sighting and break the fast upon its sighting, then you have completed the fasting of the month of Ramadan.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 222

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ghalib al-Zurari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ghalib, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu al-Sabbah Sabih ibn Abdullah, from Sabbar, the client (mawali) of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who fasts twenty-nine days, and breaks the fast upon sighting, and fasts upon sighting. Should he make up one day?’ Imam (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: ‘No, unless two just witnesses come and testify that they saw it (moon) one night before that, then he makes up one day (of fasting).’”
arabicText: أَبُو غَالِبٍ اَلزُّرَارِيُّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ غَالِبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ صَبِيحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ صَبَّارٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَصُومُ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً وَ يُفْطِرُ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ وَ يَصُومُ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ أَ يَقْضِي يَوْماً فَقَالَ» كَانَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ» لاَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجِيءَ شَاهِدَانِ عَدْلاَنِ فَيَشْهَدَا أَنَّهُمَا رَأَيَاهُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ بِلَيْلَةٍ فَيَقْضِيَ يَوْماً««.
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ghalib al-Zurari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ghalib, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu al-Sabbah Sabih ibn Abdullah, from Sabbar, the client (mawali) of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who fasts twenty-nine days, and breaks the fast upon sighting, and fasts upon sighting. Should he make up one day?’ Imam (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: ‘No, unless two just witnesses come and testify that they saw it (moon) one night before that, then he makes up one day (of fasting).’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 222

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu al-Qasim Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh said: Muhammad ibn Hammam informed us, from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Samaah, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Harun ibn Kharijah, from al-Rabi ibn Wallad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “When you see the crescent of Shaban, then count twenty-nine nights. Then if it becomes clear and you do not see it, then do not fast; and if it becomes cloudy, then fast.”
arabicText: أَبُو اَلْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قُولَوَيْهِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ هَمَّامٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنِ اَلرَّبِيعِ بْنِ وَلاَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا رَأَيْتَ هِلاَلَ شَعْبَانَ فَعُدَّ تِسْعاً وَ عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً فَإِنْ أَصْحَتْ فَلَمْ تَرَهُ فَلاَ تَصُمْ وَ إِنْ تَغَيَّمَتْ فَصُمْ
thaqalaynSanad: Abu al-Qasim Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh said: Muhammad ibn Hammam informed us, from Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Samaah, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Harun ibn Kharijah, from al-Rabi ibn Wallad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When you see the crescent of Shaban, then count twenty-nine nights. Then if it becomes clear and you do not see it, then do not fast; and if it becomes cloudy, then fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 222

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Ghalib al-Zurari, from his maternal uncle Muhammad ibn Jafar, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya ibn Shayban, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Shar, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Yaqub al-Ahmar, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: ‘Is the month of Ramadan always complete (thirty days)?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, rather it is a month from among the months.”
arabicText: أَبُو غَالِبٍ اَلزُّرَارِيُّ عَنْ خَالِهِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ شَيْبَانَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ اَلْأَحْمَرِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ تَامٌّ أَبَداً فَقَالَ» لاَ بَلْ شَهْرٌ مِنَ اَلشُّهُورِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Abu Ghalib al-Zurari, from his maternal uncle Muhammad ibn Jafar, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya ibn Shayban, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Shar, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Yaqub al-Ahmar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: ‘Is the month of Ramadan always complete (thirty days)?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, rather it is a month from among the months.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 222

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from his maternal uncle Muhammad ibn Jafar, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya al-Lului, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Shar, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Fitr ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “(month of) Ramadan is affected by deficiency (of days) just as the months are affected. So if you fast (month of) Ramadan for twenty-nine days, then it becomes cloudy, complete the count as thirty days.”
arabicText: وعنه عن خاله محمد بن جعفر عن يحيى بن زكريا اللؤلؤي عن يزيد بن اسحاق شعر عن حماد بن عثمان عن فطر بن عبد الملك قال: قال:ـ يعني ابا عبد الله عليه السلامـ يصيب شهر رمضان ما يصيب الشهور من النقصان فإذا صمت شهر رمضان تسعة وعشرين يوما ثم تغيمت فأتم العدة ثلاثين يوما
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from his maternal uncle Muhammad ibn Jafar, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya al-Lului, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Shar, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Fitr ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “(month of) Ramadan is affected by deficiency (of days) just as the months are affected. So if you fast (month of) Ramadan for twenty-nine days, then it becomes cloudy, complete the count as thirty days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 223

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Said informed us, from Abu al-Hasan ibn al-Qasim, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, who said: Ahmad ibn Isa ibn Abdullah narrated to me, from Abdullah ibn Ali ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, saying: ‘Say, “They are a means for people to determine time and pilgrimage.”’ (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:189) Imam (a.s) said: “For their fasting, their breaking of the fast, and their Hajj.”
arabicText: أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» قُلْ هِيَ مَوٰاقِيتُ لِلنّٰاسِ وَ اَلْحَجِّ« قَالَ» لِصَوْمِهِمْ وَفِطْرِهِمْ وَحَجِّهِمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Said informed us, from Abu al-Hasan ibn al-Qasim, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, who said: Ahmad ibn Isa ibn Abdullah narrated to me, from Abdullah ibn Ali ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said regarding Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, saying: ‘Say, “They are a means for people to determine time and pilgrimage.”’ (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:189) Imam (a.s) said: “For their fasting, their breaking of the fast, and their Hajj.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 223

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muammar ibn Khallad, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) was sitting with Imam (a.s) on the last day of Shaban, and I did not see Imam (a.s) fasting. Then they brought Imam (a.s) a table, and Imam (a.s) said: “Come near.” And that was after Asr. I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, I fasted today.” Imam (a.s) said to me: “And why?” I (narrator) replied: “It has come from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding the day concerning which there is doubt, that he said: ‘A day for which Allah (swt) has granted success.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Do you not know that this is only when it is not known whether it is from Shaban or from the month of Ramadan, so the man fasts it, and it turns out to be from the month of Ramadan, then it is a day for which Allah (swt) has granted success. But when there is no obstruction (of clouds) and no uncertainty (of moon not being sighted), then no.” So I (narrator) asked: “Shall I break the fast now?” Imam (a.s) said: “No.” I (narrator) asked: “And likewise with voluntary fasts, I do not have the right to break the fast after Zuhr?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: مُعَمَّرُ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: كُنْتُ جَالِساً عِنْدَهُ آخِرَ يَوْمٍ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَلَمْ أَرَهُ صَائِماً فَأَتَوْهُ بِمَائِدَةٍ فَقَالَ» اُدْنُ« وَ كَانَ ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ قُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ صُمْتُ اَلْيَوْمَ فَقَالَ لِي» وَ لِمَ« قُلْتُ جَاءَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ» يَوْمٌ وَفَّقَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ« قَالَ» أَ لَيْسَ تَدْرُونَ أَنَّمَا ذَلِكَ إِذَا كَانَ لاَ يُعْلَمُ أَ هُوَ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ أَمْ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَصَامَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ وَ كَانَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ كَانَ يَوْماً وَفَّقَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ فَأَمَّا وَ لَيْسَ عِلَّةٌ وَ لاَ شُبْهَةٌ فَلاَ« فَقُلْتُ أُفْطِرُ اَلْآنَ فَقَالَ» لاَ« قُلْتُ وَ كَذَلِكَ فِي اَلنَّوَافِلِ لَيْسَ لِي أَنْ أُفْطِرَ بَعْدَ اَلظُّهْرِ قَالَ» نَعَمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muammar ibn Khallad, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) was sitting with Imam (a.s) on the last day of Shaban, and I did not see Imam (a.s) fasting. Then they brought Imam (a.s) a table, and Imam (a.s) said: “Come near.” And that was after Asr. I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, I fasted today.” Imam (a.s) said to me: “And why?” I (narrator) replied: “It has come from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding the day concerning which there is doubt, that he said: ‘A day for which Allah (swt) has granted success.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Do you not know that this is only when it is not known whether it is from Shaban or from the month of Ramadan, so the man fasts it, and it turns out to be from the month of Ramadan, then it is a day for which Allah (swt) has granted success. But when there is no obstruction (of clouds) and no uncertainty (of moon not being sighted), then no.” So I (narrator) asked: “Shall I break the fast now?” Imam (a.s) said: “No.” I (narrator) asked: “And likewise with voluntary fasts, I do not have the right to break the fast after Zuhr?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt, and it is not known whether it is from the month of Ramadan or from Shaban.’ Imam (a.s) said: “The month of Ramadan is a month from among the months; what affects the months of increase and deficiency affects it. So fast upon sighting, and break the fast upon sighting, and I dislike that anyone precede it by fasting a day.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا ع عَنِ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ وَلاَ يُدْرَى أَهُوَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوْ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَقَالَ» شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ شَهْرٌ مِنَ اَلشُّهُورِ يُصِيبُهُ مَا يُصِيبُ اَلشُّهُورَ مِنَ اَلزِّيَادَةِ وَ اَلنُّقْصَانِ فَصُومُوا لِلرُّؤْيَةِ وَأَفْطِرُوا لِلرُّؤْيَةِ وَ لاَ يُعْجِبُنِي أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَهُ أَحَدٌ بِصِيَامِ يَوْمٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt, and it is not known whether it is from the month of Ramadan or from Shaban.’ Imam (a.s) said: “The month of Ramadan is a month from among the months; what affects the months of increase and deficiency affects it. So fast upon sighting, and break the fast upon sighting, and I dislike that anyone precede it by fasting a day.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu al-Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said: Abu Ali ibn Rashid narrated to me, who said:
Abu al-Hasan al-Askari (a.s) wrote a letter to me and dated it: “Tuesday, with one night remaining from Shaban,” and that was in the year two hundred and thirty-two. And Wednesday was a day of doubt, and the people of Baghdad fasted on Thursday, and they informed me that they had seen the crescent on the night of Thursday, and that it did not set except after twilight by a long time. He (narrator) said: “So I believed that the fasting was on Thursday, and that the month, according to us in Baghdad, had been on Wednesday.” He (narrator) said: “Imam (a.s) wrote to me: ‘May Allah (swt) increase you in success, for you have fasted with our fasting.’” He (narrator) said: “Then I met Imam (a.s) after that, and I asked Imam (a.s) about what I had written to him, so Imam (a.s) said to me: ‘Did I not write to you that I only fasted on Thursday, and do not fast except upon sighting?’”
arabicText: أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَلِيِّ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ: كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْعَسْكَرِيُّ ع كِتَاباً وَ أَرَّخَهُ» يَوْمَ اَلثَّلاَثَاءِ لِلَيْلَةٍ بَقِيَتْ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ« وَ ذَلِكَ فِي سَنَةِ اِثْنَيْنِ وَ ثَلاَثِينَ وَمِائَتَيْنِ وَكَانَ يَوْمُ اَلْأَرْبِعَاءِ يَوْمَ شَكٍّ وَصَامَ أَهْلُ بَغْدَادَ يَوْمَ اَلْخَمِيسِ وَأَخْبَرُونِي أَنَّهُمْ رَأَوُا اَلْهِلاَلَ لَيْلَةَ اَلْخَمِيسِ وَ لَمْ يَغِبْ إِلاَّ بَعْدَ اَلشَّفَقِ بِزَمَانٍ طَوِيلٍ قَالَ فَاعْتَقَدْتُ أَنَّ اَلصَّوْمَ يَوْمَ اَلْخَمِيسِ وَ أَنَّ اَلشَّهْرَ كَانَ عِنْدَنَا بِبَغْدَادَ يَوْمَ اَلْأَرْبِعَاءِ قَالَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ» زَادَكَ اَللَّهُ تَوْفِيقاً فَقَدْ صُمْتَ بِصِيَامِنَا« قَالَ ثُمَّ لَقِيتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَمَّا كَتَبْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لِي» أَوَ لَمْ أَكْتُبْ إِلَيْكَ أَنَّمَا صُمْتُ اَلْخَمِيسَ وَ لاَ تَصُمْ إِلاَّ لِلرُّؤْيَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Abu al-Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said: Abu Ali ibn Rashid narrated to me, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu al-Hasan al-Askari (a.s) wrote a letter to me and dated it: “Tuesday, with one night remaining from Shaban,” and that was in the year two hundred and thirty-two. And Wednesday was a day of doubt, and the people of Baghdad fasted on Thursday, and they informed me that they had seen the crescent on the night of Thursday, and that it did not set except after twilight by a long time. He (narrator) said: “So I believed that the fasting was on Thursday, and that the month, according to us in Baghdad, had been on Wednesday.” He (narrator) said: “Imam (a.s) wrote to me: ‘May Allah (swt) increase you in success, for you have fasted with our fasting.’” He (narrator) said: “Then I met Imam (a.s) after that, and I asked Imam (a.s) about what I had written to him, so Imam (a.s) said to me: ‘Did I not write to you that I only fasted on Thursday, and do not fast except upon sighting?’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 224

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'r from Harun ibn Hamzah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “When you fast upon sighting the crescent and break the fast upon sighting it, then you have completed the fasting of a month, even if you fast only twenty-nine days, for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers),’ and He (saws) gestured with his hand to ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and nine (fingers, but lowering down his thumb).”
arabicText: سعد بن عبد الله عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابى الخطاب عن يزيد بن اسحاق شعر عن هارون بن حمزة عن ابي عبد الله ع قال: سمعته يقول إذا صمت لرؤية الهلال وافطرت لرؤيته فقد اكملت صيام شهر وان لم تصم ألا تسعة وعشرين يوما، فان رسول الله ص قال: الشهر هكذا وهكذا وهكذا واشار بيده إلى عشرة وعشرة وتسعة
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'r from Harun ibn Hamzah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Imam (a.s) saying: “When you fast upon sighting the crescent and break the fast upon sighting it, then you have completed the fasting of a month, even if you fast only twenty-nine days, for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The month is like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers),’ and He (saws) gestured with his hand to ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and nine (fingers, but lowering down his thumb).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 225

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what Ibn Rabah narrated in the Book of Fasting from the hadith of Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, from Muadh ibn Kathir, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The people say that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, fasted twenty-nine more often than He (saws) fasted thirty.” Imam (a.s) said: “They have lied. The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not fast, from the time Allah (swt) the Exalted sent him until He (saws) took him, less than thirty days, and the month of Ramadan has not decreased, since Allah (swt) created the heavens, from thirty days and nights.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اِبْنُ رَبَاحٍ فِي كِتَابِ اَلصِّيَامِ مِنْ حَدِيثِ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ صَامَ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا صَامَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَقَالَ» كَذَبُوا مَا صَامَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مُنْذُ بَعَثَهُ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى إِلَى أَنْ قَبَضَهُ أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً وَ لاَ نَقَصَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ مُنْذُ خَلَقَ اَللَّهُ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً وَ لَيْلَةً«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what Ibn Rabah narrated in the Book of Fasting from the hadith of Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, from Muadh ibn Kathir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The people say that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, fasted twenty-nine more often than He (saws) fasted thirty.” Imam (a.s) said: “They have lied. The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not fast, from the time Allah (swt) the Exalted sent him until He (saws) took him, less than thirty days, and the month of Ramadan has not decreased, since Allah (swt) created the heavens, from thirty days and nights.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 225

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Hasan ibn Hudhayfah, from his father, from Muadh ibn Kathir, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The people narrate that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, fasted twenty-nine days.” He (narrator) said: “So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: ‘No, by Allah (swt), the month of Ramadan has not decreased, since Allah (swt) created the heavens and the earth, from thirty days and thirty nights.’”
arabicText: اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ حُذَيْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَرْوُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ صَامَ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ وَ اَللَّهِ مَا نَقَصَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ مُنْذُ خَلَقَ اَللَّهُ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضَ مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ لَيْلَةً«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Hasan ibn Hudhayfah, from his father, from Muadh ibn Kathir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The people narrate that the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, fasted twenty-nine days.” He (narrator) said: “So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: ‘No, by Allah (swt), the month of Ramadan has not decreased, since Allah (swt) created the heavens and the earth, from thirty days and thirty nights.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 225

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And Muhammad ibn Sinan also narrated this hadith from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The month of Ramadan is thirty days; it never decreases.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى هَذَا اَلْحَدِيثَ أَيْضاً مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ ثَلاَثُونَ يَوْماً لاَ يَنْقُصُ أَبَداً«.
thaqalaynSanad: And Muhammad ibn Sinan also narrated this hadith from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The month of Ramadan is thirty days; it never decreases.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 226

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From al-Hasan ibn Hudhayfah, from his father, from Muadh ibn Kathir, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “The people narrate among us that the Messenger of Allah (swt), fasted like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers), And he demonstrated with his hand, placing one of his hands over the other: ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and nine (fingers, but lowering down his thumb), more often than he fasted like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), meaning ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and ten (fingers).” He (narrator) said: “So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not fast less than thirty days, and the month of Ramadan has not decreased from thirty days since Allah (swt) created the heavens and the earth.’”
arabicText: عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَرْوُونَ عِنْدَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ص صَامَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا وَحَكَى بِيَدِهِ يُطْبِقُ إِحْدَى يَدَيْهِ عَلَى اَلْأُخْرَى عَشْراً وَ عَشْراً وَ تِسْعاً أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا صَامَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا وَ هَكَذَا يَعْنِي عَشْراً وَ عَشْراً وَ عَشْراً قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع» مَا صَامَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ص أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً وَ مَا نَقَصَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً مُنْذُ خَلَقَ اَللَّهُ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From al-Hasan ibn Hudhayfah, from his father, from Muadh ibn Kathir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “The people narrate among us that the Messenger of Allah (swt), fasted like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (nine fingers), And he demonstrated with his hand, placing one of his hands over the other: ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and nine (fingers, but lowering down his thumb), more often than he fasted like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), and like ‘this’ (ten fingers), meaning ten (fingers), and ten (fingers), and ten (fingers).” He (narrator) said: “So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not fast less than thirty days, and the month of Ramadan has not decreased from thirty days since Allah (swt) created the heavens and the earth.’”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And he mentioned it through another route, from Abu Imran al-Munshid, from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), said: “No, by Allah (swt); no, by Allah (swt), the month of Ramadan has not decreased, and it will never decrease, from thirty days and thirty nights.” So I (narrator) said to Hudhayfah: “Perhaps Imam (a.s) said to you thirty nights and thirty days, just as people say, ‘the night is the night of the day.’” So Hudhayfah said to me (narrator): “This is how I heard it.”
arabicText: وَ ذَكَرَهُ مِنْ طَرِيقٍ آخَرَ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ اَلْمُنْشِدِ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» لاَ وَ اَللَّهِ لاَ وَ اَللَّهِ مَا نَقَصَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ وَ لاَ يَنْقُصُ أَبَداً مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ لَيْلَةً« فَقُلْتُ لِحُذَيْفَةَ لَعَلَّهُ قَالَ لَكَ ثَلاَثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً كَمَا يَقُولُ اَلنَّاسُ اَللَّيْلُ لَيْلُ اَلنَّهَارِ فَقَالَ لِي حُذَيْفَةُ هَكَذَا سَمِعْتُ.
thaqalaynSanad: And he mentioned it through another route, from Abu Imran al-Munshid, from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), said: “No, by Allah (swt); no, by Allah (swt), the month of Ramadan has not decreased, and it will never decrease, from thirty days and thirty nights.” So I (narrator) said to Hudhayfah: “Perhaps Imam (a.s) said to you thirty nights and thirty days, just as people say, ‘the night is the night of the day.’” So Hudhayfah said to me (narrator): “This is how I heard it.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, who said:
I (narrator) came to Muadh ibn Kathir in the month of Ramadan, and Ishaq ibn Mukhawwal was with me. So Muadh said: “No, by Allah (swt), nothing has ever decreased from the month of Ramadan.”
arabicText: وَرَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ: أَتَيْتُ مُعَاذَ بْنَ كَثِيرٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَكَانَ مَعِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُخَوَّلٍ فَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ لاَ وَ اَللَّهِ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَطُّ.
thaqalaynSanad: And Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) came to Muadh ibn Kathir in the month of Ramadan, and Ishaq ibn Mukhawwal was with me. So Muadh said: “No, by Allah (swt), nothing has ever decreased from the month of Ramadan.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for that which Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn Yaqub ibn Shuayb, from his father, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “The people say that the Messenger of Allah (swt), fasted twenty-nine days more often than He (saws) fasted thirty days.” Imam (a.s) said: “They have lied. The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not fast except completely (thirty days), and that is the saying of Allah (swt) the Exalted: ‘So that you may complete the prescribed period.’ Thus the month of Ramadan is thirty days, Shawwal is twenty-nine days, and Dhu al-Qadah is thirty days; it never decreases, because Allah (swt) the Exalted says: ‘And We (swt) appointed for Musa thirty nights.’ (Surah Al-A'raf 7:142) And Dhu al-Hijjah is twenty-nine days. Then the months are upon the like of that: a complete month and a deficient month. And Shaban is never complete.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ صَامَ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا صَامَ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً فَقَالَ» كَذَبُوا مَا صَامَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إِلاَّ تَامّاً وَ ذَلِكَ قَوْلُ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى» وَلِتُكْمِلُوا اَلْعِدَّةَ« فَشَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ ثَلاَثُونَ يَوْماً وَشَوَّالٌ تِسْعَةٌوَ عِشْرُونَ يَوْماً وَذُو اَلْقَعْدَةِ ثَلاَثُونَ يَوْماً لاَ يَنْقُصُ أَبَداً لِأَنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ» وَوٰاعَدْنٰا مُوسىٰ ثَلاٰثِينَ لَيْلَةً« وَ ذُو اَلْحِجَّةِ تِسْعَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ يَوْماً ثُمَّ اَلشُّهُورُ عَلَى مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ شَهْرٌ تَامٌّ وَ شَهْرٌ نَاقِصٌ وَ شَعْبَانُ لاَ يَتِمُّ أَبَداً«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for that which Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn Yaqub ibn Shuayb, from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “The people say that the Messenger of Allah (swt), fasted twenty-nine days more often than He (saws) fasted thirty days.” Imam (a.s) said: “They have lied. The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not fast except completely (thirty days), and that is the saying of Allah (swt) the Exalted: ‘So that you may complete the prescribed period.’ Thus the month of Ramadan is thirty days, Shawwal is twenty-nine days, and Dhu al-Qadah is thirty days; it never decreases, because Allah (swt) the Exalted says: ‘And We (swt) appointed for Musa thirty nights.’ (Surah Al-A'raf 7:142) And Dhu al-Hijjah is twenty-nine days. Then the months are upon the like of that: a complete month and a deficient month. And Shaban is never complete.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Babawayh narrated this hadith from his father, from Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn Yaqub ibn Shuayb, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam (a.s): “The people narrate that the Messenger of Allah (swt), did not fast twenty-nine days from the month of Ramadan more often than He (saws) fasted thirty.” Imam (a.s) said: “They have lied. The Messenger of Allah (swt), did not fast except completely, and the obligations are not deficient. Indeed Allah (swt) created the year as three hundred and sixty days, and ‘He (swt) created the heavens and the earth in six days,’ so Allah (swt) withheld them from three hundred and sixty days; thus the year is three hundred and fifty-four days, and the month of Ramadan is thirty days.”
arabicText: وَرَوَى هَذَا اَلْحَدِيثَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بَابَوَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَرْوُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مَا صَامَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ تِسْعَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا صَامَ ثَلاَثِينَ فَقَالَ» كَذَبُوا مَا صَامَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إِلاَّ تَامّاً وَ لاَ تَكُونُ اَلْفَرَائِضُ نَاقِصَةً إِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى خَلَقَ اَلسَّنَةَ ثَلاَثَمِائَةٍ وَ سِتِّينَ يَوْماً وَ» خَلَقَ اَلسَّمٰاوٰاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيّٰامٍ« فَحَجَزَهَا مِنْ ثَلاَثِمِائَةٍ وَ سِتِّينَ يَوْماً فَالسَّنَةُ ثَلاَثُمِائَةٍ وَ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَ خَمْسُونَ يَوْماً وَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ ثَلاَثُونَ يَوْماً«.
thaqalaynSanad: And Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Babawayh narrated this hadith from his father, from Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn Yaqub ibn Shuayb, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): “The people narrate that the Messenger of Allah (swt), did not fast twenty-nine days from the month of Ramadan more often than He (saws) fasted thirty.” Imam (a.s) said: “They have lied. The Messenger of Allah (swt), did not fast except completely, and the obligations are not deficient. Indeed Allah (swt) created the year as three hundred and sixty days, and ‘He (swt) created the heavens and the earth in six days,’ so Allah (swt) withheld them from three hundred and sixty days; thus the year is three hundred and fifty-four days, and the month of Ramadan is thirty days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 230

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And al-Kulayni Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated it from a group of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, created the world in six days, then He (swt) reduced them from the days of the year, so the year is three hundred and fifty-four days. Shaban is never complete, and the month of Ramadan does not decrease (from thirty days), by Allah (swt), ever, and an obligation is not deficient. Indeed Allah (swt) the Exalted says: ‘And so that you may complete the number.’ And Shawwal is twenty-nine days, And Dhu al-Qadah is thirty days. Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, says: ‘And We (swt) appointed for Musa thirty nights and completed them with ten.’ (Surah Al-A'raf 7:142) And Dhu al-Hijjah is twenty-nine days, And Muharram is thirty days. Then the months after that are a complete month and a deficient month.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَاهُ اَلْكُلَيْنِيُّ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ خَلَقَ اَلدُّنْيَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اِخْتَزَلَهَا مِنْ أَيَّامِ اَلسَّنَةِ فَالسَّنَةُ ثَلاَثُمِائَةٍ وَ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَ خَمْسُونَ يَوْماً شَعْبَانُ لاَ يَتِمُّ أَبَداً وَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ لاَ يَنْقُصُ وَ اَللَّهِ أَبَداً وَ لاَ تَكُونُ فَرِيضَةٌ نَاقِصَةً إِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ» وَلِتُكْمِلُوا اَلْعِدَّةَ« وَ شَوَّالٌ تِسْعَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ يَوْماً وَ ذُو اَلْقَعْدَةِ ثَلاَثُونَ يَوْماً يَقُولُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ» وَوٰاعَدْنٰا مُوسىٰ ثَلاٰثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنٰاهٰا بِعَشْرٍ« وَذُو اَلْحِجَّةِ تِسْعَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ يَوْماً وَاَلْمُحَرَّمُ ثَلاَثُونَ يَوْماً ثُمَّ اَلشُّهُورُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ شَهْرٌ تَامٌّ وَ شَهْرٌ نَاقِصٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And al-Kulayni Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated it from a group of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, created the world in six days, then He (swt) reduced them from the days of the year, so the year is three hundred and fifty-four days. Shaban is never complete, and the month of Ramadan does not decrease (from thirty days), by Allah (swt), ever, and an obligation is not deficient. Indeed Allah (swt) the Exalted says: ‘And so that you may complete the number.’ And Shawwal is twenty-nine days, And Dhu al-Qadah is thirty days. Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, says: ‘And We (swt) appointed for Musa thirty nights and completed them with ten.’ (Surah Al-A'raf 7:142) And Dhu al-Hijjah is twenty-nine days, And Muharram is thirty days. Then the months after that are a complete month and a deficient month.”

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Bashshar, from Abdullah ibn Jundab, from Muawiyah ibn Wahb, said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Indeed the month about which it is said that it ‘does not decrease’ is Dhu al-Qadah; among the months of the year, there is none more deficient than it.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ بَشَّارٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» إِنَّ اَلشَّهْرَ اَلَّذِي يُقَالُ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَنْقُصُ ذُو اَلْقَعْدَةِ لَيْسَ فِي شُهُورِ اَلسَّنَةِ أَكْثَرُ نُقْصَاناً مِنْهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Bashshar, from Abdullah ibn Jundab, from Muawiyah ibn Wahb, said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Indeed the month about which it is said that it ‘does not decrease’ is Dhu al-Qadah; among the months of the year, there is none more deficient than it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what Ibn Rabah narrated from Samaah, from al-Hasan ibn Hudhayfah, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said regarding Allah (swt), the Exalted, saying: ‘And so that you may complete the number.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting thirty days.”
arabicText: وَ أَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اِبْنُ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى» وَلِتُكْمِلُوا اَلْعِدَّةَ« قَالَ» صَوْمُ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what Ibn Rabah narrated from Samaah, from al-Hasan ibn Hudhayfah, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said regarding Allah (swt), the Exalted, saying: ‘And so that you may complete the number.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting thirty days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 237

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “When they see the crescent before midday (al-zawal), then it belongs to the past night, and when they see it after midday (al-zawal), then it belongs to the coming night.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا رَأَوُا اَلْهِلاَلَ قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ فَهُوَ لِلَّيْلَةِ اَلْمَاضِيَةِ وَ إِذَا رَأَوْهُ بَعْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ فَهُوَ لِلَّيْلَةِ اَلْمُسْتَقْبَلَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When they see the crescent before midday (al-zawal), then it belongs to the past night, and when they see it after midday (al-zawal), then it belongs to the coming night.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 238

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And that which Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Abu Jafar, from Abu Talib Abdullah ibn al-Salt, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah and Abdullah ibn Bukayr, who both said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “When the crescent is seen before midday (al-zawal), then that day is from Shawwal, and when it is seen after midday (al-zawal), then that day is from the month of Ramadan.”
arabicText: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ وَ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالاَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» إِذَا رُئِيَ اَلْهِلاَلُ قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ فَذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمُ مِنْ شَوَّالٍ وَ إِذَا رُئِيَ بَعْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ فَذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And that which Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated from Abu Jafar, from Abu Talib Abdullah ibn al-Salt, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah and Abdullah ibn Bukayr, who both said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “When the crescent is seen before midday (al-zawal), then that day is from Shawwal, and when it is seen after midday (al-zawal), then that day is from the month of Ramadan.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 238

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Jafar, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Isa:
I (narrator) wrote to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, sometimes the crescent of the month of Ramadan is obscured from us, then the crescent is seen the next day before midday (al-zawal), and sometimes we see it after midday. So do you think that we should break the fast before midday when we see it, or not? And how do you command me regarding that?” So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “You complete until the night, for if it is complete, it is seen before midday.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ رُبَّمَا غُمَّ عَلَيْنَا هِلاَلُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيُرَى مِنَ اَلْغَدِ اَلْهِلاَلُ قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ وَ رُبَّمَا رَأَيْنَاهُ بَعْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ فَتَرَى أَنْ نُفْطِرَ قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ إِذَا رَأَيْنَاهُ أَمْ لاَ وَ كَيْفَ تَأْمُرُنِي فِي ذَلِكَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» تُتِمُّ إِلَى اَللَّيْلِ فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ كَانَ تَامّاً رُئِيَ قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Jafar, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Isa:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) wrote to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, sometimes the crescent of the month of Ramadan is obscured from us, then the crescent is seen the next day before midday (al-zawal), and sometimes we see it after midday. So do you think that we should break the fast before midday when we see it, or not? And how do you command me regarding that?” So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “You complete until the night, for if it is complete, it is seen before midday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 239

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from al-Hasan, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘When you see the crescent, then break the fast, and call upright witnesses from among the Muslims to testify to it. But if you do not see the crescent except from the middle of the day or at its end, then complete the fast until the night. And if it is obscured for you, then count thirty, then break the fast.’”
arabicText: وعنه عن الحسن بن علي عن أبيه عن الحسن عن يوسف ابن عقيل عن محمد بن قيس عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال: قال أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام: إذا رأيتم الهلال فافطروا وأشهدوا عليه عدولا من المسلمين ،فان لم تروا الهلال إلا من وسط النهار أو آخره فاتموا الصيام الى الليل، وان غم عليكم فعدوا ثلاثين ثم افطرو
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from al-Hasan, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘When you see the crescent, then break the fast, and call upright witnesses from among the Muslims to testify to it. But if you do not see the crescent except from the middle of the day or at its end, then complete the fast until the night. And if it is obscured for you, then count thirty, then break the fast.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 239

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Jarrah al-Madaini, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever sees the crescent of Shawwal during the day in (month of) Ramadan, let him complete his fast.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ جَرَّاحٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» مَنْ رَأَى هِلاَلَ شَوَّالٍ بِنَهَارٍ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَلْيُتِمَّ صِيَامَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Jarrah al-Madaini, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever sees the crescent of Shawwal during the day in (month of) Ramadan, let him complete his fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 239

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the crescent of (month of) Ramadan being obscured from us on the twenty-ninth of Shaban.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Do not fast it unless you see it (the moon). Then if the people of another town testify that they saw it (the moon), then make it up. And when you see it in the middle of the day, then complete its fast until the night.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ هِلاَلِ رَمَضَانَ يُغَمُّ عَلَيْنَا فِي تِسْعٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَقَالَ» لاَ تَصُمْهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنْ شَهِدَ أَهْلُ بَلَدٍ آخَرَ أَنَّهُمْ رَأَوْهُ فَاقْضِهِ وَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُ وَسَطَ اَلنَّهَارِ فَأَتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ إِلَى اَللَّيْلِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the crescent of (month of) Ramadan being obscured from us on the twenty-ninth of Shaban.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Do not fast it unless you see it (the moon). Then if the people of another town testify that they saw it (the moon), then make it up. And when you see it in the middle of the day, then complete its fast until the night.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ismail ibn al-Hurr, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “When the crescent sets before twilight (al-shafaq), then it is for its night, and when it sets after twilight (al-shafaq), then it is for two nights.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ اَلْحُرِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا غَابَ اَلْهِلاَلُ قَبْلَ اَلشَّفَقِ فَهُوَ لِلَيْلَتِهِ وَ إِذَا غَابَ بَعْدَ اَلشَّفَقِ فَهُوَ لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ismail ibn al-Hurr, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When the crescent sets before twilight (al-shafaq), then it is for its night, and when it sets after twilight (al-shafaq), then it is for two nights.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Murazim, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “When the crescent is encircled (tatawwaqa), then it is for two nights, and when you see the shadow of your head in it, then it is for three (nights).”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُرَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا تَطَوَّقَ اَلْهِلاَلُ فَهُوَ لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ وَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَ ظِلَّ رَأْسِكَ فِيهِ فَهُوَ لِثَلاَثٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Murazim, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When the crescent is encircled (tatawwaqa), then it is for two nights, and when you see the shadow of your head in it, then it is for three (nights).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from some of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Muzani, from Imran al-Zafarani, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The sky becomes completely covered over us in Iraq for one day, two days, and three days, so on which day should we fast?” Imam (a.s) said: “Look at the day on which you fasted from the past year, and fast on the fifth day.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْمُزَنِيِّ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ اَلزَّعْفَرَانِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَلسَّمَاءَ تُطْبِقُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْعِرَاقِ اَلْيَوْمَ وَاَلْيَوْمَيْنِ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ فَأَيَّ يَوْمٍ نَصُومُ قَالَ» اُنْظُرِ اَلْيَوْمَ اَلَّذِي صُمْتَ مِنَ اَلسَّنَةِ اَلْمَاضِيَةِ وَ صُمْ يَوْمَ اَلْخَامِسِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from some of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Muzani, from Imran al-Zafarani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The sky becomes completely covered over us in Iraq for one day, two days, and three days, so on which day should we fast?” Imam (a.s) said: “Look at the day on which you fasted from the past year, and fast on the fifth day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 241

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from a group of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Ibrahim al-Ahwal, from Imran al-Zafarani, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “We remain in winter for one day and two days without seeing sun or star, so on which day should we fast?” Imam (a.s) said: “Look at the day on which you fasted from the past year, and count five days, and fast the fifth day.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اَلْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ اَلزَّعْفَرَانِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّا نَمْكُثُ فِي اَلشِّتَاءِ اَلْيَوْمَ وَاَلْيَوْمَيْنِ لاَ نَرَى شَمْساً وَ لاَ نَجْماً فَأَيَّ يَوْمٍ نَصُومُ قَالَ» اُنْظُرِ اَلْيَوْمَ اَلَّذِي صُمْتَ مِنَ اَلسَّنَةِ اَلْمَاضِيَةِ وَ عُدَّ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَ صُمِ اَلْيَوْمَ اَلْخَامِسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from a group of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Ibrahim al-Ahwal, from Imran al-Zafarani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “We remain in winter for one day and two days without seeing sun or star, so on which day should we fast?” Imam (a.s) said: “Look at the day on which you fasted from the past year, and count five days, and fast the fifth day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 241

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘The testimony of women is not accepted regarding the sighting of the crescent, except the testimony of two just men.’”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ ع:» لاَ تُقْبَلُ شَهَادَةُ اَلنِّسَاءِ فِي رُؤْيَةِ اَلْهِلاَلِ إِلاَّ شَهَادَةُ رَجُلَيْنِ عَدْلَيْنِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘The testimony of women is not accepted regarding the sighting of the crescent, except the testimony of two just men.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 242

chapter: Chapter on Sign of the Beginning of the Month of Ramadan and Its End, and the Proof of Its Entrance
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And by this chain of transmission, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
The Imam (a.s) used to say: “I do not permit regarding the sighting of the crescent except the testimony of two just men.”
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:» لاَ أُجِيزُ فِي رُؤْيَةِ اَلْهِلاَلِ إِلاَّ شَهَادَةَ رَجُلَيْنِ عَدْلَيْنِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And by this chain of transmission, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imam (a.s) used to say: “I do not permit regarding the sighting of the crescent except the testimony of two just men.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 242

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a group of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hamzah ibn Yala, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Abi Khalid, raising it from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “When the crescent of Rajab is confirmed, then count fifty-nine days, and fast on the sixtieth day.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ يَعْلَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ يَرْفَعُهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا صَحَّ هِلاَلُ رَجَبٍ فَعُدَّ تِسْعَةً وَ خَمْسِينَ يَوْماً وَ صُمْ يَوْمَ سِتِّينَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a group of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hamzah ibn Yala, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Abi Khalid, raising it from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When the crescent of Rajab is confirmed, then count fifty-nine days, and fast on the sixtieth day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 242

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Bakr and Muhammad ibn Abi al-Sahban, from Hafs, from Umar ibn Salim and Muhammad ibn Ziyad ibn Isa, from Harun ibn Kharijah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Count Shaban as twenty-nine days. Then, if it is cloudy, begin the morning fasting; and if it is clear, and you look carefully and do not see anything, then begin the morning not fasting.”
arabicText: محمد بن يعقوب عن عدة من أصحابنا عن أحمد بن محمد عن محمد بن بكر ومحمد بن ابي الصهبان عن حفص عن عمر بن سالم ومحمد بن زياد بن عيسى عن هارون بن خارجة قال: قال أبو عبد الله عليه السلام: عد شعبان تسعة وعشرين يوما فان كانت متغيمة فاصبح صائما، وان كانت مصحية وتبصرته ولم تر شيئا فاصبح مفطرا.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Bakr and Muhammad ibn Abi al-Sahban, from Hafs, from Umar ibn Salim and Muhammad ibn Ziyad ibn Isa, from Harun ibn Kharijah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Count Shaban as twenty-nine days. Then, if it is cloudy, begin the morning fasting; and if it is clear, and you look carefully and do not see anything, then begin the morning not fasting.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 243

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ubays ibn Hisham, from al-Hasan ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt, for the people claim that whoever fasts it is in the position of one who has broken the fast on a day from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “They have lied. If it is a day from the month of Ramadan, then it is a day for which they were granted success, and if it is from other than it, then it is in the position of what has passed of the days.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْسِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ فَإِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ مَنْ صَامَهُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» كَذَبُوا إِنْ كَانَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَهُوَ يَوْمٌ وُفِّقُوا لَهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَا مَضَى مِنَ اَلْأَيَّامِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ubays ibn Hisham, from al-Hasan ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt, for the people claim that whoever fasts it is in the position of one who has broken the fast on a day from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “They have lied. If it is a day from the month of Ramadan, then it is a day for which they were granted success, and if it is from other than it, then it is in the position of what has passed of the days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 243

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Samaah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt from the month of Ramadan, when one does not know whether it is from Shaban or from the month of Ramadan, so he fasted it as being from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is a day for which he was granted success, and there is no making up upon him.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ لاَ يَدْرِي أَ هُوَ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ أَمْ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَصَامَهُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» هُوَ يَوْمٌ وُفِّقَ لَهُ وَ لاَ قَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Samaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt from the month of Ramadan, when one does not know whether it is from Shaban or from the month of Ramadan, so he fasted it as being from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is a day for which he was granted success, and there is no making up upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 243

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Suhban, from Muhammad ibn Bakr ibn Janah, from Ali ibn Shajarah, from Bashir al-Nabbal, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘fasting the day of doubt.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Fast it, for if it is from Shaban, it is voluntary, and if it is from the month of Ramadan, then it is a day for which you were granted success.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلصُّهْبَانِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَكْرِ بْنِ جَنَاحٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ شَجَرَةَ عَنْ بَشِيرٍ اَلنَّبَّالِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ اَلشَّكِّ فَقَالَ» صُمْهُ فَإِنْ يَكُ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ كَانَ تَطَوُّعاً وَ إِنْ يَكُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيَوْمٌ وُفِّقْتَ لَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Suhban, from Muhammad ibn Bakr ibn Janah, from Ali ibn Shajarah, from Bashir al-Nabbal, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘fasting the day of doubt.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Fast it, for if it is from Shaban, it is voluntary, and if it is from the month of Ramadan, then it is a day for which you were granted success.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 244

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hamzah ibn Yala, from Zakariyya ibn Adam, from al-Kahili, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt from Shaban.’ Imam (a.s) said, “For me to fast a day from Shaban is more beloved to me than to break the fast on a day from the month of Ramadan.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ يَعْلَى عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ آدَمَ عَنِ اَلْكَاهِلِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ قَالَ» لَأَنْ أَصُومَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَعْبَانَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُفْطِرَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hamzah ibn Yala, from Zakariyya ibn Adam, from al-Kahili, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the day concerning which there is doubt from Shaban.’ Imam (a.s) said, “For me to fast a day from Shaban is more beloved to me than to break the fast on a day from the month of Ramadan.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 244

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Suhban, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from Said al-Araj, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I fasted the day concerning which there is doubt, and it turned out to be from the month of Ramadan, so should I make it up?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, it is a day for which you were granted success.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلصُّهْبَانِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رِبَاطٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ اَلْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي صُمْتُ اَلْيَوْمَ اَلَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ فَكَانَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَأَقْضِيهِ قَالَ» لاَ هُوَ يَوْمٌ وُفِّقْتَ لَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Suhban, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from Said al-Araj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I fasted the day concerning which there is doubt, and it turned out to be from the month of Ramadan, so should I make it up?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, it is a day for which you were granted success.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 244

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim and Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who fasts the day concerning which there is doubt, from (month of) Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “He must make it up, even if it was so.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ وَ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَصُومُ اَلْيَوْمَ اَلَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» عَلَيْهِ قَضَاؤُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ كَذَلِكَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what al-Husayn ibn Said narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim and Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who fasts the day concerning which there is doubt, from (month of) Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “He must make it up, even if it was so.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 244

chapter: Chapter on Merit of Fasting the Day of Doubt and Taking Precaution for Fasting the Month of Ramadan
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man fasted a day while he did not know whether it was from the month of Ramadan or from other than it. Then a group came and testified that it was from the month of Ramadan. Some of the people among us said that it is not counted.” Imam (a.s) said to me (narrator): “Rather, yes.” I (narrator) asked: “They said, ‘You fasted while you did not know whether this was from the month of Ramadan or from other than it.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, yes, so count it, for it is only something for which Allah (swt), the Exalted, granted you success. The day of doubt is only fasted from Shaban, and you do not fast it from the month of Ramadan, because it has been forbidden for a person to single himself out for fasting on the day of doubt. Rather, he intends from the night that he is fasting from Shaban. Then if it is from the month of Ramadan, it suffices for him by the grace of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, and by what He (swt) has expanded for His (swt) servants. Were it not for that, the people would perish.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ صَامَ يَوْماً وَ هُوَ لاَ يَدْرِي أَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ هُوَ أَمْ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ فَجَاءَ قَوْمٌ فَشَهِدُوا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ اَلنَّاسِ عِنْدَنَا لاَ يُعْتَدُّ بِهِ فَقَالَ لِي» بَلَى« فَقُلْتُ إِنَّهُمْ قَالُوا صُمْتَ وَ أَنْتَ لاَ تَدْرِي أَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ هَذَا أَمْ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ فَقَالَ» بَلَى فَاعْتَدَّ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْءٌ وَفَّقَكَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى لَهُ إِنَّمَا يُصَامُ يَوْمُ اَلشَّكِّ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ وَ لاَ تَصُومُهُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ نُهِيَ أَنْ يَنْفَرِدَ اَلْإِنْسَانُ لِلصِّيَامِ فِي يَوْمِ اَلشَّكِّ وَ إِنَّمَا يَنْوِي مِنَ اَللَّيْلَةِ أَنَّهُ يَصُومُ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَجْزَأَ عَنْهُ بِتَفَضُّلِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَ بِمَا قَدْ وَسَّعَ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ وَ لَوْ لاَ ذَلِكَ لَهَلَكَ اَلنَّاسُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man fasted a day while he did not know whether it was from the month of Ramadan or from other than it. Then a group came and testified that it was from the month of Ramadan. Some of the people among us said that it is not counted.” Imam (a.s) said to me (narrator): “Rather, yes.” I (narrator) asked: “They said, ‘You fasted while you did not know whether this was from the month of Ramadan or from other than it.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, yes, so count it, for it is only something for which Allah (swt), the Exalted, granted you success. The day of doubt is only fasted from Shaban, and you do not fast it from the month of Ramadan, because it has been forbidden for a person to single himself out for fasting on the day of doubt. Rather, he intends from the night that he is fasting from Shaban. Then if it is from the month of Ramadan, it suffices for him by the grace of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, and by what He (swt) has expanded for His (swt) servants. Were it not for that, the people would perish.”
