chapter: Chapter on One Incapable of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “When a man travels in the month of Ramadan, he must not approach women during the day in (month of) Ramadan, for that (intimacy) is forbidden for him.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا سَافَرَ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلاَ يَقْرَبِ اَلنِّسَاءَ بِالنَّهَارِ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “When a man travels in the month of Ramadan, he must not approach women during the day in (month of) Ramadan, for that (intimacy) is forbidden for him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 310

chapter: Chapter on One Incapable of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Sinan, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan and has with him a slave-girl belonging to him, whether he may have intercourse with her during the day.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Glory be to Allah (swt)! Does this one not know the sanctity of the month of Ramadan? Indeed, he has a long expanse in the night.” I (narrator) asked: “Does he not have the right to eat, drink, and shorten the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has granted the traveler a concession in breaking the fast and shortening the prayer, as a mercy and an easing because of the place of fatigue, hardship, and the roughness of travel, but Allah (swt) has not granted him a concession in having intercourse with women during travel by day in the month of Ramadan. And Allah (swt) has made obligatory upon him the making up of the fast, but Allah (swt) has not made obligatory upon him the completing of the prayer when he returns from his travel.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “And the Sunnah is not measured by analogy, and when I travel in the month of Ramadan, I do not eat except (minimal) sustenance, and I do not drink (excessively) to full quenching.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ مَعَهُ جَارِيَةٌ لَهُ فَلَهُ أَنْ يُصِيبَ مِنْهَا بِالنَّهَارِ فَقَالَ» سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ أَ مَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا حُرْمَةَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّ لَهُ فِي اَللَّيْلِ سَبْحاً طَوِيلاً« قُلْتُ أَ لَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ وَ يَشْرَبَ وَ يُقَصِّرَ فَقَالَ» إِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ رَخَّصَ لِلْمُسَافِرِ فِي اَلْإِفْطَارِ وَ اَلتَّقْصِيرِ رَحْمَةً وَ تَخْفِيفاً لِمَوْضِعِ اَلتَّعَبِ وَ اَلنَّصَبِ وَوَعْثِ اَلسَّفَرِ وَ لَمْ يُرَخِّصْ لَهُ فِي مُجَامَعَةِ اَلنِّسَاءِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ بِالنَّهَارِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ أَوْجَبَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءَ اَلصِّيَامِ وَ لَمْ يُوجِبْ عَلَيْهِ تَمَامَ اَلصَّلاَةِ إِذَا آبَ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» وَ اَلسُّنَّةُ لاَ تُقَاسُ وَ إِنِّي إِذَا سَافَرْتُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَا آكُلُ إِلاَّ اَلْقُوتَ وَ مَا أَشْرَبُ كُلَّ اَلرِّيِّ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan and has with him a slave-girl belonging to him, whether he may have intercourse with her during the day.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Glory be to Allah (swt)! Does this one not know the sanctity of the month of Ramadan? Indeed, he has a long expanse in the night.” I (narrator) asked: “Does he not have the right to eat, drink, and shorten the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has granted the traveler a concession in breaking the fast and shortening the prayer, as a mercy and an easing because of the place of fatigue, hardship, and the roughness of travel, but Allah (swt) has not granted him a concession in having intercourse with women during travel by day in the month of Ramadan. And Allah (swt) has made obligatory upon him the making up of the fast, but Allah (swt) has not made obligatory upon him the completing of the prayer when he returns from his travel.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “And the Sunnah is not measured by analogy, and when I travel in the month of Ramadan, I do not eat except (minimal) sustenance, and I do not drink (excessively) to full quenching.”

chapter: Chapter on One Incapable of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Ahmar, from Abdullah ibn Hammad, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who comes to his slave-girl (for intimacy) during the day in the month of Ramadan while travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Does this one not know the right of the month of Ramadan? Indeed, he has a long expanse in the night.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ اَلْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي جَارِيَتَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِالنَّهَارِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَقَالَ» أَ مَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا حَقَّ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّ لَهُ فِي اَللَّيْلِ سَبْحاً طَوِيلاً«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Ahmar, from Abdullah ibn Hammad, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who comes to his slave-girl (for intimacy) during the day in the month of Ramadan while travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Does this one not know the right of the month of Ramadan? Indeed, he has a long expanse in the night.”

chapter: Chapter on One Incapable of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who came to his wife (for intimacy) in the month of Ramadan while he was travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who came to his wife (for intimacy) in the month of Ramadan while he was travelling.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 311

chapter: Chapter on One Incapable of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan, does he have the right to have intercourse with women?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَ لَهُ أَنْ يُصِيبَ مِنَ اَلنِّسَاءِ قَالَ» نَعَمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan, does he have the right to have intercourse with women?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 312

chapter: Chapter on One Incapable of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Malik ibn Utbah al-Hashimi, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man having intercourse with his wife while travelling in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُجَامِعُ أَهْلَهُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Malik ibn Utbah al-Hashimi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man having intercourse with his wife while travelling in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 312

chapter: Chapter on One Incapable of Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrives from a journey after the afternoon prayer in the month of Ramadan, and then comes to his wife (for intimacy) when she has become pure from menstruation. May he have intercourse with her?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيُصِيبُ اِمْرَأَتَهُ حِينَ طَهُرَتْ مِنَ اَلْحَيْضِ أَيُوَاقِعُهَا قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrives from a journey after the afternoon prayer in the month of Ramadan, and then comes to his wife (for intimacy) when she has become pure from menstruation. May he have intercourse with her?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 312

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, who said:
I (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed or not?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast, and he does not make up the prayer.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَ يُّوبَ بْ نِ نُوحٍ قَا لَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ سْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ أَ مْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّوْمَ وَ لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed or not?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast, and he does not make up the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, who said:
I (narrator) wrote to the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, while I was in Madinah, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْقَاسَانِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّوْمَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) wrote to the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, while I was in Madinah, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who is unconscious for days.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He does not repeat anything of his prayer.”
arabicText: حَرِيزٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ اَلْأَيَّامَ قَالَ» لاَ يُعِيدُ شَيْئاً مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who is unconscious for days.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He does not repeat anything of his prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed of the prayer or not?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast, and he does not make up the prayer.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ أَمْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّوْمَ وَ لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a day or more, does he make up what he missed of the prayer or not?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “He does not make up the fast, and he does not make up the prayer.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what Ibn Abi Umayr narrated, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The one who is unconscious makes up the prayer of three days.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what Ibn Abi Umayr narrated, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The one who is unconscious makes up the prayer of three days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The one who is unconscious makes up what he missed.”
arabicText: حَفْصٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» يَقْضِي اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ مَا فَاتَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The one who is unconscious makes up what he missed.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 313

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer of one day.”
arabicText: حَفْصٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ يَوْمٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer of one day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer during which he regained consciousness.”
arabicText: حَفْصٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلَّتِي أَفَاقَ فِيهَا«.
thaqalaynSanad: Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer during which he regained consciousness.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifaa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a month, what does he make up of the prayer?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He makes all of it up. Indeed, the matter of prayer is severe.”
arabicText: اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ شَهْراً مَا يَقْضِي مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ» يَقْضِيهَا كُلَّهَا إِنَّ أَمْرَ اَلصَّلاَةِ شَدِيدٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifaa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a month, what does he make up of the prayer?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He makes all of it up. Indeed, the matter of prayer is severe.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Hasan, from Zuraa, from Samaa, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a sick person who becomes unconscious.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it is less than three days, then there is no making up upon him; and if he is made unconscious for three days, then upon him is the making up of the prayer in them.”
arabicText: اَلْحَسَنُ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ قَالَ» إِذَا كَانَ دُونَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ وَ إِذَا أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَعَلَيْهِ قَضَاءُ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِيهِنَّ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Hasan, from Zuraa, from Samaa, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a sick person who becomes unconscious.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it is less than three days, then there is no making up upon him; and if he is made unconscious for three days, then upon him is the making up of the prayer in them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Nadr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Everything that you have left of your prayers because of an illness in which you were made unconscious, make it up when you regain consciousness.”
arabicText: اَلنَّضْرُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» كُلُّ شَيْءٍ تَرَكْتَهُ مِنْ صَلَوَاتِكَ لِمَرَضٍ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْكَ فِيهِ فَاقْضِهِ إِذَا أَفَقْتَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Nadr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Everything that you have left of your prayers because of an illness in which you were made unconscious, make it up when you regain consciousness.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who becomes unconscious and then regains consciousness.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up what he missed, and he gives the call to prayer for the first one and gives the iqamah for the rest.”
arabicText: صَفْوَانُ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُفِيقُ قَالَ» يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ وَ يُؤَذِّنُ فِي اَلْأُولَى وَ يُقِيمُ فِي اَلْبَقِيَّةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who becomes unconscious and then regains consciousness.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up what he missed, and he gives the call to prayer for the first one and gives the iqamah for the rest.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Hariz, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man was made unconscious for a month; does he make up anything of his prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up three days of it.”
arabicText: حَرِيزٌ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ شَهْراً أَ يَقْضِي مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ شَيْئاً قَالَ »يَقْضِي مِنْهَا ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Hariz, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man was made unconscious for a month; does he make up anything of his prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up three days of it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Hammad, from Abu Kahmas, who said:
I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘one who is unconscious, does he make up what he left of the prayer?’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for me, my children, and my family, we do that.” – meaning make up the prayer.
arabicText: حَمَّادٌ عَنْ أَبِي كَهْمَسٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: وَ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ أَ يَقْضِي مَا تَرَكَ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ» أَمَّا أَنَا وَ وُلْدِي وَ أَهْلِي فَنَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Hammad, from Abu Kahmas, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘one who is unconscious, does he make up what he left of the prayer?’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for me, my children, and my family, we do that.” – meaning make up the prayer.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from more than one person, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
He (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a month or forty nights.’ He (narrator) said: “So Imam (a.s) said, ‘If you wish, I will inform you of what I command myself and my children with: that you make up everything that you missed.’”
arabicText: إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ شَهْراً أَوْ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً قَالَ فَقَالَ »إِنْ شِئْتَ أَخْبَرْتُكَ بِمَا آمُرُ بِهِ نَفْسِي وَ وُلْدِي أَنْ تَقْضِيَ كُلَّمَا فَاتَكَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from more than one person, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: He (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who is unconscious for a month or forty nights.’ He (narrator) said: “So Imam (a.s) said, ‘If you wish, I will inform you of what I command myself and my children with: that you make up everything that you missed.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 314

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Unconscious Person, the One Afflicted with Bile (Sahib al-Mirrah]) and the Insane Person Regarding Prayer and Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Everything over which Allah (swt) has overcome a person, there is nothing upon its possessor.”
arabicText: إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »كُلُّمَا غَلَبَ اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ شَيْءٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Everything over which Allah (swt) has overcome a person, there is nothing upon its possessor.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who accepted Islam in the middle of the month of Ramadan, what fasting is upon him?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Nothing is upon him except that in which he accepted Islam.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَسْلَمَ فِي اَلنِّصْفِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ صِيَامٍ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ مَا أَسْلَمَ فِيهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who accepted Islam in the middle of the month of Ramadan, what fasting is upon him?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Nothing is upon him except that in which he accepted Islam.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a people who accepted Islam in the month of Ramadan while some days of it had already passed. Is it upon them to make up what had passed of it, or their day on which they accepted Islam?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no making up upon them, nor their day on which they accepted Islam, unless they had accepted Islam before the rising of dawn.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ أَسْلَمُوا فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ قَدْ مَضَى مِنْهُ أَيَّامٌ هَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يَقْضُوا مَا مَضَى مِنْهُ أَوْ يَوْمَهُمُ اَلَّذِي أَسْلَمُوا فِيهِ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَضَاءٌ وَ لاَ يَوْمُهُمْ اَلَّذِي أَسْلَمُوا فِيهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونُوا قَدْ أَسْلَمُوا قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a people who accepted Islam in the month of Ramadan while some days of it had already passed. Is it upon them to make up what had passed of it, or their day on which they accepted Islam?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no making up upon them, nor their day on which they accepted Islam, unless they had accepted Islam before the rising of dawn.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Masada ibn Sadaqa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his fathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say, regarding a man who accepted Islam in the middle of the month of Ramadan; ‘nothing is upon him except what he faces going forward.’”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:» فِي رَجُلٍ أَسْلَمَ فِي اَلنِّصْفِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ مَا يَسْتَقْبِلُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Masada ibn Sadaqa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his fathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say, regarding a man who accepted Islam in the middle of the month of Ramadan; ‘nothing is upon him except what he faces going forward.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 315

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And that which al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who accepted Islam after some days had entered into the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Let him make up what he missed.”
arabicText: وَاَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَسْلَمَ بَعْدَ مَا دَخَلَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَيَّاماً فَقَالَ» لِيَقْضِ مَا فَاتَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And that which al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who accepted Islam after some days had entered into the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Let him make up what he missed.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 316

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
What indicates that is what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mualla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who dies while a debt from the month of Ramadan is upon him, who makes it up on his behalf?’ Imam (a.s) said: “The person most entitled to him.” I (narrator) asked: “Then if the person most entitled to him is a woman?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, only the men.”
arabicText: يَدُلُّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَنْ يَقْضِي عَنْهُ قَالَ» أَوْلَى اَلنَّاسِ بِهِ« قُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَوْلَى اَلنَّاسِ بِهِ اِمْرَأَةً قَالَ» لاَ إِلاَّ اَلرِّجَالُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: What indicates that is what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mualla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who dies while a debt from the month of Ramadan is upon him, who makes it up on his behalf?’ Imam (a.s) said: “The person most entitled to him.” I (narrator) asked: “Then if the person most entitled to him is a woman?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, only the men.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 316

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad, who said:
I (narrator) wrote to the ‘Al Akhir’, the ‘Last One’ (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding ‘a man who died while upon him was the making up of ten days from the month of Ramadan, and he has two guardians. Is it permissible for both of them to make it up on his behalf together, five days by one of the two guardians and five days by the other?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, signed: “The eldest of his two guardians makes up ten consecutive days on his behalf, if Allah (swt) wills.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلْأَخِيرِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَ لَهُ وَلِيَّانِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُمَا أَنْ يَقْضِيَا عَنْهُ جَمِيعاً خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَحَدُ اَلْوَلِيَّيْنِ وَ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ اَلْآخَرُ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» يَقْضِي عَنْهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِيَّيْهِ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ وِلاَءً إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) wrote to the ‘Al Akhir’, the ‘Last One’ (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding ‘a man who died while upon him was the making up of ten days from the month of Ramadan, and he has two guardians. Is it permissible for both of them to make it up on his behalf together, five days by one of the two guardians and five days by the other?’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, signed: “The eldest of his two guardians makes up ten consecutive days on his behalf, if Allah (swt) wills.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 316

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa ibn Mihran, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom the month of Ramadan entered while he was sick and unable to fast, then he died in the month of Ramadan or in the month of Shawwal.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no fasting upon him and no making up on his behalf.” I (narrator) asked: “Then a woman in postnatal bleeding, upon whom the month of Ramadan entered while she was unable to fast, then she died in the month of Ramadan or in Shawwal?” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلصِّيَامِ فَمَاتَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوْ فِي شَهْرِ شَوَّالٍ قَالَ» لاَ صِيَامَ عَلَيْهِ وَ لاَ قَضَاءَ عَنْهُ« قُلْتُ فَامْرَأَةٌ نُفَسَاءُ دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ عَلَيْهَا وَ لَمْ تَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلصَّوْمِ فَمَاتَتْ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَوْ فِي شَوَّالٍ فَقَالَ» لاَ يُقْضَى عَنْهَا«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what Sa’ad ibn Abdullah narrated, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa ibn Mihran, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom the month of Ramadan entered while he was sick and unable to fast, then he died in the month of Ramadan or in the month of Shawwal.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no fasting upon him and no making up on his behalf.” I (narrator) asked: “Then a woman in postnatal bleeding, upon whom the month of Ramadan entered while she was unable to fast, then she died in the month of Ramadan or in Shawwal?” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn Amira, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the sick person in the month of Ramadan who does not recover until he dies.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on his behalf.” (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘the menstruating woman who dies in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلاَ يَصِحُّ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ قَالَ» لاَ يُقْضَى عَنْهُ« وَاَلْحَائِضِ تَمُوتُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» لاَ يُقْضَى عَنْهَا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn Amira, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the sick person in the month of Ramadan who does not recover until he dies.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on his behalf.” (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘the menstruating woman who dies in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Zarif ibn Nasih, from Abu Maryam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “If a man fasts something of the month of Ramadan, then remains sick until he dies, then there is nothing upon him. And if he recovers, then becomes sick until he dies, and he had wealth, charity is given on his behalf. But if he did not have wealth, his guardian gives charity on his behalf.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ ظَرِيفِ بْنِ نَاصِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا صَامَ اَلرَّجُلُ شَيْئاً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ مَرِيضاً حَتَّى يَمُوتَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ إِنْ صَحَّ ثُمَّ مَرِضَ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ وَ كَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ تُصُدِّقَ عَنْهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ تَصَدَّقَ عَنْهُ وَلِيُّهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Zarif ibn Nasih, from Abu Maryam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “If a man fasts something of the month of Ramadan, then remains sick until he dies, then there is nothing upon him. And if he recovers, then becomes sick until he dies, and he had wealth, charity is given on his behalf. But if he did not have wealth, his guardian gives charity on his behalf.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And in the narration of Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mualla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Maryam:
The like of that (in hadith 735), except that Imam (a.s) said: “His guardian fasts on his behalf.”
arabicText: وَفِي رِوَايَةِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ: مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ» صَامَ عَنْهُ وَلِيُّهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And in the narration of Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mualla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Maryam:
thaqalaynMatn: The like of that (in hadith 735), except that Imam (a.s) said: “His guardian fasts on his behalf.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 317

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who became sick in (month of) Ramadan and died in the month of Shawwal, and she instructed me to make it up on her behalf.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Did she recover from her illness?” I (narrator) said: “No, she died in it.” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf, for Allah (swt) did not place it upon her.” I (narrator) asked: “But I desire to make it up on her behalf, and she instructed me to do that.” Imam (a.s) said: “So how can you make up something which Allah (swt) did not place upon her? If you desire to fast for yourself, then fast.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ مَرِضَتْ فِي رَمَضَانَ وَ مَاتَتْ فِي شَهْرِ شَوَّالٍ فَأَوْصَتْنِي أَنْ أَقْضِيَ عَنْهَا قَالَ» هَلْ بَرَأَتْ مِنْ مَرَضِهَا« قُلْتُ لاَ مَاتَتْ فِيهِ قَالَ» لاَ يُقْضَى عَنْهَا فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ لَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَيْهَا« قُلْتُ فَإِنِّي أَشْتَهِي أَنْ أَقْضِيَ عَنْهَا وَ قَدْ أَوْصَتْنِي بِذَلِكَ قَالَ» فَكَيْفَ تَقْضِي شَيْئاً لَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا فَإِنِ اِشْتَهَيْتَ أَنْ تَصُومَ لِنَفْسِكَ فَصُمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who became sick in (month of) Ramadan and died in the month of Shawwal, and she instructed me to make it up on her behalf.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Did she recover from her illness?” I (narrator) said: “No, she died in it.” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not made up on her behalf, for Allah (swt) did not place it upon her.” I (narrator) asked: “But I desire to make it up on her behalf, and she instructed me to do that.” Imam (a.s) said: “So how can you make up something which Allah (swt) did not place upon her? If you desire to fast for yourself, then fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 318

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And also what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who was overtaken by the month of Ramadan while he was sick, then he died before recovering.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him, but it is made up on behalf of the one who recovers and then dies before making it up.”
arabicText: وَ أَيْضاً مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ فَتُوُفِّيَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْرَأَ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَكِنْ يُقْضَى عَنِ اَلَّذِي يَبْرَأُ ثُمَّ يَمُوتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And also what Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who was overtaken by the month of Ramadan while he was sick, then he died before recovering.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him, but it is made up on behalf of the one who recovers and then dies before making it up.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 318

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And also what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated, from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who dies in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not upon his guardian to make up on his behalf what remains of the month. And if he became sick and did not fast (month of) Ramadan, then continued to be sick until (month of) Ramadan passed while he was sick, then died in that illness of his, then it is not upon his guardian to make up the fasting on his behalf. But if he became sick and did not fast the month of Ramadan, then recovered after that and did not make it up, then became sick and died, then it is upon his guardian to make it up on his behalf, because he had recovered and did not make it up, and it became obligatory upon him.”
arabicText: وَ أَيْضاً مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَحْمَدَ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَى وَلِيِّهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ عَنْهُ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ اَلشَّهْرِ وَإِنْ مَرِضَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَزَلْ مَرِيضاً حَتَّى مَضَى رَمَضَانُ وَهُوَ مَرِيضٌ ثُمَّ مَاتَ فِي مَرَضِهِ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَى وَلِيِّهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ عَنْهُ اَلصِّيَامَ فَإِنْ مَرِضَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ صَحَّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَمْ يَقْضِهِ ثُمَّ مَرِضَ فَمَاتَ فَعَلَى وَلِيِّهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ عَنْهُ لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ صَحَّ فَلَمْ يَقْضِ وَ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And also what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated, from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from their father, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who dies in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not upon his guardian to make up on his behalf what remains of the month. And if he became sick and did not fast (month of) Ramadan, then continued to be sick until (month of) Ramadan passed while he was sick, then died in that illness of his, then it is not upon his guardian to make up the fasting on his behalf. But if he became sick and did not fast the month of Ramadan, then recovered after that and did not make it up, then became sick and died, then it is upon his guardian to make it up on his behalf, because he had recovered and did not make it up, and it became obligatory upon him.”

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn al-Rabi, from Sayf ibn Amira, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan and dies.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is made up on his behalf. And if a woman menstruates in (month of) Ramadan and dies, it is not made up on her behalf. And the sick person in (month of) Ramadan who did not recover until he died, it is not made up on his behalf.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلرَّبِيعِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيَمُوتُ قَالَ» يُقْضَى عَنْهُ وَ إِنِ اِمْرَأَةٌ حَاضَتْ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَمَاتَتْ لَمْ يُقْضَ عَنْهَا وَ اَلْمَرِيضُ فِي رَمَضَانَ لَمْ يَصِحَّ حَتَّى مَاتَ لَمْ يُقْضَ عَنْهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn al-Rabi, from Sayf ibn Amira, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who travels in the month of Ramadan and dies.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is made up on his behalf. And if a woman menstruates in (month of) Ramadan and dies, it is not made up on her behalf. And the sick person in (month of) Ramadan who did not recover until he died, it is not made up on his behalf.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 319

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a woman who became sick in the month of Ramadan, or menstruated, or travelled, then died before (month of) Ramadan ended. Is it made up on her behalf?’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for menstruation and sickness, no; but as for travel, yes.”

thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:

Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:

arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:» إِذَا مَاتَ رَجُلٌ وَ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِنْ عِلَّةٍ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ عَنِ اَلشَّهْرِ اَلْأَوَّلِ وَ يَقْضِيَ عَنِ اَلثَّانِي«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I (narrator) asked the one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, about ‘a man who became sick and did not fast until another month of Ramadan overtook him.’ So the Imams (a.s) said: “If he had recovered, then was negligent before the other fast overtook him, he fasts the one that has overtaken him, gives charity for each day with a mudd of food to a needy person, and upon him is its making up. But if he had continued to be sick until another month of Ramadan overtook him, he fasts the one that has overtaken him and gives charity for the first, for each day a mudd to a needy person, and there is no making up upon him.”

thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked the one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, about ‘a man who became sick and did not fast until another month of Ramadan overtook him.’ So the Imams (a.s) said: “If he had recovered, then was negligent before the other fast overtook him, he fasts the one that has overtaken him, gives charity for each day with a mudd of food to a needy person, and upon him is its making up. But if he had continued to be sick until another month of Ramadan overtook him, he fasts the one that has overtaken him and gives charity for the first, for each day a mudd to a needy person, and there is no making up upon him.”

But if he had recovered in between them and did not fast until another month of Ramadan overtook him, he fasts both of them together and gives charity for the first.”

thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who becomes sick, then the month of Ramadan overtakes him, and it passes from him while he is sick, until another month of Ramadan overtakes him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He gives charity for the first, and fasts the second. author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī

And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, and al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there was a portion from the month of Ramadan, then a coming month of Ramadan overtook him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he had recovered in between that, then did not make it up until a coming (month of) Ramadan overtook him, then upon him is that he fast and that he feed a needy person for each day. And if he was sick in between that until a coming month of Ramadan overtook him, then nothing is upon him except fasting if he recovers. But if the illness continued upon him, then upon him is that he feed a needy person for each day.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ اَلْكِنَانِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ طَائِفَةٌ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانٍ قَابِلٌ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ صَحَّ فِيمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَقْضِهِ حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ رَمَضَانٌ قَابِلٌ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَصُومَ وَ أَنْ يُطْعِمَ عَنْ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِيناً وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَرِيضاً فِيمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانٍ قَابِلٌ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ اَلصِّيَامُ إِنْ صَحَّ فَإِنْ تَتَابَعَ اَلْمَرَضُ عَلَيْهِ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُطْعِمَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِيناً«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, and al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:

And if he was sick in between that until a coming month of Ramadan overtook him, then nothing is upon him except fasting if he recovers. But if the illness continued upon him, then upon him is that he feed a needy person for each day.”

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “If a man is sick from (month of) Ramadan to (month of) Ramadan, then recovers, then upon him for each day that he broke the fast is only a redemption: food, and it is a mudd for each needy person.” Imam (a.s) said: “And likewise also in the expiation of an oath and the expiation of zihar, a ‘mudd’, a ‘mudd’ (for each). thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “If a man is sick from (month of) Ramadan to (month of) Ramadan, then recovers, then upon him for each day that he broke the fast is only a redemption: food, and it is a mudd for each needy person.” Imam (a.s) said: “And likewise also in the expiation of an oath and the expiation of zihar, a ‘mudd’, a ‘mudd’ (for each). And if he recovers between the two (months of) Ramadans, then upon him is only that he make up the fast. But if he is negligent regarding it while he has recovered, then upon him are charity and fasting together, for each day a mudd, when he finishes that (month of) Ramadan.”

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And that which al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man whom (month of) Ramadan overtook while upon him was a (month of) Ramadan before that which he had not fasted.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He gives charity in place of each day of the (month of) Ramadan that was upon him with a mudd of food, and let him fast this one that has overtaken him. For I was sick, and three (month of) Ramadans passed over me in which I did not recover, then a (month of) Ramadan overtook me, so I gave charity in place of each day of what had passed with a mudd of food. Then Allah (swt) granted me recovery, and I fasted them.”

thaqalaynSanad: And that which al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man whom (month of) Ramadan overtook while upon him was a (month of) Ramadan before that which he had not fasted.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He gives charity in place of each day of the (month of) Ramadan that was upon him with a mudd of food, and let him fast this one that has overtaken him. Then when he breaks the fast, let him fast the (month of) Ramadan that was upon him. For I was sick, and three (month of) Ramadans passed over me in which I did not recover, then a (month of) Ramadan overtook me, so I gave charity in place of each day of what had passed with a mudd of food. Then Allah (swt) granted me recovery, and I fasted them.”

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadala, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever breaks the fast for something of (month of) Ramadan due to an excuse, then another (month of) Ramadan overtakes him while he is sick, let him give charity with a mudd for each day. As for me, I fasted and gave charity.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» مَنْ أَفْطَرَ شَيْئاً مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فِي عُذْرٍ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَ رَمَضَاناً آخَرَ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِمُدٍّ لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ فَأَمَّا أَنَا فَإِنِّي صُمْتُ وَتَصَدَّقْتُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadala, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever breaks the fast for something of (month of) Ramadan due to an excuse, then another (month of) Ramadan overtakes him while he is sick, let him give charity with a mudd for each day. As for me, I fasted and gave charity.”

chapter: Chapter on One Who Becomes Muslim in Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Reaches Puberty in It, and One Who Dies after Having Fasted Part of It or Not Having Fasted Anything from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abbad ibn Sulayman, from Sa’ad ibn Sa’ad, from a man, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who is sick in the month of Ramadan, then recovers after that, but delays the making up for a year, or less than that, or more. What is upon him in that?’ Imam (a.s) said: “I like for him to hasten the fasting, but if he has delayed it, then there is nothing upon him.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَكُونُ مَرِيضاً فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ يَصِحُّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَيُؤَخِّرُ اَلْقَضَاءَ سَنَةً أَوْ أَقَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ذَلِكَ قَالَ» أُحِبُّ لَهُ تَعْجِيلَ اَلصِّيَامِ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَخَّرَهُ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abbad ibn Sulayman, from Sa’ad ibn Sa’ad, from a man, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who is sick in the month of Ramadan, then recovers after that, but delays the making up for a year, or less than that, or more. What is upon him in that?’ Imam (a.s) said: “I like for him to hasten the fasting, but if he has delayed it, then there is nothing upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a woman who began the morning fasting in (month of) Ramadan, then when the day had risen high, she menstruated.’ Imam (a.s) said: “She breaks the fast.” He (narrator) asked: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who saw purity at the beginning of the day.’” Imam (a.s) said: “She prays, completes her day, and makes it up.”
arabicText: وَ رَوَى اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ أَصْبَحَتْ صَائِمَةً فِي رَمَضَانَ فَلَمَّا اِرْتَفَعَ اَلنَّهَارُ حَاضَتْ قَالَ» تُفْطِرُ« قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ رَأَتِ اَلطُّهْرَ أَوَّلَ اَلنَّهَارِ قَالَ» تُصَلِّي وَ تُتِمُّ يَوْمَهَا وَ تَقْضِي«.
thaqalaynSanad: And al-Husayn ibn Said narrated, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a woman who began the morning fasting in (month of) Ramadan, then when the day had risen high, she menstruated.’ Imam (a.s) said: “She breaks the fast.” He (narrator) asked: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who saw purity at the beginning of the day.’” Imam (a.s) said: “She prays, completes her day, and makes it up.”

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a traveller who entered upon his family before the sun’s decline while he had eaten.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not proper for him to eat anything on that day of his, nor to have intercourse in the month of Ramadan, if he has a wife.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ مُسَافِرٍ دَخَلَ أَهْلَهُ قَبْلَ زَوَالِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ قَدْ أَكَلَ قَالَ» لاَ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ شَيْئاً وَ لاَ يُوَاقِعَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ أَهْلٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaa, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a traveller who entered upon his family before the sun’s decline while he had eaten.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not proper for him to eat anything on that day of his, nor to have intercourse in the month of Ramadan, if he has a wife.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 324

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, who said:
He said regarding ‘the traveller who enters upon his family in the month of Ramadan, and he had eaten before his entry.’ He said: “He refrains from eating for the rest of his day, and upon him is making it up (the fast).” And He said: “Regarding the traveller who enters upon his family while he is in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah) before the sun’s decline, and he had not eaten, then upon him is that he complete his fast, and there is no making up upon him,” meaning if his major ritual impurity (janabah) was from a wet dream (ihtilam).
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ قَالَ: فِي اَلْمُسَافِرِ اَلَّذِي يَدْخُلُ أَهْلَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ قَدْ أَكَلَ قَبْلَ دُخُولِهِ قَالَ» يَكُفُّ عَنِ اَلْأَكْلِ بَقِيَّةَ يَوْمِهِ وَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْقَضَاءُ« وَ قَالَ» فِي اَلْمُسَافِرِ يَدْخُلُ أَهْلَهُ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَكَلَ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ وَ لاَ قَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ« يَعْنِي إِذَا كَانَتْ جَنَابَتُهُ مِنِ اِحْتِلاَمٍ.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: He said regarding ‘the traveller who enters upon his family in the month of Ramadan, and he had eaten before his entry.’ He said: “He refrains from eating for the rest of his day, and upon him is making it up (the fast).” And He said: “Regarding the traveller who enters upon his family while he is in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah) before the sun’s decline, and he had not eaten, then upon him is that he complete his fast, and there is no making up upon him,” meaning if his major ritual impurity (janabah) was from a wet dream (ihtilam).

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 324

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrives from a journey after the afternoon prayer in the month of Ramadan, and he comes upon his wife when she has become pure from menstruation, may he have intercourse with her?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
arabicText: فاما ما رواه سعد بن عبد الله عن محمد بن عيسى بن عبيد عن عثمان بن عيسى عن حريز بن عبد الله عن محمد بن مسلم قال: سألت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن الرجل يقدم من سفر بعد العصر في شهر رمضان فيصيب امرأته حين طهرت من الحيض أيواقعها؟ قال: لا بأس به.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrives from a journey after the afternoon prayer in the month of Ramadan, and he comes upon his wife when she has become pure from menstruation, may he have intercourse with her?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 324

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Samaa, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who arrives from a journey in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he arrives before the sun’s decline, then upon him is the fasting of that day, and he counts it.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» إِنْ قَدِمَ قَبْلَ زَوَالِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَعَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ وَ يَعْتَدُّ بِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Samaa, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who arrives from a journey in the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he arrives before the sun’s decline, then upon him is the fasting of that day, and he counts it.”

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrived from a journey in the month of Ramadan and had not tasted anything before the sun’s decline.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ لَمْ يَطْعَمْ شَيْئاً قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ قَالَ» يَصُومُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrived from a journey in the month of Ramadan and had not tasted anything before the sun’s decline.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts.”

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifaa ibn Musa, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who comes in the month of Ramadan from a journey until he sees that he will enter upon his family in the forenoon or when the day has risen high.’ Imam (a.s) said: “When dawn rises while he is outside and has not entered, then he has the choice: if he wishes, he fasts, and if he wishes, he breaks the fast.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُقْبِلُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ حَتَّى يَرَى أَنَّهُ سَيَدْخُلُ أَهْلَهُ ضَحْوَةً أَوِ اِرْتِفَاعَ اَلنَّهَارِ قَالَ »إِذَا طَلَعَ اَلْفَجْرُ وَ هُوَ خَارِجٌ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ صَامَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifaa ibn Musa, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who comes in the month of Ramadan from a journey until he sees that he will enter upon his family in the forenoon or when the day has risen high.’ Imam (a.s) said: “When dawn rises while he is outside and has not entered, then he has the choice: if he wishes, he fasts, and if he wishes, he breaks the fast.”

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Sick Person Who Breaks the Fast Then Becomes Well during Part of the Day, the Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure, and the Traveller Who Arrives/Traveller Returns
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who arrived from a journey in the month of Ramadan and entered upon his family when morning began or when the day had risen high.’ Imam (a.s) said: “When dawn rises while he is outside and has not entered upon his family, then he has the choice: if he wishes, he fasts, and if he wishes, he breaks the fast.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيَدْخُلُ أَهْلَهُ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ أَوِ اِرْتِفَاعَ اَلنَّهَارِ فَقَالَ» إِذَا طَلَعَ اَلْفَجْرُ وَ هُوَ خَارِجٌ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ أَهْلَهُ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ صَامَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ«.
