chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Forgetful One and the Mistaken One Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man placing his hand upon the body of his wife while he is fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, and if he emits pre-seminal fluid (amadha), it does not break the fast.” He (narrator) said: “And Imam (a.s) said: ‘Do not have intimate relations with them,’” -meaning intercourse (al-ghishyan) in the month of Ramadan during the day.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى جَسَدِ اِمْرَأَتِهِ وَ هُوَ صَائِمٌ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ أَمْذَى فَلاَ يُفْطِرُ« قَالَ» وَ قَالَ» لاٰ تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ« يَعْنِي اَلْغِشْيَانَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِالنَّهَارِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man placing his hand upon the body of his wife while he is fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, and if he emits pre-seminal fluid (amadha), it does not break the fast.” He (narrator) said: “And Imam (a.s) said: ‘Do not have intimate relations with them,’” -meaning intercourse (al-ghishyan) in the month of Ramadan during the day.”

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Forgetful One and the Mistaken One Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who spoke (lustfully) to his wife in the month of Ramadan while he was fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him, and if he emits pre-seminal fluid (amadha), there is nothing upon him. And physical contact has no harm in it, and there is no making up of his day, but he should not expose himself to (lustful intentions) in the (month of) Ramadan.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَلَّمَ اِمْرَأَتَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ صَائِمٌ فَقَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ إِنْ أَمْذَى فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَاَلْمُبَاشَرَةُ لَيْسَ بِهَا بَأْسٌ وَ لاَ قَضَاءُ يَوْمِهِ وَ لاَ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَتَعَرَّضَ لِرَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who spoke (lustfully) to his wife in the month of Ramadan while he was fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him, and if he emits pre-seminal fluid (amadha), there is nothing upon him. And physical contact has no harm in it, and there is no making up of his day, but he should not expose himself to (lustful intentions) in the (month of) Ramadan.”

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Forgetful One and the Mistaken One Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Rifaah ibn Musa, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who touched a slave-girl in the month of Ramadan and emitted pre-seminal fluid (amadha).’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it was unlawful, then let him seek Allah’s (swt) forgiveness, the seeking of forgiveness of one who will never return (to this act), and let him fast a day in place of a day. And if it was from what is lawful, then let him seek Allah’s (swt) forgiveness and not return (to this act), and let him fast a day in place of a day.”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ لاَمَسَ جَارِيَةً فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَأَمْذَى قَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ حَرَاماً فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرِ اَللَّهَ اِسْتِغْفَارَ مَنْ لاَ يَعُودُ أَبَداً وَ يَصُومُ يَوْماً مَكَانَ يَوْمٍ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ حَلاَلٍ فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرِ اَللَّهَ وَ لاَ يَعُودُ وَ يَصُومُ يَوْماً مَكَانَ يَوْمٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Rifaah ibn Musa, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who touched a slave-girl in the month of Ramadan and emitted pre-seminal fluid (amadha).’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it was unlawful, then let him seek Allah’s (swt) forgiveness, the seeking of forgiveness of one who will never return (to this act), and let him fast a day in place of a day. And if it was from what is lawful, then let him seek Allah’s (swt) forgiveness and not return (to this act), and let him fast a day in place of a day.”

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Forgetful One and the Mistaken One Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who plays (foreplays) with his wife in the month of Ramadan until he emits semen.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is the like (verdict) of what is upon the one who has intercourse.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَعْبَثُ بِأَهْلِهِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى يُمْنِيَ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ مِثْلُ مَا عَلَى اَلَّذِي يُجَامِعُ«
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who plays (foreplays) with his wife in the month of Ramadan until he emits semen.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is the like (verdict) of what is upon the one who has intercourse.”

chapter: Chapter on Ruling of the Forgetful One and the Mistaken One Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī

Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who spoke (lustfully) to his wife during the month of Ramadan while he was fasting, and then emitted semen.’ Imam (a.s) said, “There is no harm.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَلَّمَ اِمْرَأَتَهُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ صَائِمٌ فَأَمْنَى فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who spoke (lustfully) to his wife during the month of Ramadan while he was fasting, and then emitted semen.’ Imam (a.s) said, “There is no harm.”

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “If a man owes anything from the fasting of the month of Ramadan, then let him make it up in whichever of the months he wishes, as consecutive days. If he is not able, then let him make it up however he wishes, and let him count the days. If he separates them, that is good, and if he follows them consecutively, that is good.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘What do you think if there remains upon him something from the fasting of (month of) Ramadan, should he make it up in Dhu al-Hijjah?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا كَانَ عَلَى اَلرَّجُلِ شَيْءٌمِنْ صَوْ مِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلْيَقْضِهِ فِي أَيِّ اَلشُّهُورِشَاءَ أَ يَّاماً مُتَتَابِعَةً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَلْيَقْضِهِ كَيْفَ شَاءَ وَ لْيُحْصِ اَ لْأَيَّامَ فَإِنْ فَرَّ قَ فَحَسَنٌ وَ إِنْ تَابَعَ فَحَسَنٌ« قَالَ قُلْتُ أَ رَأَيْتَ إِنْ بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ صَوْ مِ رَمَضَانَ أَ يَقْضِيهِ فِي ذِ ي اَلْحِجَّةِ قَا لَ»نَعَمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “If a man owes anything from the fasting of the month of Ramadan, then let him make it up in whichever of the months he wishes, as consecutive days. If he is not able, then let him make it up however he wishes, and let him count the days. If he separates them, that is good, and if he follows them consecutively, that is good.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘What do you think if there remains upon him something from the fasting of (month of) Ramadan, should he make it up in Dhu al-Hijjah?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 345

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Hammad, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever breaks the fast for any part of the month of Ramadan due to an excuse, then if he makes it up consecutively, it is better, and if he makes it up separately, that is good.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» مَنْ أَفْطَرَ شَيْئاً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي عُذْرٍ فَإِنْ قَضَاهُ مُتَتَابِعاً فَهُوَ أَفْضَلُ وَ إِنْ قَضَاهُ مُتَفَرِّقاً فَحَسَنٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Hammad, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever breaks the fast for any part of the month of Ramadan due to an excuse, then if he makes it up consecutively, it is better, and if he makes it up separately, that is good.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 345

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam, from Sulayman ibn Jafar al-Jafari, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who has days from the month of Ramadan upon him, should he make them up separately?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in separating the making up of the month of Ramadan. The fasting that is not to be separated is only the expiation of zihar (unlawful pre-Islamic practice), the expiation of blood, and the expiation of an oath.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشْيَمَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ اَلْجَعْفَرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ أَيَّامٌ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَ يَقْضِيهَا مُتَفَرِّقَةً قَالَ »لاَ بَأْسَ بِتَفْرِقَةِ قَضَاءِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّمَا اَلصِّيَامُ اَلَّذِي لاَ يُفَرَّقُ كَفَّارَةُ اَلظِّهَارِ وَ كَفَّارَةُ اَلدَّمِ وَ كَفَّارَةُ اَلْيَمِينِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam, from Sulayman ibn Jafar al-Jafari, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who has days from the month of Ramadan upon him, should he make them up separately?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in separating the making up of the month of Ramadan. The fasting that is not to be separated is only the expiation of zihar (unlawful pre-Islamic practice), the expiation of blood, and the expiation of an oath.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 345

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who has days from the month of Ramadan upon him, how should he make them up?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he has two days upon him, then let him break the fast between them for one day. And if he has five upon him, then let him break the fast between them for some days. He does not have the right to fast more than six consecutive days. And if he has eight days or ten upon him, he should break the fast between them for one day.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ أَيَّامٌ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ كَيْفَ يَقْضِيهَا فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَانِ فَلْيُفْطِرْ بَيْنَهُمَا يَوْماً وَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْسَةٌ فَلْيُفْطِرْ بَيْنَهُمَا أَيَّاماً وَ لَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَصُومَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ مُتَوَالِيَةٍ وَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ عَشَرَةٌ أَفْطَرَ بَيْنَهُمَا يَوْماً«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who has days from the month of Ramadan upon him, how should he make them up?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he has two days upon him, then let him break the fast between them for one day. And if he has five upon him, then let him break the fast between them for some days. He does not have the right to fast more than six consecutive days. And if he has eight days or ten upon him, he should break the fast between them for one day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 346

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘making up the month of Ramadan in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah and interrupting it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Make it up in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah, and interrupt it if you wish.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَضَاءِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِي شَهْرِ ذِي اَلْحِجَّةِ وَ أَقْطَعُهُ فَقَالَ» اِقْضِهِ فِي شَهْرِ ذِي اَلْحِجَّةِ وَ اِقْطَعْهُ إِنْ شِئْتَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘making up the month of Ramadan in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah and interrupting it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Make it up in the month of Dhu al-Hijjah, and interrupt it if you wish.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 346

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And that which Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s) said regarding making up the month of Ramadan, ‘If he is not able to fast it continuously, he should separate it. He should not make up the month of Ramadan during the ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah.’”
arabicText: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَضَاءِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنْ كَانَ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى سَرْدِهِ فَرَّقَهُ وَ قَالَ» لاَ يَقْضِي شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فِي عَشْرِ ذِي اَلْحِجَّةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And that which Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s) said regarding making up the month of Ramadan, ‘If he is not able to fast it continuously, he should separate it. He should not make up the month of Ramadan during the ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 346

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Hilal, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who became ill during the month of Ramadan, then when he recovered, he wanted to perform Hajj. What should he do regarding making up the fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “When he returns (from Hajj), let him make it up.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ مَرِضَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَلَمَّا بَرَأَ أَرَادَ اَلْحَجَّ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ بِقَضَاءِ اَلصَّوْمِ فَقَالَ» إِذَا رَجَعَ فَلْيَقْضِهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Hilal, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who became ill during the month of Ramadan, then when he recovered, he wanted to perform Hajj. What should he do regarding making up the fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “When he returns (from Hajj), let him make it up.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there is a portion from the month of Ramadan (of qada fast). May he perform voluntary fasting?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, not until he makes up what is upon him from the month of Ramadan.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ طَائِفَةٌ أَ يَتَطَوَّعُ فَقَالَ» لاَ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there is a portion from the month of Ramadan (of qada fast). May he perform voluntary fasting?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, not until he makes up what is upon him from the month of Ramadan.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there are days from the month of Ramadan; may he perform voluntary fasting?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, not until he makes up what is upon him from the month of Ramadan.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ اَلْكِنَانِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَيَّامٌ أَ يَتَطَوَّعُ فَقَالَ» لاَ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ مَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there are days from the month of Ramadan; may he perform voluntary fasting?’ Imam (a.s) said: “No, not until he makes up what is upon him from the month of Ramadan.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Ibn Sinan, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who is making up (month of) Ramadan, and he becomes in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) from the beginning of the night, and does not perform the ritual bath (ghusl) until the end of the night, while he thinks that dawn has already risen.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He should not fast that day, and he should fast another day instead.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْضِي رَمَضَانَ فَيُجْنِبُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اَللَّيْلِ وَلاَ يَغْتَسِلُ حَتَّى آخِرِ اَللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ يَرَى أَنَّ اَلْفَجْرَ قَدْ طَلَعَ قَالَ» لاَ يَصُومُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ يَصُومُ غَيْرَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who is making up (month of) Ramadan, and he becomes in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) from the beginning of the night, and does not perform the ritual bath (ghusl) until the end of the night, while he thinks that dawn has already risen.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He should not fast that day, and he should fast another day instead.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who forgot, so he ate and drank, then remembered.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He does not break his fast. It is only something that Allah (swt) has provided for him, so let him complete his fast.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ فَأَكَلَ وَ شَرِبَ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ قَالَ» لاَ يُفْطِرُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْءٌ رَزَقَهُ اَللَّهُ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who forgot, so he ate and drank, then remembered.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He does not break his fast. It is only something that Allah (swt) has provided for him, so let him complete his fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: ‘Whoever fasts and then forgets, so he eats and drinks, then he does not break his fast because he forgot. Rather, it is only sustenance which Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has provided for him, so let him complete his fast.’”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ كَانَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» مَنْ صَامَ فَنَسِيَ فَأَكَلَ وَشَرِبَ فَلاَ يُفْطِرُ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ نَسِيَ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ رِزْقٌ رَزَقَهُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: ‘Whoever fasts and then forgets, so he eats and drinks, then he does not break his fast because he forgot. Rather, it is only sustenance which Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, has provided for him, so let him complete his fast.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Wuhayb ibn Hafs, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man fasted one day as a voluntary fast, then ate and drank forgetfully.” Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete that day of his, and there is nothing upon him.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ وُهَيْبِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ صَامَ يَوْماً نَافِلَةً فَأَكَلَ وَ شَرِبَ نَاسِياً قَالَ» يُتِمُّ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Wuhayb ibn Hafs, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man fasted one day as a voluntary fast, then ate and drank forgetfully.” Imam (a.s) said: “He should complete that day of his, and there is nothing upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Hamzah ibn Yala, from al-Barqi, from Ubayd ibn al-Husayn, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “As for voluntary fasting, you may break your fast between yourself and the night whenever you wish. And as for the fasting of making up an obligatory fast, you may break your fast until the decline of the sun (zawal al-shams). Then when the sun has declined, you do not have the right to break your fast.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ يَعْلَى عَنِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» صَوْمُ اَلنَّافِلَةِ لَكَ أَنْ تُفْطِرَ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ اَللَّيْلِ مَتَى مَا شِئْتَ وَ صَوْمُ قَضَاءِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ لَكَ أَنْ تُفْطِرَ إِلَى زَوَالِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَإِذَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ فَلَيْسَ لَكَ أَنْ تُفْطِرَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Hamzah ibn Yala, from al-Barqi, from Ubayd ibn al-Husayn, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “As for voluntary fasting, you may break your fast between yourself and the night whenever you wish. And as for the fasting of making up an obligatory fast, you may break your fast until the decline of the sun (zawal al-shams). Then when the sun has declined, you do not have the right to break your fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Samaah, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a woman who is making up the month of Ramadan, and her husband compels her to break the fast.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not appropriate for him to compel her after the decline of the sun (zawal).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَقْضِي شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فَيُكْرِهُهَا زَوْجُهَا عَلَى اَلْإِفْطَارِ فَقَالَ» لاَ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يُكْرِهَهَا بَعْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Samaah, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a woman who is making up the month of Ramadan, and her husband compels her to break the fast.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is not appropriate for him to compel her after the decline of the sun (zawal).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ibn Sinan, from Uthman ibn Marwan, from Samaah ibn Mihran, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding his statement, ‘The fasting person has the choice until the decline of the sun.’ Imam (a.s) said: “That is regarding the obligatory fast. As for the voluntary fast, he may break the fast at whichever hour he wishes until the setting of the sun.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِهِ اَلصَّائِمُ بِالْخِيَارِ إِلَى زَوَالِ اَلشَّمْسِ قَالَ» إِنَّ ذَلِكَ فِي اَلْفَرِيضَةِ فَأَمَّا اَلنَّافِلَةُ فَلَهُ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شَاءَ إِلَى غُرُوبِ اَلشَّمْسِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ibn Sinan, from Uthman ibn Marwan, from Samaah ibn Mihran, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding his statement, ‘The fasting person has the choice until the decline of the sun.’ Imam (a.s) said: “That is regarding the obligatory fast. As for the voluntary fast, he may break the fast at whichever hour he wishes until the setting of the sun.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from al-Harith ibn Muhammad, from Burayd al-Ijli, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who came (intimate relations) to his wife on a day that he was making up from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he came to his wife before the decline of the sun, then there is nothing upon him except a day in place of a day. And if he came to his wife on a day after the decline of the sun, then upon him is to give charity to ten poor persons. If he is not able, he fasts a day in place of a day, and fasts three days as an expiation for what he did.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْحَارِثِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ فِي يَوْمٍ يَقْضِيهِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ قَبْلَ اَلزَّوَالِ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ يَوْماً مَكَانَ يَوْمٍ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ فِي يَوْمٍ بَعْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ عَلَى عَشَرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ صَامَ يَوْماً مَكَانَ يَوْمٍ وَ صَامَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ كَفَّارَةً لِمَا صَنَعَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from al-Harith ibn Muhammad, from Burayd al-Ijli, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who came (intimate relations) to his wife on a day that he was making up from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he came to his wife before the decline of the sun, then there is nothing upon him except a day in place of a day. And if he came to his wife on a day after the decline of the sun, then upon him is to give charity to ten poor persons. If he is not able, he fasts a day in place of a day, and fasts three days as an expiation for what he did.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Jafar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man had intercourse with his wife while he was making up the month of Ramadan.” Imam (a.s) said: “If he had intercourse with her before the afternoon prayer, then there is nothing upon him; he fasts a day in place of a day. And if he did so after the afternoon prayer, he fasts that day and feeds ten poor persons. If he is not able to do so, he fasts three days as an expiation for that.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ وَقَعَ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ وَ هُوَ يَقْضِي شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ وَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ اَلْعَصْرِ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ يَصُومُ يَوْماً بَدَلَ يَوْمٍ وَ إِنْ فَعَلَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ صَامَ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ أَطْعَمَ عَشَرَةَ مَسَاكِينَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُمْكِنْهُ صَامَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ كَفَّارَةً لِذَلِكَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Jafar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man had intercourse with his wife while he was making up the month of Ramadan.” Imam (a.s) said: “If he had intercourse with her before the afternoon prayer, then there is nothing upon him; he fasts a day in place of a day. And if he did so after the afternoon prayer, he fasts that day and feeds ten poor persons. If he is not able to do so, he fasts three days as an expiation for that.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdillah, from Zurarah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who fasted as a make-up fast from the month of Ramadan, then came (for intimate relations) to women.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him of the expiation is what is upon the one who had intercourse during the month of Ramadan. That day, with Allah (swt), is among the days of Ramadan.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَامَ قَضَاءً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَأَتَى اَلنِّسَاءَ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَلْكَفَّارَةِ مَا عَلَى اَلَّذِي أَصَابَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمُ عِنْدَ اَللَّهِ مِنْ أَيَّامِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdillah, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who fasted as a make-up fast from the month of Ramadan, then came (for intimate relations) to women.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him of the expiation is what is upon the one who had intercourse during the month of Ramadan. That day, with Allah (swt), is among the days of Ramadan.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And that which Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man upon whom there are days from the month of Ramadan, and he wants to make them up; when does he intend the fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He has the choice until the sun declines. Then when the sun has declined, if he had intended the fast, then let him fast, and if he had intended breaking the fast, then let him break the fast.” Imam (a.s) was asked: “If he had intended breaking the fast, is it valid for him to intend the fast after the sun has declined?” Imam (a.s) said: “No.” Imam (a.s) was asked: “If he intended the fast, then broke the fast after the sun had declined?” Imam (a.s) said: “He has done wrong, and there is nothing upon him except making up that day which he had intended to make up.”
arabicText: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع: عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ أَيَّامٌ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقْضِيَهَا مَتَى يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْوِيَ اَلصِّيَامَ قَالَ» هُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِلَى أَنْ تَزُولَ اَلشَّمْسُ فَإِذَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ فَإِنْ كَانَ نَوَى اَلصَّوْمَ فَلْيَصُمْ وَإِنْ كَانَ نَوَى اَلْإِفْطَارَ فَلْيُفْطِرْ« سُئِلَ فَإِنْ كَانَ نَوَى اَلْإِفْطَارَ يَسْتَقِيمُ أَنْ يَنْوِيَ اَلصَّوْمَ بَعْدَ مَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ قَالَ» لاَ« سُئِلَ فَإِنْ نَوَى اَلصَّوْمَ ثُمَّ أَفْطَرَ بَعْدَ مَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ قَالَ» قَدْ أَسَاءَ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ إِلاَّ قَضَاءُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي أَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْضِيَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And that which Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man upon whom there are days from the month of Ramadan, and he wants to make them up; when does he intend the fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He has the choice until the sun declines. Then when the sun has declined, if he had intended the fast, then let him fast, and if he had intended breaking the fast, then let him break the fast.” Imam (a.s) was asked: “If he had intended breaking the fast, is it valid for him to intend the fast after the sun has declined?” Imam (a.s) said: “No.” Imam (a.s) was asked: “If he intended the fast, then broke the fast after the sun had declined?” Imam (a.s) said: “He has done wrong, and there is nothing upon him except making up that day which he had intended to make up.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Bakr ibn Abi Sammak, from Zakariyya al-Mumin, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The one who is making up the month of Ramadan has the choice regarding breaking the fast between himself and when the sun declines, and in voluntary fasting, between himself and when the sun sets.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي سَمَّاكٍ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا اَلْمُؤْمِنِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلَّذِي يَقْضِي شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ هُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ فِي اَلْإِفْطَارِ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ أَنْ تَزُولَ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ فِي اَلتَّطَوُّعِ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ أَنْ تَغِيبَ اَلشَّمْسُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Bakr ibn Abi Sammak, from Zakariyya al-Mumin, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The one who is making up the month of Ramadan has the choice regarding breaking the fast between himself and when the sun declines, and in voluntary fasting, between himself and when the sun sets.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding the one who makes up the month of Ramadan, he has the choice until the decline of the sun. And if it is voluntary (fast), then he has the choice until the night (when the sun sets).”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» فِي اَلَّذِي يَقْضِي شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّهُ بِالْخِيَارِ إِلَى زَوَالِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ تَطَوُّعاً فَإِنَّهُ إِلَى اَللَّيْلِ بِالْخِيَارِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Regarding the one who makes up the month of Ramadan, he has the choice until the decline of the sun. And if it is voluntary (fast), then he has the choice until the night (when the sun sets).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated, from Harun ibn Muslim and Sadan, from Masadah ibn Sadaqah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
Imams (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘The one fasting voluntarily has the choice between himself and midday. Then when the day reaches its middle, the fast has become obligatory.’”
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ سَعْدَانَ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلصَّائِمُ تَطَوُّعاً بِالْخِيَارِ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ نِصْفِ اَلنَّهَارِ فَإِذَا اِنْتَصَفَ اَلنَّهَارُ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ اَلصَّوْمُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: As for what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated, from Harun ibn Muslim and Sadan, from Masadah ibn Sadaqah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: Imams (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘The one fasting voluntarily has the choice between himself and midday. Then when the day reaches its middle, the fast has become obligatory.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting is upon the boy when he has a wet dream (ihtilam). And fasting and the head-covering (khimar) are upon the girl are when she menstruates, unless she is owned, for there is no head-covering upon her (the bond girl) unless she wishes to cover herself with a head-covering (takhtamir), and fasting is upon her.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» عَلَى اَلصَّبِيِّ إِذَا اِحْتَلَمَ اَلصِّيَامُ وَ عَلَى اَلْجَارِيَةِ إِذَا حَاضَتِ اَلصِّيَامُ وَاَلْخِمَارُ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَمْلُوكَةً فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا خِمَارٌ إِلاَّ أَنْ تُحِبَّ أَنْ تَخْتَمِرَ وَ عَلَيْهَا اَلصِّيَامُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting is upon the boy when he has a wet dream (ihtilam). And fasting and the head-covering (khimar) are upon the girl are when she menstruates, unless she is owned, for there is no head-covering upon her (the bond girl) unless she wishes to cover herself with a head-covering (takhtamir), and fasting is upon her.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Ismail ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “The boy, when he is able to fast three consecutive days, then the fasting of the month of Ramadan has become obligatory upon him.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلصَّبِيُّ إِذَا أَطَاقَ أَنْ يَصُومَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ مُتَتَابِعَةٍ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Ismail ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The boy, when he is able to fast three consecutive days, then the fasting of the month of Ramadan has become obligatory upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “We command our boys (the Ahlul Bayt) to fast when they are sons of seven years, according to what they are able of fasting the day, whether it is until midday, or more than that, or less. Then when thirst and hunger overcome them, they break the fast, until they become accustomed to fasting and are able to bear it. So command your boys, when they are sons of nine years, according to what they are able of fasting, then when thirst overcomes them, they break the fast.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» إِنَّا نَأْمُرُ صِبْيَانَنَا بِالصِّيَامِ إِذَا كَانُوا بَنِي سَبْعِ سِنِينَ بِمَا أَطَاقُوا مِنْ صِيَامِ اَلْيَوْمِ فَإِنْ كَانَ إِلَى نِصْفِ اَلنَّهَارِ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَوْ أَقَلَّ فَإِذَا غَلَبَهُمُ اَلْعَطَشُ وَاَلْغَرَثُ أَفْطَرُوا حَتَّى يَتَعَوَّدُوا اَلصِّيَامَ وَيُطِيقُوهُ فَمُرُوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ إِذَا كَانُوا بَنِي تِسْعِ سِنِينَ مَا أَطَاقُوا مِنْ صِيَامٍ فَإِذَا غَلَبَهُمُ اَلْعَطَشُ أَفْطَرُوا«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “We command our boys (the Ahlul Bayt) to fast when they are sons of seven years, according to what they are able of fasting the day, whether it is until midday, or more than that, or less. Then when thirst and hunger overcome them, they break the fast, until they become accustomed to fasting and are able to bear it. So command your boys, when they are sons of nine years, according to what they are able of fasting, then when thirst overcomes them, they break the fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated that, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Riab, from Samaah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the woman with irregular bleeding (mustahadah).’ Imam (a.s) said: “She fasts the month of Ramadan except for the days in which she used to menstruate, then she makes them up afterwards.”
arabicText: رَوَى ذَلِكَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ» تَصُومُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ إِلاَّ اَلْأَيَّامَ اَلَّتِي كَانَتْ تَحِيضُ فِيهِنَّ ثُمَّ تَقْضِيَنَّهَا بَعْدُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated that, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Riab, from Samaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the woman with irregular bleeding (mustahadah).’ Imam (a.s) said: “She fasts the month of Ramadan except for the days in which she used to menstruate, then she makes them up afterwards.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah ibn Mihran, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there is the fasting of two consecutive months, may he separate between the days?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he has fasted more than a month and joined it, then an affair occurred for him and he broke the fast, there is no harm. But if it was less than a month or a month, then upon him is to repeat the fasting.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ صَوْمُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ أَ يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ اَلْأَيَّامِ فَقَالَ» إِذَا صَامَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ فَوَصَلَهُ ثُمَّ عَرَضَ لَهُ أَمْرٌ فَأَفْطَرَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَقَلَّ مِنْ شَهْرٍ أَوْ شَهْراً فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ اَلصِّيَامَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah ibn Mihran, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there is the fasting of two consecutive months, may he separate between the days?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he has fasted more than a month and joined it, then an affair occurred for him and he broke the fast, there is no harm. But if it was less than a month or a month, then upon him is to repeat the fasting.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting of the expiation of the oath in zihar is two consecutive months, and consecutiveness is that he fasts a month and fasts from the other some days or something from it. Then if something occurs to him from which he breaks the fast, he breaks the fast, then makes up what remains upon him. And if he fasts a month, then something occurs to him, so he breaks the fast before fasting anything from the other, then he has not maintained consecutiveness, so let him repeat the entire fast.” And Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting of three days in the expiation of an oath is consecutive, and they are not to be separated.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» صِيَامُ كَفَّارَةِ اَلْيَمِينِ فِي اَلظِّهَارِ شَهْرَانِ مُتَتَابِعَانِ وَ اَلتَّتَابُعُ أَنْ يَصُومَ شَهْراً وَ يَصُومَ مِنَ اَلْآخَرِ أَيَّاماً أَوْ شَيْئاً مِنْهُ فَإِنْ عَرَضَ لَهُ شَيْءٌ يُفْطَرُ مِنْهُ أَفْطَرَ ثُمَّ قَضَى مَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ صَامَ شَهْراً ثُمَّ عَرَضَ لَهُ شَيْءٌ فَأَفْطَرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَصُومَ مِنَ اَلْآخَرِ شَيْئاً فَلَمْ يُتَابِعْ فَلْيُعِدِ اَلصَّوْمَ كُلَّهُ« وَ قَالَ» صِيَامُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي كَفَّارَةِ اَلْيَمِينِ مُتَتَابِعَاتٌ وَ لاَ يُفْصَلُ بَيْنَهُنَّ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting of the expiation of the oath in zihar is two consecutive months, and consecutiveness is that he fasts a month and fasts from the other some days or something from it. Then if something occurs to him from which he breaks the fast, he breaks the fast, then makes up what remains upon him. And if he fasts a month, then something occurs to him, so he breaks the fast before fasting anything from the other, then he has not maintained consecutiveness, so let him repeat the entire fast.” And Imam (a.s) said: “The fasting of three days in the expiation of an oath is consecutive, and they are not to be separated.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was asked regarding ‘a man who fasted in (expiation for) zihar during Shaban, then the month of Ramadan overtook him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts the month of Ramadan and begins the fast anew. But if he fasted in (expiation for) zihar and exceeded half (one month) by one day, he builds upon it and makes up the remainder.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي رَجُلٍ صَامَ فِي ظِهَارٍ شَعْبَانَ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَهُ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» يَصُومُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَيَسْتَأْنِفُ اَلصَّوْمَ فَإِنْ صَامَ فِي اَلظِّهَارِ فَزَادَ فِي اَلنِّصْفِ يَوْماً بَنَى وَ قَضَى بَقِيَّتَهُ«
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked regarding ‘a man who fasted in (expiation for) zihar during Shaban, then the month of Ramadan overtook him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts the month of Ramadan and begins the fast anew. But if he fasted in (expiation for) zihar and exceeded half (one month) by one day, he builds upon it and makes up the remainder.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail ibn Marrar and Abd al-Jabbar ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there was the fasting of two consecutive months, so he fasted twenty-five days, then became ill. When he recovers, should he build upon his fast, or repeat his entire (sequence of) fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, he builds upon what he had fasted.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “This is from what Allah (swt) has overcome him with, and there is nothing upon one regarding what Allah (swt), the Majestic, has overcome him with.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ وَعَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ بْنِ اَلْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فَصَامَ خَمْسَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً ثُمَّ مَرِضَ فَإِذَا بَرَأَ أَ يَبْنِي عَلَى صَوْمِهِ أَمْ يُعِيدُ صَوْمَهُ كُلَّهُ فَقَالَ» بَلْ يَبْنِي عَلَى مَا كَانَ صَامَ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» هَذَا مِمَّا غَلَبَ اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى مَا غَلَبَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail ibn Marrar and Abd al-Jabbar ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there was the fasting of two consecutive months, so he fasted twenty-five days, then became ill. When he recovers, should he build upon his fast, or repeat his entire (sequence of) fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, he builds upon what he had fasted.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “This is from what Allah (swt) has overcome him with, and there is nothing upon one regarding what Allah (swt), the Majestic, has overcome him with.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr and Fadalah, from Rifaah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there is the fasting of two consecutive months, so he fasted a month and became ill.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He builds upon it (the days he has already fasted); Allah (swt) detained him (in the illness).” I (narrator) asked: “A woman upon whom there was the fasting of two consecutive months, so she fasted, then broke the fast during the days of her menstruation.” Imam (a.s) said: “She makes them up.” – meaning the days she missed. I (narrator) asked: “Then if she makes them up, and thereafter her menstruation ceases altogether?” Imam (a.s) said: “She does not repeat them; that suffices her.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَم عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فَصَامَ شَهْراً وَ مَرِضَ قَالَ» يَبْنِي عَلَيْهِ اَللَّهُ حَبَسَهُ« قُلْتُ اِمْرَأَةٌ كَانَ عَلَيْهَا صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فَصَامَتْ فَأَفْطَرَتْ أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا قَالَ» تَقْضِيهَا« قُلْتُ فَإِنْ قَضَتْهَا ثُمَّ يَئِسَتْ مِنَ اَلْحَيْضِ قَالَ» لاَ تُعِيدُهَا أَجْزَأَهَا ذَلِكَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr and Fadalah, from Rifaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man upon whom there is the fasting of two consecutive months, so he fasted a month and became ill.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He builds upon it (the days he has already fasted); Allah (swt) detained him (in the illness).” I (narrator) asked: “A woman upon whom there was the fasting of two consecutive months, so she fasted, then broke the fast during the days of her menstruation.” Imam (a.s) said: “She makes them up.” – meaning the days she missed. I (narrator) asked: “Then if she makes them up, and thereafter her menstruation ceases altogether?” Imam (a.s) said: “She does not repeat them; that suffices her.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said the like of that (in hadith 859).
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said the like of that (in hadith 859).

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And that which Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all together from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil and Muhammad ibn Humran, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a free man upon whom the fasting of two consecutive months becomes binding in zihar, so he fasts a month, then becomes ill.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He begins anew (two consecutive months). But if he exceeded the other month by one day or two days, he builds upon what remains.”
arabicText: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ اَلْحُرِّ يَلْزَمُهُ صَوْمُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فِي ظِهَارٍ فَيَصُومُ شَهْراً ثُمَّ يَمْرَضُ قَالَ» يَسْتَقْبِلُ فَإِنْ زَادَ عَلَى اَلشَّهْرِ اَلْآخَرِ يَوْماً أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ بَنَى عَلَى مَا بَقِيَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And that which Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all together from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil and Muhammad ibn Humran, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a free man upon whom the fasting of two consecutive months becomes binding in zihar, so he fasts a month, then becomes ill.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He begins anew (two consecutive months). But if he exceeded the other month by one day or two days, he builds upon what remains.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And what al-Husayn ibn Said also narrated, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘interrupting the fasting of the expiation of an oath, the expiation of zihar, and the expiation of blood.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If a man has upon him the fasting of two consecutive months, then he breaks the fast or becomes ill in the first month, then upon him is to repeat the fasting. But if he fasted the first month and fasted something (by even a day) from the second month, then something occurs to him for which he has an excuse, then upon him is only to make it up.”
arabicText: وَ مَا رَوَاهُ أَيْضاً اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَطْعِ صَوْمِ كَفَّارَةِ اَلْيَمِينِ وَكَفَّارَةِ اَلظِّهَارِ وَكَفَّارَةِ اَلدَّمِ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فَأَفْطَرَ أَوْ مَرِضَ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ اَلْأَوَّلِ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ اَلصِّيَامَ وَإِنْ صَامَ اَلشَّهْرَ اَلْأَوَّلَ وَصَامَ مِنَ اَلشَّهْرِ اَلثَّانِي شَيْئاً ثُمَّ عَرَضَ لَهُ مَالَهُ اَلْعُذْرُ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And what al-Husayn ibn Said also narrated, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘interrupting the fasting of the expiation of an oath, the expiation of zihar, and the expiation of blood.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If a man has upon him the fasting of two consecutive months, then he breaks the fast or becomes ill in the first month, then upon him is to repeat the fasting. But if he fasted the first month and fasted something (by even a day) from the second month, then something occurs to him for which he has an excuse, then upon him is only to make it up.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on Making Up the Month of Ramadan, and the Ruling of One Who Breaks the Fast in It Intentionally and Forgetfully, and One upon Whom Fasting Two Consecutive Months Is Obligatory and He Breaks the Fast during Them, or upon Whom There Is a Vow Regarding Fasting
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who made upon himself the fasting of a month, so he fasted fifteen days from it, then an affair occurred for him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he had fasted fifteen days, then he may make up what remains upon him. But if it was less than fifteen days, it would not suffice him until he fasts a complete month.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ جَعَلَ عَلَيْهِ صَوْمَ شَهْرٍ فَصَامَ مِنْهُ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً ثُمَّ عَرَضَ لَهُ أَمْرٌ قَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ صَامَ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً فَلَهُ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ مَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً لَمْ يُجْزِهِ حَتَّى يَصُومَ شَهْراً تَامّاً«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who made upon himself the fasting of a month, so he fasted fifteen days from it, then an affair occurred for him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he had fasted fifteen days, then he may make up what remains upon him. But if it was less than fifteen days, it would not suffice him until he fasts a complete month.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 357
