chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting the days of al-Tashriq.’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for in the cities, there is no problem, but as for in Mina, then no.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صِيَامِ أَيَّامِ اَلتَّشْرِيقِ فَقَالَ» أَمَّا بِالْأَمْصَارِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ أَمَّا بِمِنًى فَلاَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting the days of al-Tashriq.’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for in the cities, there is no problem, but as for in Mina, then no.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 373

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from one who narrated it, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Continuous joining (sawm al-wisal) in fasting is that he makes his dinner his pre-dawn meal (suhur).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَمَّنْ رَوَاهُ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» اَلْوِصَالُ فِي اَلصِّيَامِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ عَشَاءَهُ سَحُورَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from one who narrated it, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Continuous joining (sawm al-wisal) in fasting is that he makes his dinner his pre-dawn meal (suhur).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 373

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from them, peace be upon them:
They said: “When you break the fast from (month of) Ramadan, then you must not fast voluntarily after al-Fitr except after three days have passed.”
arabicText: وَاَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْهُمْ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» إِذَا أَفْطَرْتَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَلاَ تَصُومَنَّ بَعْدَ اَلْفِطْرِ تَطَوُّعاً إِلاَّ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ يَمْضِينَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal narrated, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from them, peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: They said: “When you break the fast from (month of) Ramadan, then you must not fast voluntarily after al-Fitr except after three days have passed.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 373

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting the day of Arafah is equal to the year.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Imam al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, did not fast (day of Arafah), and Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, fasted (day of Arafah).”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» صَوْمُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ يَعْدِلُ اَلسَّنَةَ« وَ قَالَ» لَمْ يَصُمْهُ اَلْحَسَنُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ صَامَهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting the day of Arafah is equal to the year.” And Imam (a.s) said: “Imam al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, did not fast (day of Arafah), and Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, fasted (day of Arafah).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 373

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Sulayman al-Jafari, who said:
I (narrator) heard Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, used to fast the day of Arafah on the hot day at the standing place, and He (a.s) would command that an elevated shade be set up for him, so it would be erected for him, and He (a.s) would wash himself because of the heat that reached him.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ اَلْجَعْفَرِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَصُومُ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ فِي اَلْيَوْمِ اَلْحَارِّ فِي اَلْمَوْقِفِ وَ يَأْمُرُ بِظِلٍّ مُرْتَفِعٍ فَيُضْرَبُ لَهُ فَيَغْتَسِلُ مِمَّا يَبْلُغُ مِنْهُ اَلْحَرُّ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Sulayman al-Jafari, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, used to fast the day of Arafah on the hot day at the standing place, and He (a.s) would command that an elevated shade be set up for him, so it would be erected for him, and He (a.s) would wash himself because of the heat that reached him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 374

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from their father, from Thalabah ibn Maymun, from Muhammad ibn Qays, who said:
I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not fast the day of Arafah from the time the fasting of the month of Ramadan was revealed.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَحْمَدَ اِبْنَيِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ لَمْ يَصُمْ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ مُنْذُ نَزَلَ صِيَامُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad and Ahmad, the two sons of al-Hasan, from their father, from Thalabah ibn Maymun, from Muhammad ibn Qays, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, did not fast the day of Arafah from the time the fasting of the month of Ramadan was revealed.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 374

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘fasting the day of Arafah’, And I asked: “May I be made your ransom, they claim that it is equal to fasting a year.” Imam (a.s) said: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, would not fast it.” I (narrator) asked: “And why is that?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, the day of Arafah is a day of supplication and asking, and I fear that it would weaken me from supplication, and I dislike fasting it, and I fear that Arafah may be the day of Adha, so it is not a day of fasting.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّهُمْ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُ يَعْدِلُ صَوْمَ سَنَةٍ قَالَ» كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ لاَ يَصُومُهُ« قُلْتُ وَ لِمَ ذَاكَ قَالَ» إِنَّ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ يَوْمُ دُعَاءٍ وَ مَسْأَلَةٍ وَ أَتَخَوَّفُ أَنْ يُضْعِفَنِي عَنِ اَلدُّعَاءِ وَ أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَصُومَهُ وَ أَتَخَوَّفُ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَرَفَةُ يَوْمَ أَضْحًى فَلَيْسَ بِيَوْمِ صَوْمٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘fasting the day of Arafah’, And I asked: “May I be made your ransom, they claim that it is equal to fasting a year.” Imam (a.s) said: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, would not fast it.” I (narrator) asked: “And why is that?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, the day of Arafah is a day of supplication and asking, and I fear that it would weaken me from supplication, and I dislike fasting it, and I fear that Arafah may be the day of Adha, so it is not a day of fasting.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 374

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about’ fasting the day of Arafah.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever has strength for it, then it is good, if it does not prevent you from supplication, for it is a day of supplication and asking, so fast it. And if you fear that you will become weak from that, then do not fast it.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ قَالَ» مَنْ قَوِيَ عَلَيْهِ فَحَسَنٌ إِنْ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ مِنَ اَلدُّعَاءِ فَإِنَّهُ يَوْمُ دُعَاءٍ وَمَسْأَلَةٍ فَصُمْهُ وَإِنْ خَشِيتَ أَنْ تَضْعُفَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ تَصُمْهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about’ fasting the day of Arafah.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Whoever has strength for it, then it is good, if it does not prevent you from supplication, for it is a day of supplication and asking, so fast it. And if you fear that you will become weak from that, then do not fast it.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 374

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Masadah ibn Sadaqah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
The Imams (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said, ‘Fast Ashura, the ninth and the tenth (of Muharram), for it expiates the sins of a year.’”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» صُومُوا اَلْعَاشُورَاءَ اَلتَّاسِعَ وَاَلْعَاشِرَ فَإِنَّهُ يُكَفِّرُ ذُنُوبَ سَنَةٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Masadah ibn Sadaqah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imams (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said, ‘Fast Ashura, the ninth and the tenth (of Muharram), for it expiates the sins of a year.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 375

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, fasted the day of Ashura.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» صَامَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, fasted the day of Ashura.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 375

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Jafar, from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah, from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
The Imams (a.s) said: “Fasting the day of Ashura is the expiation of a year.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِاَللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ اَلْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» صِيَامُ يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ كَفَّارَةُ سَنَةٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Jafar, from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah, from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imams (a.s) said: “Fasting the day of Ashura is the expiation of a year.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 375

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman al-Ahmar, from Kathir al-Nawwa, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The ark came to rest on the day of Ashura (tenth of Muharram) upon al-Judi, so Nuh (a.s), peace be upon him, commanded those who were with him from the jinn and mankind to fast that day.” And Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Do you know what this day is? This is the day on which Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, turned in repentance toward Adam (a.s) and Hawwa (s.a), peace be upon her; And this is the day on which the Majestic Allah (swt) split the sea for the Children of Israel, so Allah (swt) drowned Firaun and those with him; And this is the day on which Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, overcame Firaun; And this is the day on which Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, was born; And this is the day on which Allah (swt) turned in repentance toward the people of Prophet Yunus (a.s), peace be upon him; And this is the day on which Isa ibn Maryam (a.s), peace be upon him, was born; And this is the day on which al-Qaim (ajf), peace be upon him, will rise.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ اَلْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ اَلنَّوَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لَزِقَتِ اَلسَّفِينَةُ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ عَلَى اَلْجُودِيِّ فَأَمَرَ نُوحٌ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ اَلْجِنِّ وَ اَلْإِنْسِ أَنْ يَصُومُوا ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ« وَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» أَ تَدْرُونَ مَا هَذَا اَلْيَوْمُ هَذَا اَلْيَوْمُ اَلَّذِي تَابَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِيهِ عَلَى آدَمَ وَ حَوَّاءَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ هَذَا اَلْيَوْمُ اَلَّذِي فَلَقَ اَللَّهُ فِيهِ اَلْبَحْرَ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَأَغْرَقَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَنْ مَعَهُ وَ هَذَا اَلْيَوْمُ اَلَّذِي غَلَبَ فِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هَذَا اَلْيَوْمُ اَلَّذِي وُلِدَ فِيهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَهَذَا اَلْيَوْمُ اَلَّذِي تَابَ اَللَّهُ فِيهِ عَلَى قَوْمِ يُونُسَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَهَذَا اَلْيَوْمُ اَلَّذِي وُلِدَ فِيهِ عِيسَى اِبْنُ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ هَذَا اَلْيَوْمُ اَلَّذِي يَقُومُ فِيهِ اَلْقَائِمُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman al-Ahmar, from Kathir al-Nawwa, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The ark came to rest on the day of Ashura (tenth of Muharram) upon al-Judi, so Nuh (a.s), peace be upon him, commanded those who were with him from the jinn and mankind to fast that day.” And Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Do you know what this day is? This is the day on which Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, turned in repentance toward Adam (a.s) and Hawwa (s.a), peace be upon her; And this is the day on which the Majestic Allah (swt) split the sea for the Children of Israel, so Allah (swt) drowned Firaun and those with him; And this is the day on which Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, overcame Firaun; And this is the day on which Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, was born; And this is the day on which Allah (swt) turned in repentance toward the people of Prophet Yunus (a.s), peace be upon him; And this is the day on which Isa ibn Maryam (a.s), peace be upon him, was born; And this is the day on which al-Qaim (ajf), peace be upon him, will rise.”

chapter: Chapter on Categories of Fasting and the Explanation of All of Them with Clarification
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Nuh ibn Shuayb al-Naysaburi, from Yasin al-Darir, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
The Imams (a.s) both said: “Do not fast the day of Ashura (tenth of Muharram), nor the day of Arafah in Mecca, nor in Madinah, nor in your homeland, nor in any city from among the cities.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ نُوحِ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ اَلنَّيْسَابُورِيِّ عَنْ يَاسِينَ اَلضَّرِيرِ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالاَ:» لاَ تَصُمْ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ وَ لاَ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ بِمَكَّةَ وَ لاَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَ لاَ فِي وَطَنِكَ وَ لاَ فِي مِصْرٍ مِنَ اَلْأَمْصَارِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Nuh ibn Shuayb al-Naysaburi, from Yasin al-Darir, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far (a.s) from his father, Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imams (a.s) both said: “Do not fast the day of Ashura (tenth of Muharram), nor the day of Arafah in Mecca, nor in Madinah, nor in your homeland, nor in any city from among the cities.”

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Hashimi, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from al-Washsha, who said: Najiyyah ibn al-Harith al-Attar narrated to me, saying:
I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting the day of Ashura.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is a fast abandoned by the coming down of the month of Ramadan, and (doing) the abandoned is an innovation.” Najiyyah said: “Then I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about that after his father (a.s), peace be upon him, and Imam (a.s) answered with the like of the answer of his father (a.s).” Then Imam (a.s) said to me: “Indeed, it is the fast of a day concerning which no Book came down and no Sunnah took place, except the Sunnah of the family of Ziyad, may Allah (swt) curse them, through the killing of Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s), may the blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَجِيَّةُ بْنُ اَلْحَارِثِ اَلْعَطَّارُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ فَقَالَ» صَوْمٌ مَتْرُوكٌ بِنُزُولِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَاَلْمَتْرُوكُ بِدْعَةٌ« قَالَ نَجِيَّةُ فَسَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَأَجَابَ بِمِثْلِ جَوَابِ أَبِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي» أَمَا إِنَّهُ صِيَامُ يَوْمٍ مَا نَزَلَ بِهِ كِتَابٌ وَ لاَ جَرَتْ بِهِ سُنَّةٌ إِلاَّ سُنَّةُ آلِ زِيَادٍ لَعَنَهُمُ اَللَّهُ بِقَتْلِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ صَلَوَاتُُ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Hashimi, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from al-Washsha, who said: Najiyyah ibn al-Harith al-Attar narrated to me, saying:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting the day of Ashura.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It is a fast abandoned by the coming down of the month of Ramadan, and (doing) the abandoned is an innovation.” Najiyyah said: “Then I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about that after his father (a.s), peace be upon him, and Imam (a.s) answered with the like of the answer of his father (a.s).” Then Imam (a.s) said to me: “Indeed, it is the fast of a day concerning which no Book came down and no Sunnah took place, except the Sunnah of the family of Ziyad, may Allah (swt) curse them, through the killing of Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s), may the blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him.”

And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Hashimi, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, who said: Jafar ibn Isa, my brother, narrated to us, saying:
I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting the day of Ashura and what the people say regarding it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Are you asking me about the fast of Ibn Marjanah, may Allah (swt) curse him? That is a day which none fasted except the claimants from the family of Ziyad through the killing of Imam al-Husayn (a.s), may the blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him. And it is a day by which the family of Muhammad (saws) regarded as ill-omened. And it is a day by which the people of Islam regard as ill-omened. And the day which Islam and its people regard as ill-omened is not fasted and is not treated as blessed. And Monday is a day of misfortune, on which Allah (swt) took His blessed Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and the family of Prophet Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them, were not afflicted except on Monday, so we regarded it as ill-omened, and our enemies treated it as blessed. And the day of Ashura, Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, was killed, and Ibn Marjanah treated it as blessed, and the family of Prophet Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them, regarded it as ill-omened. So whoever fasts the two of them (Mondays and Ashura) and treats the two of them as blessed will meet Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, with the heart wiped out, and his place of gathering will be with those who established fasting the two of them (Mondays and Ashura) and treated the two of them as blessed.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عِيسَى أَخِي قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ وَ مَا يَقُولُ اَلنَّاسُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ» عَنْ صَوْمِ اِبْنِ مَرْجَانَةَ لَعَنَهُ اَللَّهُ تَسْأَلُنِي ذَلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَا صَامَهُ إِلاَّ اَلْأَدْعِيَاءُ مِنْ آلِ زِيَادٍ بِقَتْلِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ صَلَوَاتُُ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ يَوْمٌ تَشَاءَمَ بِهِ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ يَتَشَاءَمُ بِهِ أَهْلُ اَلْإِسْلاَمِ وَ اَلْيَوْمُ اَلْمُتَشَائِمُ بِهِ اَلْإِسْلاَمُ وَ أَهْلُهُ لاَ يُصَامُ وَ لاَ يُتَبَرَّكُ بِهِ وَ يَوْمُ اَلْإِثْنَيْنِ يَوْمُ نَحْسٍ قَبَضَ اَللَّهُ فِيهِ نَبِيَّهُ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَ مَا أُصِيبَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِلاَّ فِي يَوْمِ اَلْإِثْنَيْنِ فَتَشَاءَمْنَا بِهِ وَ تَبَرَّكَ بِهِ أَعْدَاؤُنَا وَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ قُتِلَ اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ تَبَرَّكَ بِهِ اِبْنُ مَرْجَانَةَ وَ تَشَاءَمَ بِهِ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَمَنْ صَامَهُمَا وَتَبَرَّكَ بِهِمَا لَقِيَ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مَمْسُوحَ اَلْقَلْبِ وَ كَانَ مَحْشَرُهُ مَعَ اَلَّذِينَ سَنُّوا صَوْمَهُمَا وَ تَبَرَّكُوا بِهِمَا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Hashimi, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, who said: Jafar ibn Isa, my brother, narrated to us, saying:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting the day of Ashura and what the people say regarding it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Are you asking me about the fast of Ibn Marjanah, may Allah (swt) curse him? And it is a day by which the family of Muhammad (saws) regarded as ill-omened. And it is a day by which the people of Islam regard as ill-omened. And the day which Islam and its people regard as ill-omened is not fasted and is not treated as blessed. And Monday is a day of misfortune, on which Allah (swt) took His blessed Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and the family of Prophet Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them, were not afflicted except on Monday, so we regarded it as ill-omened, and our enemies treated it as blessed. And the day of Ashura, Imam al-Husayn (a.s), peace be upon him, was killed, and Ibn Marjanah treated it as blessed, and the family of Prophet Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them, regarded it as ill-omened. So whoever fasts the two of them (Mondays and Ashura) and treats the two of them as blessed will meet Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, with the heart wiped out, and his place of gathering will be with those who established fasting the two of them (Mondays and Ashura) and treated the two of them as blessed.”

And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Hashimi, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated to me, from Zayd al-Narsi, who said: Ubayd ibn Zurarah narrated to us, saying:

thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Hashimi, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated to me, from Zayd al-Narsi, who said: Ubayd ibn Zurarah narrated to us, saying:

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Three Days in Every Month and What Has Come Concerning That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mualla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam (a.s) saying: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, fasted until it was said: 'he does not break the fast; (meaning that the blessed Prophet (saws) is always fasting) Then the Prophet (saws) broke the fast until it was said: ‘he does not fast’; (meaning that the blessed Prophet (saws) does not fast at all) Then the Prophet (saws) fasted the fast of Dawud (a.s), peace be upon him; one day and one day not; Then the Prophet (saws), peace be upon him, was taken (died) while upon fasting three days in the month.” And the Imam (a.s) said: “(fasting three days in a month) equal the fasting of the lifetime, and they remove the rancor (wahar) of the chest.” Hammad said: “So I asked: What is al-wahar?” Imam (a.s) said: “Al-wahar is whispering (al-waswasah).” Hammad said: “So I asked: ‘Which days are they?’” Imam (a.s) said: “The first Thursday in the month, and the first Wednesday after the tenth (of the month), and the last Thursday in it.” So I (narrator) replied: “Why did these become the days that are fasted?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, those before us from the nations, when punishment descended upon one of them, it descended on these feared days.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُو لُ: »صَامَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ص حَتَّى قِيلَ مَا يُفْطِرُ ثُمَّ أَفْطَرَ حَتَّى قِيلَ مَ ا يَصُومُ ثُمَّ صَا مَ صَوْمَ دَ اوُدَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَوْ ماً وَ يَوْماً لاَ ثُمَّ قُبِضَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى صِيَامِ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ وَ قَالَ »يَعْدِلْنَ صَوْمَ اَلدَّهْرِ وَ يَذْهَبْنَ بِوَحَرِ اَلصَّدْرِ«« قَالَ حَمَّادٌ فَقُلْتُ فَمَا اَلْوَحَرُ فَقَالَ» اَلْوَحَرُ اَلْوَسْوَسَةُ« قَالَ حَمَّادٌ فَقُلْتُ أَيُّ اَلْأَيَّامِ هِيَ قَالَ» أَوَّلُ خَمِيسٍ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ وَ أَوَّلُ أَرْبِعَاءَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَشْرِ وَ آخِرُ خَمِيسٍ فِيهِ« فَقُلْتُ لِمَ صَارَتْ هَذِهِ اَلْأَيَّامُ اَلَّتِي تُصَامُ فَقَالَ »إِنَّ مَنْ قَبْلَنَا مِنَ اَلْأُمَمِ كَانَ إِذَ ا نَزَلَ عَلَى أَحَدِهِمُ اَلْعَذَابُ نَزَلَ فِي هَذِهِ اَلْأَيَّامِ اَلْمَخُوفَةِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mualla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washsha, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam (a.s) saying: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, fasted until it was said: 'he does not break the fast; (meaning that the blessed Prophet (saws) is always fasting) Then the Prophet (saws) broke the fast until it was said: ‘he does not fast’; (meaning that the blessed Prophet (saws) does not fast at all) Then the Prophet (saws) fasted the fast of Dawud (a.s), peace be upon him; one day and one day not; Then the Prophet (saws), peace be upon him, was taken (died) while upon fasting three days in the month.” And the Imam (a.s) said: “(fasting three days in a month) equal the fasting of the lifetime, and they remove the rancor (wahar) of the chest.” Hammad said: “So I asked: What is al-wahar?” Imam (a.s) said: “Al-wahar is whispering (al-waswasah).” Hammad said: “So I asked: ‘Which days are they?’” Imam (a.s) said: “The first Thursday in the month, and the first Wednesday after the tenth (of the month), and the last Thursday in it.” So I (narrator) replied: “Why did these become the days that are fasted?” Imam (a.s) said: “Indeed, those before us from the nations, when punishment descended upon one of them, it descended on these feared days.”

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Three Days in Every Month and What Has Come Concerning That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting in the month, how is it done?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Three in the month, one day in every ten. Indeed, Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, says: ‘Whoever comes with a good deed, then for him is ten like it’. (Surah Al-An'am 6:160) And thus three days in the month is (as if) fasting perpetually.’” – meaning fasting for the whole thirty days of the month.
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصِّيَامِ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ كَيْفَ هُوَ فَقَالَ» ثَلاَثٌ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ فِي كُلِّ عَشْرٍ يَوْمٌ إِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ يَقُولُ» مَنْ جٰاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثٰالِهٰا« وَ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ صَوْمُ اَلدَّهْرِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting in the month, how is it done?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Three in the month, one day in every ten. (Surah Al-An'am 6:160) And thus three days in the month is (as if) fasting perpetually.’” – meaning fasting for the whole thirty days of the month.

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Three Days in Every Month and What Has Come Concerning That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the fast of the Sunnah.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting three days from every month: (first) Thursday, Wednesday (after the tenth), and (last)Thursday; of the month. They remove the anxieties of the heart and the burning rancor of the chest (wahar al-sadr): Thursday, Wednesday, and Thursday. And if he wishes, (he can also fast) Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. And if he fasts one day in every ten days, then that is thirty good deeds. And if he loves to increase beyond that, then let him increase.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَوْمِ اَلسُّنَّةِ فَقَالَ» صِيَامُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ اَلْخَمِيسِ وَ اَلْأَرْبِعَاءِ وَ اَلْخَمِيسِ يَذْهَبْنَ بِبَلاَبِلِ اَلْقَلْبِ وَ وَحَرِ اَلصَّدْرِ اَلْخَمِيسِ وَ اَلْأَرْبِعَاءِ وَ اَلْخَمِيسِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ اَلْإِثْنَيْنَ وَاَلْأَرْبِعَاءَ وَاَلْخَمِيسَ وَإِنْ صَامَ فِي كُلِّ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ يَوْماً فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثُونَ حَسَنَةً وَإِنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَزِيدَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَلْيَزِدْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the fast of the Sunnah.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Fasting three days from every month: (first) Thursday, Wednesday (after the tenth), and (last)Thursday; of the month. They remove the anxieties of the heart and the burning rancor of the chest (wahar al-sadr): Thursday, Wednesday, and Thursday. And if he wishes, (he can also fast) Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. And if he fasts one day in every ten days, then that is thirty good deeds. And if he loves to increase beyond that, then let him increase.”

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Three Days in Every Month and What Has Come Concerning That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Imran, from Ziyad al-Qandi, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “If there are two Thursdays at the beginning of the month, then fast the first of them, for it is better. And if there are two Thursdays at its end, then fast the last of them, for it is better.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ عَنْ زِيَادٍ اَلْقَنْدِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» إِذَا كَانَ فِي أَوَّلِ اَلشَّهْرِ خَمِيسَانِ فَصُمْ أَوَّلَهُمَا فَإِنَّهُ أَفْضَلُ وَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي آخِرِهِ خَمِيسَانِ فَصُمْ آخِرَهُمَا فَإِنَّهُ أَفْضَلُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Imran, from Ziyad al-Qandi, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “If there are two Thursdays at the beginning of the month, then fast the first of them, for it is better. And if there are two Thursdays at its end, then fast the last of them, for it is better.”

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Three Days in Every Month and What Has Come Concerning That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And that which Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Imran al-Ashari, from Zurah, from Samaah, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘fasting three days in the month.’ Imam (a.s) said: “In every ten days, one day: (first) Thursday, Wednesday (after the tenth), and (last) Thursday; And the month that follows it: Wednesday, Thursday, and Wednesday.”
arabicText: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَوْمِ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ فَقَالَ» فِي كُلِّ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ يَوْمٌ خَمِيسٌ وَ أَرْبِعَاءُ وَ خَمِيسٌ وَ اَلشَّهْرِ اَلَّذِي يَلِيهِ أَرْبِعَاءُ وَ خَمِيسٌ وَ أَرْبِعَاءُ«.

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Three Days in Every Month and What Has Come Concerning That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn Jafar al-Madaini, from Ibrahim ibn Ismail ibn Dawud, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Three days in the month: Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.” So I (narrator) asked: “Our companions fast a Wednesday between two Thursdays.” – meaning the first and the last Thursday of the month. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem with that, And there is no problem with a Thursday between two Wednesdays.” – meaning the first and the last Wednesday of the month.
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصِّيَامِ فَقَالَ» ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ فِي اَلشَّهْرِ اَلْأَرْبِعَاءُ وَ اَلْخَمِيسُ وَ اَلْجُمُعَةُ« فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا يَصُومُونَ أَرْبِعَاءَ بَيْنَ خَمِيسَيْنِ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ وَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِخَمِيسٍ بَيْنَ أَرْبِعَاءَيْنِ«.

Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem with that, And there is no problem with a Thursday between two Wednesdays.” – meaning the first and the last Wednesday of the month.

chapter: Chapter on Fasting the Four Days in the Year
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from some of our companions, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Allah (swt) sent Muhammad, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, as a mercy to the worlds, on the twenty-seventh of Rajab. So whoever fasts that day, Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, writes for him the fasting of sixty months. And on the twenty-fifth of Dhu al-Qadah, Allah (swt) placed the House (Ka’aba), and it is the first mercy placed upon the face of the earth, so Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, made it a place of return for the people and a security. So whoever fasts that day, Allah (swt) writes for him the fasting of sixty months. And on the first day of Dhu al-Hijjah, Ibrahim (a.s), the intimate friend of the All-Merciful (swt) (Khalil al-Rahman), was born. So whoever fasts that day, Allah (swt) writes for him the fasting of sixty months.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَ صْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »بَعَثَ اَللَّهُ مُحَمَّد اً صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ »رَحْمَةً لِلْعٰالَمِينَ« فِ ي سَبْعَةٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ مِنْ رَجَبٍ فَمَنْ صَامَ ذَلِكَ اَ لْيَوْمَ كَتَبَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ صِيَامَ سِتِّينَ شَهْراً وَ فِي خَمْسَةٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ مِنْ ذِي اَلْقَعْدَةِ وَضَعَ اَللَّهُ اَلْبَيْتَ وَ هُوَ أَ وَّلُ رَحْمَةٍ وُضِعَتْ عَلَى وَجْهِ اَ لْأَرْضِ فَجَعَلَهُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ »مَثٰابَةً لِلنّٰاسِ وَ أَمْناً« فَمَنْ صَامَ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ كَتَبَ اَللَّهُ لَهُ صِيَامَ سِتِّينَ شَهْراً وَ فِي أَ وَّلِ يَوْمٍ مِنْ ذِي اَلْحِجَّةِ وُلِدَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ خَلِيلُ اَلرَّحْمَنِ فَمَنْ صَامَ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ كَتَبَ اَ للَّهُ لَهُ صِيَامَ سِتِّينَ شَهْراً«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from some of our companions, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Allah (swt) sent Muhammad, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, as a mercy to the worlds, on the twenty-seventh of Rajab. So whoever fasts that day, Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, writes for him the fasting of sixty months. And on the twenty-fifth of Dhu al-Qadah, Allah (swt) placed the House (Ka’aba), and it is the first mercy placed upon the face of the earth, so Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, made it a place of return for the people and a security. So whoever fasts that day, Allah (swt) writes for him the fasting of sixty months. chapter: Chapter on Fasting the Four Days in the Year
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Abu Abdullah ibn Ayyash said: Ahmad ibn Ziyad al-Hamadhani and Ali ibn Muhammad al-Tustari narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Layth al-Makki narrated to us, saying:
Abu Ishaq ibn Abdullah al-Alawi al-Uraydi narrated to me, saying: “And there was uncertainty in my chest regarding which days are to be fasted, so I went to our master Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him, while he was in Sarba, and I did not disclose that (question) to anyone from the creation of Allah (swt). So I entered upon Imam (a.s), and when he saw me, the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “O Abu Ishaq, you have come to ask me about ‘the days on which fasting is observed’. These days of fasting are divided in four; (1) The first of them is the day of twenty-seventh of Rajab, the day on which Allah (swt), Exalted, sent Muhammad, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, to His (swt) creation as a mercy to the worlds; (2) And the day of the birth of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and it is the seventeenth of the month of Rabi al-Awwal; (3) And the day of the twenty-fifth of Dhu al-Qadah, in which the Ka’aba was spread out; (4) And the day of al-Ghadeer, in which the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, established his brother Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, as a standard for the people and an Imam after him.” I (narrator) replied: “You have spoken the truth, may I be made your ransom. It is indeed for this reason that I came to you. I bear witness that you are indeed the Proof of Allah (swt) over His (swt) creation.”
arabicText: أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ اَلْهَمَذَانِيُّ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلتُّسْتَرِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَللَّيْثِ اَلْمَكِّيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْعَلَوِيُّ اَلْعُرَيْضِيُّ قَالَ: وَحَكَّ فِي صَدْرِي مَا اَلْأَيَّامُ اَلَّتِي تُصَامُ فَقَصَدْتُ مَوْلاَنَا أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلِيَّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ بِصَرْبَا وَ لَمْ أُبْدِ ذَلِكَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِ اَللَّهِ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا بَصُرَ بِي قَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» يَا أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ جِئْتَ تَسْأَلُنِي عَنِ اَلْأَيَّامِ اَلَّتِي يُصَامُ فِيهِنَّ وَ هِيَ أَرْبَعَةٌ أَوَّلُهُنَّ يَوْمُ اَلسَّابِعِ وَاَلْعِشْرِينَ مِنْ رَجَبٍ يَوْمٌ بَعَثَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إِلَى خَلْقِهِ» رَحْمَةً لِلْعٰالَمِينَ« وَيَوْمُ مَوْلِدِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَهُوَ اَلسَّابِعَ عَشَرَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَبِيعٍ اَلْأَوَّلِ وَ يَوْمُ اَلْخَامِسِ وَاَلْعِشْرِينَ مِنْ ذِي اَلْقَعْدَةِ فِيهِ دُحِيَتِ اَلْكَعْبَةُ وَ يَوْمُ اَلْغَدِيرِ فِيهِ أَقَامَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَخَاهُ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَماً لِلنَّاسِ وَ إِمَاماً مِنْ بَعْدِهِ« قُلْتُ صَدَقْتَ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ لِذَلِكَ قَصَدْتُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ حُجَّةُ اَللَّهِ عَلَى خَلْقِهِ.

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Rajab and the Days from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, who said: Kathir, the seller of date-stones, narrated to us, saying:
I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Nuh (a.s) heard the creaking of the ark upon al-Judi, so he feared for it. Nuh (a.s) brought his head out from the side of the ark, raised his hand, and pointed with his finger while saying: ‘Rahman itqan’, and the interpretation of the two of these words is: ‘O Lord (azj), make good.’ And indeed, when Nuh (a.s), peace be upon him, boarded the ark, he boarded it on the first day of Rajab, so he commanded those who were with him from the jinn and mankind to fast that day.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “And whoever among you fasts it (the first of Rajab), the Fire will be distanced from him by the travel of a year; And whoever fasts seven days of it (the month of Rajab), the seven gates of the Fires will be closed against him; And whoever fasts eight days of it (the month of Rajab), the eight gates of the Gardens will be opened for him; And whoever fasts days of it (the month of Rajab), he will be given his request; And whoever fasts twenty-five days of it (the month of Rajab), it will be said to him: “Begin the deeds anew, for you have been forgiven (of all bad deeds); And whoever increases (in the fasts of the month of Rajab), Allah (swt) will increase him.”
arabicText: عَ لِ يُّ بْ نُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرٌ بَيَّاعُ اَلنَّوَى قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» سَمِعَ نُوحٌ صَرِيرَ اَلسَّفِينَةِ عَلَى اَلْجُودِيِّ فَخَافَ عَلَيْهَا فَأَخْرَجَ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ اَلسَّفِينَةِ فَرَ فَعَ يَدَهُ وَ أَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ وَ هُوَ يَقُولُ رهمان اتقن وَ تَأْوِيلُهُمَا يَا رَ بِّ أَحْسِنْ وَ إِنَّ نُوحاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَ مُ لَمَّا رَكِبَ اَلسَّفِينَةَ رَكِبَهَا فِي أَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ مِنْ رَجَبٍ فَأَمَرَ مَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ اَلْجِنِّ وَ اَلْإِنْسِ أَنْ يَصُومُوا ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ« فَقَالَ» وَ مَنْ صَامَهُ مِنْكُمْ تَبَاعَدَتْ عَنْهُ اَلنَّارُ مَسِيرَةَ سَنَةٍ وَ مَنْ صَامَ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ مِنْهُ غُلِّقَتْ عَنْهُ أَبْوَابُ اَلنِّيرَانِ اَلسَّبْعَةُ وَ مَنْ صَامَ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ مِنْهُ فُتِحَتْ لَهُ أَ بْ وَ ا بُ اَ لْ جِ نَ ا نِ اَلثَّمَانِيَةُ وَ مَنْ صَامَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ مِنْهُ أُعْطِيَ مَسْأَلَتَهُ وَ مَنْ صَامَ خَمْسَةً وَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً مِنْهُ قِيلَ لَهُ اِسْتَأْنِفِ اَلْعَمَلَ فَقَدْ غُفِرَ لَكَ وَ مَنْ زَادَ زَادَهُ اَللَّهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, who said: Kathir, the seller of date-stones, narrated to us, saying:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Nuh (a.s) heard the creaking of the ark upon al-Judi, so he feared for it. Nuh (a.s) brought his head out from the side of the ark, raised his hand, and pointed with his finger while saying: ‘Rahman itqan’, and the interpretation of the two of these words is: ‘O Lord (azj), make good.’ And indeed, when Nuh (a.s), peace be upon him, boarded the ark, he boarded it on the first day of Rajab, so he commanded those who were with him from the jinn and mankind to fast that day.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “And whoever among you fasts it (the first of Rajab), the Fire will be distanced from him by the travel of a year; And whoever fasts seven days of it (the month of Rajab), the seven gates of the Fires will be closed against him; And whoever fasts eight days of it (the month of Rajab), the eight gates of the Gardens will be opened for him; And whoever fasts days of it (the month of Rajab), he will be given his request; And whoever fasts twenty-five days of it (the month of Rajab), it will be said to him: “Begin the deeds anew, for you have been forgiven (of all bad deeds); And whoever increases (in the fasts of the month of Rajab), Allah (swt) will increase him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 382

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Rajab and the Days from It
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And it has been narrated from Abu al-Hasan Musa (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Rajab is a river in Paradise, whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. Whoever fasts a day from the month of Rajab, Allah (swt) will give him to drink from that river.”
arabicText: وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:» رَجَبٌ نَهَرٌ فِي اَلْجَنَّةِ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضاً مِنَ اَللَّبَنِ وَ أَحْلَى مِنَ اَلْعَسَلِ مَنْ صَامَ يَوْماً مِنْ رَجَبٍ سَقَاهُ اَللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ اَلنَّهَرِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And it has been narrated from Abu al-Hasan Musa (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Rajab is a river in Paradise, whiter than milk and sweeter than honey. Whoever fasts a day from the month of Rajab, Allah (swt) will give him to drink from that river.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 382

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Shaban
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, all together from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Salamah, the companion of al-Sabiri, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Fasting Shaban and the month of Ramadan consecutively is repentance from Allah (swt).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ صَاحِبِ اَلسَّابِرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلصَّبَّاحِ اَلْكِنَانِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» صَوْمُ شَعْبَانَ وَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ تَوْبَةٌ مِنَ اَللَّهِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, all together from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Salamah, the companion of al-Sabiri, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “Fasting Shaban and the month of Ramadan consecutively is repentance from Allah (swt).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 382

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Shaban
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Husayn ibn Ulwan, from Amr ibn Khalid, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to fast Shaban and the month of Ramadan and join them together, and the Prophet (saws) would forbid the people from joining them together. And the Prophet (saws) used to say: ‘They are the two months of Allah (swt), and they are an expiation for what is before them and what is after them.’”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُلْوَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ يَصُومُ شَعْبَانَ وَ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَيَصِلُهُمَا وَ يَنْهَى اَلنَّاسَ أَنْ يَصِلُوهُمَا وَ كَانَ يَقُولُ» هُمَا شَهْرُ اَللَّهِ وَ هُمَا كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا قَبْلَهُمَا وَ مَا بَعْدَهُمَا««.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Husayn ibn Ulwan, from Amr ibn Khalid, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to fast Shaban and the month of Ramadan and join them together, and the Prophet (saws) would forbid the people from joining them together. And the Prophet (saws) used to say: ‘They are the two months of Allah (swt), and they are an expiation for what is before them and what is after them.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 383

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Shaban
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from some of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from his father, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What do you say regarding a man who fasts Shaban and the month of Ramadan?” Imam (a.s) said: “They are the two months about which Allah (swt), the Exalted, said: ‘Two consecutive months as repentance from Allah (swt).’” (Surah An-Nisa 4:92) He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘Then should he not separate between them?’” Imam (a.s) said: “When he breaks his fast during the night, then that is a separation. The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, only said, ‘There is no continuous fasting in fasting,’ meaning that a man should not fast two consecutive days without breaking the fast, and it is recommended for the servant not to leave the pre-dawn meal (al-suhur).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَصُومُ شَعْبَانَ وَ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» هُمَا اَلشَّهْرَانِ اَللَّذَانِ قَالَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى» شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتٰابِعَيْنِ تَوْبَةً مِنَ اللهَِ« « قَالَ قُلْتُ أَ فَلاَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمَا قَالَ »إِذَا أَفْطَرَ مِنَ اَللَّيْلِ فَهُوَ فَصْلٌ وَ إِنَّمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ» لاَ وِصَالَ فِي صِيَامٍ« يَعْنِي لاَ يَصُومُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَوْمَيْنِ مُتَوَالِيَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ إِفْطَارٍ وَ قَدْ يُسْتَحَبُّ لِلْعَبْدِ أَنْ لاَ يَدَعَ اَلسَّحُورَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from some of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from his father, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “What do you say regarding a man who fasts Shaban and the month of Ramadan?” Imam (a.s) said: “They are the two months about which Allah (swt), the Exalted, said: ‘Two consecutive months as repentance from Allah (swt).’” (Surah An-Nisa 4:92) He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘Then should he not separate between them?’” Imam (a.s) said: “When he breaks his fast during the night, then that is a separation. The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, only said, ‘There is no continuous fasting in fasting,’ meaning that a man should not fast two consecutive days without breaking the fast, and it is recommended for the servant not to leave the pre-dawn meal (al-suhur).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 383

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Shaban
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from al-Husayn ibn Mukhariq and Abu Junadah al-Saluli, from Abu Hamzah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him:
The Messenger of Allah (swt), blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, said: ‘Whoever fasts Shaban, it will be for him a purification from every slip (of sin), stain (wasmah), and rash utterance (badirah).’” Abu Hamzah said: “So I asked to Abu Ja’far (a.s), ‘What is the stain (wasmah)?’” Imam (a.s) said: “An oath in disobedience, and there is no vow in disobedience.” So I (narrator) asked: “What is the rash utterance (badirah)?” Imam (a.s) said: “An oath at the time of anger, and repentance from it is at the time of regret.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُخَارِقٍ وَأَبِي جُنَادَةَ اَلسَّلُولِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:» مَنْ صَامَ شَعْبَانَ كَانَ لَهُ طُهْرَةٌ مِنْ كُلِّ زَلَّةٍ وَوَصْمَةٍ وَبَادِرَةٍ« قَالَ أَبُو حَمْزَةَ فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَا اَلْوَصْمَةُ قَالَ» اَلْيَمِينُ فِي اَلْمَعْصِيَةِ وَ لاَ نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةٍ« فَقُلْتُ مَا اَلْبَادِرَةُ فَقَالَ» اَلْيَمِينُ عِنْدَ اَلْغَضَبِ وَ اَلتَّوْبَةُ مِنْهَا عِنْدَ اَلنَّدَمِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from al-Husayn ibn Mukhariq and Abu Junadah al-Saluli, from Abu Hamzah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: The Messenger of Allah (swt), blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, said: ‘Whoever fasts Shaban, it will be for him a purification from every slip (of sin), stain (wasmah), and rash utterance (badirah).’” Abu Hamzah said: “So I asked to Abu Ja’far (a.s), ‘What is the stain (wasmah)?’” Imam (a.s) said: “An oath in disobedience, and there is no vow in disobedience.” So I (narrator) asked: “What is the rash utterance (badirah)?” Imam (a.s) said: “An oath at the time of anger, and repentance from it is at the time of regret.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 383

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Shaban
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhassin ibn Ahmad, Muhammad ibn al-Walid, Amr ibn Uthman, and Sindi ibn Muhammad, all of them from Yunus ibn Yaqub, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fast of Shaban’, And I said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, did any of your fathers (a.s), peace be upon them, fast the month of Shaban?” Imam (a.s) said: “The best of my fathers (ancestors), the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, had most of his fasting in the month of Shaban.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَسِّنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ وَعَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ وَ سِنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ جَمِيعِهِمْ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَوْمِ شَعْبَانَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ كَانَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ آبَائِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَصُومُ شَعْبَانَ قَالَ» كَانَ خَيْرُ آبَائِي رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَكْثَرُ صِيَامِهِ فِي شَعْبَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Muhassin ibn Ahmad, Muhammad ibn al-Walid, Amr ibn Uthman, and Sindi ibn Muhammad, all of them from Yunus ibn Yaqub, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fast of Shaban’, And I said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, did any of your fathers (a.s), peace be upon them, fast the month of Shaban?” Imam (a.s) said: “The best of my fathers (ancestors), the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, had most of his fasting in the month of Shaban.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 384

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Shaban
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, “Did any of your fathers fast the month of Shaban?” Imam (a.s) said: “The best of my fathers (ancestors), the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, fasted it (Shaban).”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ صَامَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ آبَائِكَ شَعْبَانَ فَقَالَ» خَيْرُ آبَائِي رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ صَامَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, “Did any of your fathers fast the month of Shaban?” Imam (a.s) said: “The best of my fathers (ancestors), the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, fasted it (Shaban).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 384

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Shaban
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ashari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Did any of your forefathers ever fast the month of Shaban?” Imam (a.s) said: “The best of my forefathers fasted it, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”
arabicText: وعنه عن ابي علي الاشعري عن محمد بن عبد الجبار ومحمد بن إسماعيل عن الفضل بن شاذان عن صفوان عن ابن مسكان عن الحلبي قال: سألت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام هل صام أحد من آبائك شعبان قط؟ فقال: صامه خير آبائي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ashari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Did any of your forefathers ever fast the month of Shaban?” Imam (a.s) said: “The best of my forefathers fasted it, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 384

chapter: Chapter on Fasting Shaban
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The wives of the Prophet (saws), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, when fasting was due upon them, would delay that until the month of Shaban, out of dislike that they should prevent the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, from his need. So when it was the month of Shaban, they (the wives) would fast, and the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, would also (fast) and say, ‘Shaban is my month.’”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »كُنَّ نِسَاءُ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ إِذَا كَانَ عَلَيْهِنَّ صِيَامٌ أَخَّرْنَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى شَعْبَانَ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَمْنَعْنَ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ حَاجَتَهُ فَإِذَا كَانَ شَعْبَانُ صُمْنَ وَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ يَقُولُ» شَعْبَانُ شَهْرِي««.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The wives of the Prophet (saws), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, when fasting was due upon them, would delay that until the month of Shaban, out of dislike that they should prevent the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, from his need. So when it was the month of Shaban, they (the wives) would fast, and the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, would also (fast) and say, ‘Shaban is my month.’”

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (a.s), from his fathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
Imam Ali (a.s), said regarding ‘a man who vowed to fast for a period of time (zamanan).’ Imam (a.s) said: “The period of time (al-zaman) is five months, and the time (al-hin) is six months, because Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: ‘(always) yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord (azj).’” (Surah Ibrahim 14:25)
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:فِ ي رَ جُ لٍ نَ ذَ رَ أَ نْ يَ صُ و مَ زَ مَ ا ن اً قَ ا لَ »اَلزَّمَانُ خَ مْ سَ ةُ أَ شْ هُ رٍ وَ اَ لْ حِ ي نُ سِ تَّ ةُ أَ شْ هُ رٍ لِ أَ نَّ اَ ل لَّ هَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ» تُؤْتِي أُكُلَهٰا كُلَّ حِينٍ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهٰا««.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (a.s), from his fathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s), said regarding ‘a man who vowed to fast for a period of time (zamanan).’ Imam (a.s) said: “The period of time (al-zaman) is five months, and the time (al-hin) is six months, because Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: ‘(always) yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord (azj).’” (Surah Ibrahim 14:25)

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahbub, from Khalid ibn Jarir, from Abu al-Rabi al-Shami, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who said, ‘For Allah (swt) upon me is that I fast for a time (hinan),’ and that was in my uncertainty. So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, was approached regarding the like of that, so He (a.s) said: ‘Fast six months, for Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: ‘(always) yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord (azj).’ (Surah Ibrahim 14:25) meaning six months.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلرَّبِيعِ اَلشَّامِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ لِلَّهِ عَلَيَّ أَنْ أَصُومَ حِيناً وَ ذَلِكَ فِي شَكِّي فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ »قَدْ أُتِيَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ» صُمْ سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ» تُؤْتِي أُكُلَهٰا كُلَّ حِينٍ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهٰا«« يَعْنِي سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahbub, from Khalid ibn Jarir, from Abu al-Rabi al-Shami, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who said, ‘For Allah (swt) upon me is that I fast for a time (hinan),’ and that was in my uncertainty. So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, was approached regarding the like of that, so He (a.s) said: ‘Fast six months, for Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: ‘(always) yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord (azj).’ (Surah Ibrahim 14:25) meaning six months.”

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ubays ibn Hisham, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “A man was taken captive by the Romans, and he did not fast the month of Ramadan, and he did not know which month it was.” Imam (a.s) said: “He should fast a month, seeking to determine it, and count it thereby. If the month which he fasted was before (month of) Ramadan, it will not suffice him, and if it was after the month of Ramadan, it will suffice him.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عُبَيْسِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ أَسَرَتْهُ اَلرُّومُ وَ لَمْ يَصُمْ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَ لَمْ يَدْرِ أَيُّ شَهْرٍ هُوَ قَالَ» يَصُومُ شَهْراً يَتَوَخَّاهُ وَ يَحْتَسِبُ بِهِ فَإِنْ كَانَ اَلشَّهْرُ اَلَّذِي صَامَهُ قَبْلَ رَمَضَانَ لَمْ يُجْزِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَجْزَأَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Ubays ibn Hisham, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “A man was taken captive by the Romans, and he did not fast the month of Ramadan, and he did not know which month it was.” Imam (a.s) said: “He should fast a month, seeking to determine it, and count it thereby. If the month which he fasted was before (month of) Ramadan, it will not suffice him, and if it was after the month of Ramadan, it will suffice him.”

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Riab, from Samaah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the woman with irregular bleeding (mustahadah).’ Imam (a.s) said: “She fasts the month of Ramadan except for the days in which she used to menstruate, then she makes them up afterwards.”
arabicText: محمد بن يعقوب عن عدة من أصحابنا عن سهل بن زياد عن الحسن بن محبوب عن علي بن رئاب عن سماعة قال: سألت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن المستحاضة قال فقال: تصوم شهر رمضان إلا الايام التي كانت تحيض فيهن ثم تقضيها بعد
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Riab, from Samaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the woman with irregular bleeding (mustahadah).’ Imam (a.s) said: “She fasts the month of Ramadan except for the days in which she used to menstruate, then she makes them up afterwards.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 386

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
I (narrator) wrote to Imam (a.s): “A woman became pure from her menstruation or from the blood of her postnatal bleeding (nifas) on the first day of the month of Ramadan, then she had irregular bleeding (istihadah), so she prayed and fasted the whole month of Ramadan without doing what the woman with irregular bleeding (al-mustahadah) does of performing the ritual bath (ghusl) for every two prayers. Is her fasting and her prayer valid or not?” So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “She must make up her fasting, and she does not make up her prayer, because the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, used to command the blessed Sayyidah Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, and the believing women among his wives, with that.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ اِمْرَأَةٌ طَهُرَتْ مِنْ حَيْضِهَا أَوْ مِنْ دَمِ نِفَاسِهَا فِي أَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ اِسْتَحَاضَتْ فَصَلَّتْ وَ صَامَتْ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ كُلَّهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ مَا تَعْمَلُ اَلْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ مِنَ اَلْغُسْلِ لِكُلِّ صَلاَتَيْنِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ صَوْمُهَا وَصَلاَتُهَا أَمْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» تَقْضِي صَوْمَهَا وَ لاَ تَقْضِي صَلاَتَهَا لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ كَانَ يَأْمُرُ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا اَلسَّلاَمُ وَاَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ بِذَلِكَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) wrote to Imam (a.s): “A woman became pure from her menstruation or from the blood of her postnatal bleeding (nifas) on the first day of the month of Ramadan, then she had irregular bleeding (istihadah), so she prayed and fasted the whole month of Ramadan without doing what the woman with irregular bleeding (al-mustahadah) does of performing the ritual bath (ghusl) for every two prayers. Is her fasting and her prayer valid or not?” So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote: “She must make up her fasting, and she does not make up her prayer, because the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, used to command the blessed Sayyidah Fatimah (s.a), peace be upon her, and the believing women among his wives, with that.”

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘a man who became ritually impure (ajnaba) in the month of Ramadan, then forgot to perform the ritual bath (yaghtasil) until the month of Ramadan ended.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is to make up the prayer and the fasting.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَجْنَبَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَنَسِيَ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ حَتَّى خَرَجَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ اَلصِّيَامَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘a man who became ritually impure (ajnaba) in the month of Ramadan, then forgot to perform the ritual bath (yaghtasil) until the month of Ramadan ended.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is to make up the prayer and the fasting.”

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who entered the morning while fasting, then when the day had risen, or when it was evening, she menstruated. Should she break her fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and even if it is the time of sunset, let her break her fast.” He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who saw purity at the beginning of the day in the month of Ramadan, so she performs the ritual bath (taghtasil), and has not eaten. What should she do regarding that day?’” Imam (a.s) said: “She should break her fast on that day, for her breaking of the fast is only due to the blood.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ أَصْبَحَتْ صَائِمَةً فَلَمَّا اِرْتَفَعَ اَلنَّهَارُ أَوْ كَانَ اَلْعِشَاءُ حَاضَتْ أَ تُفْطِرُ قَالَ» نَعَمْ وَإِنْ كَانَ وَقْتُ اَلْمَغْرِبِ فَلْتُفْطِرْ« قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةٍ رَأَتِ اَلطُّهْرَ فِي أَوَّلِ اَلنَّهَارِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَتَغْتَسِلُ وَ لَمْ تَطْعَمْ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ فِي ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ قَالَ» تُفْطِرُ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ فَإِنَّمَا إِفْطَارُهَا مِنَ اَلدَّمِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who entered the morning while fasting, then when the day had risen, or when it was evening, she menstruated. Should she break her fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and even if it is the time of sunset, let her break her fast.” He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a woman who saw purity at the beginning of the day in the month of Ramadan, so she performs the ritual bath (taghtasil), and has not eaten. What should she do regarding that day?’” Imam (a.s) said: “She should break her fast on that day, for her breaking of the fast is only due to the blood.”

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in the fasting man tasting the pot (of cooking).”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يَذُوقَ اَلرَّجُلُ اَلصَّائِمُ اَلْقِدْرَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in the fasting man tasting the pot (of cooking).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 388

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
Ibn Abi Yafur asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, while I was listening, about ‘the fasting person pouring medicine into his ear.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and he may taste the broth and feed the chick (al-farkh).”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلَ اِبْنُ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ عَنِ اَلصَّائِمِ يَصُبُّ اَلدَّوَاءَ فِي أُذُنِهِ قَالَ» نَعَمْ وَ يَذُوقُ اَلْمَرَقَ وَيَزُقُّ اَلْفَرْخَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Ibn Abi Yafur asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, while I was listening, about ‘the fasting person pouring medicine into his ear.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and he may taste the broth and feed the chick (al-farkh).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 389

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi:
Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a fasting woman who cooks the pot and tastes the broth, looking into it.’ – meaning the odours enter her nose and throat. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.” And Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a woman who has a child while she is fasting, so she chews bread (food) for him to feed him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it, and likewise for the bird (to feed it), if it is hers.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ اَلصَّائِمَةِ تَطْبُخُ اَلْقِدْرَ فَتَذُوقُ اَلْمَرَقَ تَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ« وَ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ يَكُونُ لَهَا اَلصَّبِيُّ وَهِيَ صَائِمَةٌ فَتَمْضَغُ لَهُ اَلْخُبْزَ تُطْعِمُهُ فَقَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ وَاَلطَّيْرُ إِنْ كَانَ لَهَا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a fasting woman who cooks the pot and tastes the broth, looking into it.’ – meaning the odours enter her nose and throat.
