Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.” And Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a woman who has a child while she is fasting, so she chews bread (food) for him to feed him.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it, and likewise for the bird (to feed it), if it is hers.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 389

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ali ibn al-Numan, from Said al-Araj, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the fasting person tasting something and not swallowing it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ اَلْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّائِمِ يَذُوقُ اَلشَّيْءَ وَ لاَ يَبْلَعُهُ فَقَالَ» لاَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ali ibn al-Numan, from Said al-Araj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘the fasting person tasting something and not swallowing it.’ Imam (a.s) said: “No.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 389

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail ibn Marrar and Abd al-Jabbar ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man upon whom was the fasting of two consecutive months, but he was not able to fast, and he was not able to free a slave, and he was not able to give charity.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him fast eighteen days, three days for every ten needy persons.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ وَعَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ بْنِ اَلْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ صِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فَلَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلصِّيَامِ وَ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلْعِتْقِ وَ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلصَّدَقَةِ قَالَ» فَلْيَصُمْ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً عَنْ كُلِّ عَشَرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ismail ibn Marrar and Abd al-Jabbar ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man upon whom was the fasting of two consecutive months, but he was not able to fast, and he was not able to free a slave, and he was not able to give charity.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him fast eighteen days, three days for every ten needy persons.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 389

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who made binding upon himself the fasting of one month in Kufa, one month in Madinah, and one month in Mecca, because of a trial with which he was afflicted. It was decreed that he fasted one month in Kufa, and entered Madinah, so he fasted there eighteen days, but the camel-driver (al-jammal) did not stay for him (to finish his fasting).’ Imam (a.s) said: He fasts what remains upon him when he reaches his town.
arabicText: محمد بن يعقوب عن عدة من أصحابنا عن أحمد بن محمد عن الحسين بن سعيد عن القاسم بن محمد عن علي بن ابي حمزة عن ابي إبراهيم عليه السلام قال: سألته عن رجل جعل على نفسه صوم شهر بالكوفة وشهر بالمدينة وشهر بمكة من بلاء ابتلي به فقضي انه صام بالكوفة شهرا ودخل المدينة فصام بها ثمانية عشر يوما ولم يقم الجمال عليه قال: يصوم ما بقي عليه إذا انتهى إلى بلده
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who made binding upon himself the fasting of one month in Kufa, one month in Madinah, and one month in Mecca, because of a trial with which he was afflicted. It was decreed that he fasted one month in Kufa, and entered Madinah, so he fasted there eighteen days, but the camel-driver (al-jammal) did not stay for him (to finish his fasting).’ Imam (a.s) said: He fasts what remains upon him when he reaches his town.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 390

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Umar, from Muhammad ibn Mansur, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who made a vow concerning fasting, then became incapable.’ Imam (a.s) said: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: ‘Upon him, in place of every day, is one mudd (of food in charity).’”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَذَرَ نَذْراً فِي صِيَامٍ فَعَجَزَ فَقَالَ» كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ» عَلَيْهِ مَكَانَ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مُدٌّ««.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Umar, from Muhammad ibn Mansur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who made a vow concerning fasting, then became incapable.’ Imam (a.s) said: “My father (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: ‘Upon him, in place of every day, is one mudd (of food in charity).’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 390

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ashari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who did not fast the three days while fasting was becoming severe upon him. Is there a ransom (fida) in it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “A mudd of food (in charity) for each day.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ اَلْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَمَّنْ لَمْ يَصُمِ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ اَلْأَيَّامِ وَ هُوَ يَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهِ اَلصِّيَامُ هَلْ فِيهِ فِدَاءٌ قَالَ» مُدٌّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ashari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘one who did not fast the three days while fasting was becoming severe upon him. Is there a ransom (fida) in it?’ Imam (a.s) said: “A mudd of food (in charity) for each day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 390

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi, from Salih ibn Uqbah, from Uqbah, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be made your ransom, I have become old and weak from fasting, so what should I do regarding these three days in every month?” Imam (a.s) said: “O Uqbah, give a dirham in charity for each day.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘One dirham?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Perhaps they have become many with you, and you consider the dirham little.” He (narrator) said: “I said, ‘Yes, indeed the blessings of Allah (swt) upon me are abundant.’” Imam (a.s) said: “O Uqbah, feeding a Muslim is better than fasting for a month.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنِّي قَدْ كَبِرْتُ وَضَعُفْتُ عَنِ اَلصِّيَامِ فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ بِهَذِهِ اَلثَّلاَثَةِ اَلْأَيَّامِ فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ فَقَالَ» يَا عُقْبَةُ تَصَدَّقْ بِدِرْهَمٍ عَنْ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ« قَالَ قُلْتُ دِرْهَمٌ وَاحِدٌ فَقَالَ» لَعَلَّهَا كَثُرَتْ عِنْدَكَ وَ أَنْتَ تَسْتَقِلُّ اَلدِّرْهَمَ« قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ إِنَّ نِعَمَ اَللَّهِ عَلَيَّ لَسَابِغَةٌ فَقَالَ» يَا عُقْبَةُ لَإِطْعَامُ مُسْلِمٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ صِيَامِ شَهْرٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi, from Salih ibn Uqbah, from Uqbah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be made your ransom, I have become old and weak from fasting, so what should I do regarding these three days in every month?” Imam (a.s) said: “O Uqbah, give a dirham in charity for each day.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘One dirham?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Perhaps they have become many with you, and you consider the dirham little.” He (narrator) said: “I said, ‘Yes, indeed the blessings of Allah (swt) upon me are abundant.’” Imam (a.s) said: “O Uqbah, feeding a Muslim is better than fasting for a month.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 391

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Hasan ibn Rashid, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, or to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man deliberately chooses the month during the short days and fasts it for the year.” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَوْ لِأَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَتَعَمَّدُ اَلشَّهْرَ فِي اَلْأَيَّامِ اَلْقِصَارِ يَصُومُهُ لِلسَّنَةِ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Hasan ibn Rashid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, or to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man deliberately chooses the month during the short days and fasts it for the year.” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 391

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from several of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibrahim ibn Mihzam, from al-Husayn ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Hamzah, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “The fast of three days in every month, may I delay them until winter and then fast them?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مِهْزَمٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ صَوْمُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي كُلِّ شَهْرِ أُؤَخِّرُهَا إِلَى اَلشِّتَاءِ ثُمَّ أَصُومُهَا قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from several of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibrahim ibn Mihzam, from al-Husayn ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Hamzah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “The fast of three days in every month, may I delay them until winter and then fast them?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 391

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Idris and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man upon whom there are some of the three days of the month. Is it proper for him to delay them and fast them at the end of the month?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.” I (narrator) asked: “Should he fast them consecutively, or separate between them?” Imam (a.s) said: “Whatever he likes; if he wishes, consecutively, and if he wishes, he separates between them.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَلثَّلاَثَةِ اَلْأَيَّامِ اَلشَّهْرِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يُؤَخِّرَهَا وَ يَصُومَهَا فِي آخِرِ اَلشَّهْرِ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ« قُلْتُ يَصُومُهَا مُتَوَالِيَةً أَوْ يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَهَا قَالَ» مَا أَحَبَّ إِنْ شَاءَ مُتَوَالِيَةً وَ إِنْ شَاءَ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَهَا«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Idris and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Said, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man upon whom there are some of the three days of the month. Is it proper for him to delay them and fast them at the end of the month?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.” I (narrator) asked: “Should he fast them consecutively, or separate between them?” Imam (a.s) said: “Whatever he likes; if he wishes, consecutively, and if he wishes, he separates between them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 392

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from his brother al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the pre-dawn meal (suhur) for one who intends to fast.’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for the month of Ramadan, the merit is in the pre-dawn meal, so let him do it, even with a drink of water. As for voluntary fasting, whoever likes to take the pre-dawn meal, let him do it, and whoever does not do it, there is no harm.”
arabicText: الحسين بن سعيد عن أخيه الحسن عن زرعة عن سماعة قال: سألته عن السحور لمن اراد الصوم فقال: اما في شهر رمضان فان الفضل في السحور فليفعل ولو بشربة من ماء، واما في التطوع فمن أحب ان يتسحر فليفعل ومن لم يفعل فلا بأس
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from his brother al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the pre-dawn meal (suhur) for one who intends to fast.’ Imam (a.s) said: “As for the month of Ramadan, the merit is in the pre-dawn meal, so let him do it, even with a drink of water. As for voluntary fasting, whoever likes to take the pre-dawn meal, let him do it, and whoever does not do it, there is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 392

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, who said:
I (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘a group among us who pray but do not fast the month of Ramadan, and I need them to harvest for me. So when I call them to the harvest, they do not respond until I feed them, while they find someone who will feed them, so they go to him and leave me, and I feel constrained about feeding them in the month of Ramadan.’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote to me in his handwriting: “I know it. Feed them.”
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ عِنْدَنَا يُصَلُّونَ وَلاَ يَصُومُونَ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَأَنَا أَحْتَاجُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَحْصُدُونَ لِي فَإِذَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ إِلَى اَلْحَصَادِ لَمْ يُجِيبُوا حَتَّى أُطْعِمَهُمْ وَ هُمْ يَجِدُونَ مَنْ يُطْعِمُهُمْ فَيَذْهَبُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَيَدَعُونِي وَ أَنَا أَضِيقُ مِنْ إِطْعَامِهِمْ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِلَيَّ بِخَطِّهِ» أَعْرِفُهُ أَطْعِمْهُمْ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about ‘a group among us who pray but do not fast the month of Ramadan, and I need them to harvest for me. So when I call them to the harvest, they do not respond until I feed them, while they find someone who will feed them, so they go to him and leave me, and I feel constrained about feeding them in the month of Ramadan.’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote to me in his handwriting: “I know it. Feed them.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 392

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked him about ‘a man who performed tamattu, but did not find what he could offer as a sacrifice, so he fasted three days. Then, when he had completed his rites, it occurred to him to stay for a year.’ He said: “Let him consider the journey route of the people of his town; then, when he thinks they would have entered their town, he should fast the seven days.”
arabicText: وَرَوَى اِبْنُ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَمَتَّعَ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ مَا يُهْدِي فَصَامَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَلَمَّا قَضَى نُسُكَهُ بَدَا لَهُ أَنْ يُقِيمَ سَنَةً قَالَ» فَلْيَنْظُرْ مَنْهَلَ أَهْلِ بَلَدِهِ فَإِذَا ظَنَّ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ دَخَلُوا بَلَدَهُمْ فَلْيَصُمِ اَلسَّبْعَةَ اَلْأَيَّامِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked him about ‘a man who performed tamattu, but did not find what he could offer as a sacrifice, so he fasted three days. Then, when he had completed his rites, it occurred to him to stay for a year.’ He said: “Let him consider the journey route of the people of his town; then, when he thinks they would have entered their town, he should fast the seven days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 393

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And in the narration of Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “That if he has a stay in Makkah and wants to fast the seven, he should leave fasting for the length of his journey to his family, or one month, then fast.”
arabicText: وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» أَنَّهُ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مُقَامٌ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَصُومَ اَلسَّبْعَةَ تَرَكَ اَلصِّيَامَ بِقَدْرِ سَيْرِهِ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ أَوْ شَهْراً ثُمَّ صَامَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And in the narration of Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “That if he has a stay in Makkah and wants to fast the seven, he should leave fasting for the length of his journey to his family, or one month, then fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 393

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “A man has upon him the make-up fast (qada) from the month of Ramadan, and he enters the morning and does not eat until the afternoon. Is it permissible for him to make it a make-up fast (qada) from the month of Ramadan?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
arabicText: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى عن يعقوب بن يزيد عن أحمد ابن محمد بن ابي نصر عمن ذكره عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: قلت له الرجل يكون عليه القضاء من شهر رمضان ويصبح فلا يأكل إلى العصر أيجوز له ان يجعله قضاءا من شهر رمضان؟ قال: نعم
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “A man has upon him the make-up fast (qada) from the month of Ramadan, and he enters the morning and does not eat until the afternoon. Is it permissible for him to make it a make-up fast (qada) from the month of Ramadan?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 393

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alawi, from al-Amraki al-Khurasani, from Ali ibn Jafar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fast of three days during the Hajj and the seven (days to be fasted). Should he fast them consecutively or separate between them?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts the three days, not separating between them, and the seven days, not separating between them, and he does not combine the seven days and the three days all together.”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ اَلْخُرَاسَانِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَوْمِ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي اَلْحَجِّ وَاَلسَّبْعَةِ أَ يَصُومُهَا مُتَوَالِيَةً أَوْ يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَهَا قَالَ» يَصُومُ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ لاَ يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَهَا وَ اَلسَّبْعَةَ لاَ يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَهَا وَ لاَ يَجْمَعُ اَلسَّبْعَةَ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَةَ جَمِيعاً«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alawi, from al-Amraki al-Khurasani, from Ali ibn Jafar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fast of three days during the Hajj and the seven (days to be fasted). Should he fast them consecutively or separate between them?’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts the three days, not separating between them, and the seven days, not separating between them, and he does not combine the seven days and the three days all together.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 394

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Damrah Anas ibn Iyad al-Laythi, from Sa’ad ibn Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, who said:
I (narrator) heard a man from Banu al-Harith ibn Kab say: “I heard Abu Hurayrah saying: It is not I who forbid fasting on Friday, but I heard the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, say: ‘Do not fast on Friday unless you fast before it or after it.’
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي ضَمْرَةَ أَنَسِ بْنِ عِيَاضٍ اَللَّيْثِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَجُلاً مِنْ بَنِي اَلْحَارِثِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ: لَيْسَ أَنَا أَنْهَى عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ لَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ قَالَ» لاَ تَصُومُوا يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَصُومُوا قَبْلَهُ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Damrah Anas ibn Iyad al-Laythi, from Sa’ad ibn Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard a man from Banu al-Harith ibn Kab say: “I heard Abu Hurayrah saying: It is not I who forbid fasting on Friday, but I heard the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, say: ‘Do not fast on Friday unless you fast before it or after it.’

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 394

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Musa ibn Jafar, from al-Washsha, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) saw Imam (a.s) fasting on Friday, so I said to him: “May I be made your ransom, indeed the people claim that it (Friday) is a day of Eid.” Imam (a.s) said: “No, indeed it is a day of ease and rest.”
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُهُ صَائِماً يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُ يَوْمُ عِيدٍ فَقَالَ» كَلاَّ إِنَّهُ يَوْمُ خَفْضٍ وَدَعَةٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Musa ibn Jafar, from al-Washsha, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) saw Imam (a.s) fasting on Friday, so I said to him: “May I be made your ransom, indeed the people claim that it (Friday) is a day of Eid.” Imam (a.s) said: “No, indeed it is a day of ease and rest.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 394

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “The wives of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, when they had fasting upon them, would delay that until the month of Shaban, out of dislike that they should prevent the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, from His (saws) need. So when it was Shaban, they would fast, and He (saws) would fast with them.” Imam (a.s) said: “And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to say: ‘Shaban is my month.’”
arabicText: محمد بن يعقوب عن يعقوب بن يزيد عن ابن ابي عمير عن حفص بن البختري عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: ان نساء النبي صلى الله عليه وآله إذا كان عليهن صيام أخرن ذلك إلى شعبان كراهية أن يمنعن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله حاجته فإذا كان شعبان صمن وصام معهن قال: وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله يقول: شعبان شهري
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “The wives of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, when they had fasting upon them, would delay that until the month of Shaban, out of dislike that they should prevent the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, from His (saws) need. So when it was Shaban, they would fast, and He (saws) would fast with them.” Imam (a.s) said: “And the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to say: ‘Shaban is my month.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 394

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Harun ibn al-Hasan ibn Jabalah, from Samaah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, the month of Ramadan enters upon me, so I fast part of it, then the intention to visit the grave of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, comes to me. Should I visit him (Imam al-Husayn (a.s)) and break my fast while going and returning, or should I remain until I break the fast, and visit him after I have broken the fast by a day or two?” Imam (a.s) said: “Remain until you break the fast.” I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, is that better?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes. Do you not read in the Book of Allah (swt): ‘So whoever among you witnesses the month (of Ramadan), let him fast it’?” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:185)
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيَّ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ فَأَصُومُ بَعْضَهُ فَتَحْضُرُنِي نِيَّةُ زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَأَزُورُهُ وَأُفْطِرُ ذَاهِباً وَ جَائِياً أَوْ أُقِيمُ حَتَّى أُفْطِرَ وَ أَزُورُهُ بَعْدَ مَا أُفْطِرُ بِيَوْمٍ أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَقَالَ» أَقِمْ حَتَّى تُفْطِرَ« قُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ فَهُوَ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ» نَعَمْ أَ مَا تَقْرَأُ فِي كِتَابِ اَللَّهِ» فَمَنْ شَهِدَ مِنْكُمُ اَلشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ««.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Harun ibn al-Hasan ibn Jabalah, from Samaah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, the month of Ramadan enters upon me, so I fast part of it, then the intention to visit the grave of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, comes to me. Should I visit him (Imam al-Husayn (a.s)) and break my fast while going and returning, or should I remain until I break the fast, and visit him after I have broken the fast by a day or two?” Imam (a.s) said: “Remain until you break the fast.” I (narrator) said to Imam (a.s): “May I be made your ransom, is that better?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes. Do you not read in the Book of Allah (swt): ‘So whoever among you witnesses the month (of Ramadan), let him fast it’?” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:185)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 395

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Shuayb ibn Yaqub, from Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (a.s), from his father (a.s):
Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘I do not permit, regarding divorce and regarding the crescent moon, except two men (as witnesses).’”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: »لاَ أُجِيزُ فِي اَلطَّلاَقِ وَ لاَ فِي اَلْهِلاَلِ إِلاَّ رَجُلَيْنِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Shuayb ibn Yaqub, from Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (a.s), from his father (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘I do not permit, regarding divorce and regarding the crescent moon, except two men (as witnesses).’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 395

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ibrahim, from Ismail ibn Marar, from Yunus, from Habib, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “Testimony for the sighting of the crescent is not permissible with fewer than fifty men, the number of the collective oath (qasamah). The testimony of two men is only permissible if they are from outside the city (misr), and there is an obstruction (illah) in the city, so they inform that they saw the moon and inform about a people who fasted due to the sighting.”
arabicText: محمد بن على بن محبوب عن إبراهيم عن إسماعيل بن مرار عن يونس عن حبيب عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: لا تجوز الشهادة لرؤية الهلال دون خمسين رجلا عدد القسامة، وانما يجوز شهادة رجلين إذا كانا من خارج المصر وكان بالمصر علة فاخبرا أنهما رأياه واخبرا عن قوم صاموا للرؤية
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ibrahim, from Ismail ibn Marar, from Yunus, from Habib, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Testimony for the sighting of the crescent is not permissible with fewer than fifty men, the number of the collective oath (qasamah). The testimony of two men is only permissible if they are from outside the city (misr), and there is an obstruction (illah) in the city, so they inform that they saw the moon and inform about a people who fasted due to the sighting.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 395

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Jafar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who sees the crescent moon in the month of Ramadan by himself, and no one else sees it. May he fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he does not doubt it, then let him fast; otherwise, let him fast with the people.”
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَرَى اَلْهِلاَلَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَحْدَهُ لاَ يُبْصِرُهُ غَيْرُهُ لَهُ أَنْ يَصُومَ قَالَ» إِذَا لَمْ يَشُكَّ فِيهِ فَلْيَصُمْ وَ إِلاَّ فَلْيَصُمْ مَعَ اَلنَّاسِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Jafar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who sees the crescent moon in the month of Ramadan by himself, and no one else sees it. May he fast?’ Imam (a.s) said: “If he does not doubt it, then let him fast; otherwise, let him fast with the people.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 396

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad, from al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq al-Nahdi, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Khallad ibn Umarah, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “I entered upon Abu al-Abbas on a day of doubt, while I knew that it was from the month of Ramadan, and he was eating lunch. So he (Abu al-Abbas) said: ‘O Abu Abdullah, is this not from your days?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Why, O Commander of the Faithful? My fasting is only with your fasting, and my breaking of the fast is only with your breaking of the fast.” Imam (a.s) said: “So he (Abu al-Abbas) said, ‘Come near.’” Imam (a.s) said: “So I came near and ate, while I knew that it was from the month of Ramadan.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدٌ عَنِ اَلْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ أَبِي مَسْرُوقٍ اَلنَّهْدِيِّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ خَلاَّدِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:» دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي اَلْعَبَّاسِ فِي يَوْمِ شَكٍّ وَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ هُوَ يَتَغَذَّى فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ لَيْسَ هَذَا مِنْ أَيَّامِكَ قُلْتُ لِمَ يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا صَوْمِي إِلاَّ بِصَوْمِكَ وَ لاَ إِفْطَارِي إِلاَّ بِإِفْطَارِكَ قَالَ فَقَالَ اُدْنُ قَالَ فَدَنَوْتُ فَأَكَلْتُ وَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad, from al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq al-Nahdi, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Khallad ibn Umarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “I entered upon Abu al-Abbas on a day of doubt, while I knew that it was from the month of Ramadan, and he was eating lunch. So he (Abu al-Abbas) said: ‘O Abu Abdullah, is this not from your days?’ Imam (a.s) said: “Why, O Commander of the Faithful? My fasting is only with your fasting, and my breaking of the fast is only with your breaking of the fast.” Imam (a.s) said: “So he (Abu al-Abbas) said, ‘Come near.’” Imam (a.s) said: “So I came near and ate, while I knew that it was from the month of Ramadan.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 396

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Abu al-Jarud, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “We doubted one year, in one of those years, regarding al-Adha. Then when I entered upon Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, while some of our companions were offering the sacrifice, Imam (a.s) said: ‘Al-Fitr is the day when the people break the fast, and al-Adha is the day when the people offer the sacrifice, and fasting is the day when the people fast.’”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْجَارُودِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّا شَكَكْنَا سَنَةً فِي عَامٍ مِنْ تِلْكَ اَلْأَعْوَامِ فِي اَلْأَضْحَى فَلَمَّا دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ كَانَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا يُضَحِّي فَقَالَ »اَلْفِطْرُ يَوْمُ يُفْطِرُ اَلنَّاسُ وَ اَلْأَضْحَى يَوْمُ يُضَحِّي اَلنَّاسُ وَ اَلصَّوْمُ يَوْمُ يَصُومُ اَلنَّاسُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Abu al-Jarud, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “We doubted one year, in one of those years, regarding al-Adha. Then when I entered upon Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, while some of our companions were offering the sacrifice, Imam (a.s) said: ‘Al-Fitr is the day when the people break the fast, and al-Adha is the day when the people offer the sacrifice, and fasting is the day when the people fast.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 396

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah ibn Mihran, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘two men who stood and looked toward the dawn, and one of them said, ‘It is this,’ and the other said, ‘I do not see anything.’’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then let the one to whom the dawn has not become clear eat, while eating has become forbidden for the one who claimed that he has seen the dawn. Indeed Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: ‘Eat and drink until the white thread becomes clear to you from the black thread of the dawn, then complete the fast until the night.’” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:187)
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلَيْنِ قَامَا فَنَظَرَا إِلَى اَلْفَجْرِ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا هُوَ ذَا وَ قَالَ اَلْآخَرُ مَا أَرَى شَيْئاً قَالَ» فَلْيَأْكُلِ اَلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَبَيَّنْ لَهُ اَلْفَجْرُ وَ قَدْ حَرُمَ اَلْأَكْلُ عَلَى اَلَّذِي زَعَمَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ رَأَى اَلْفَجْرَ إِنَّ اَللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ» كُلُوا وَاِشْرَبُوا حَتّٰى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ اَلْخَيْطُ اَلْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ اَلْخَيْطِ اَلْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ اَلْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا اَلصِّيٰامَ إِلَى اَللَّيْلِ««.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah ibn Mihran, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘two men who stood and looked toward the dawn, and one of them said, ‘It is this,’ and the other said, ‘I do not see anything.’’ Imam (a.s) said: “Then let the one to whom the dawn has not become clear eat, while eating has become forbidden for the one who claimed that he has seen the dawn. Indeed Allah (swt), the Exalted, says: ‘Eat and drink until the white thread becomes clear to you from the black thread of the dawn, then complete the fast until the night.’” (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:187)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 397

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), about ‘the time of breaking the fast of the fasting person.’ Imam (a.s) said: “When three stars appear.” And Imam (a.s) said regarding ‘a man who thought that the sun had set, so he broke his fast, then he saw the sun after that.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no making up (qada) upon him.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ وَقْتِ إِفْطَارِ اَلصَّائِمِ قَالَ» حِينَ يَبْدُو ثَلاَثَةُ أَنْجُمٍ« وَ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ ظَنَّ أَنَّ اَلشَّمْسَ قَدْ غَابَتْ فَأَفْطَرَ ثُمَّ أَبْصَرَ اَلشَّمْسَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), about ‘the time of breaking the fast of the fasting person.’ Imam (a.s) said: “When three stars appear.” And Imam (a.s) said regarding ‘a man who thought that the sun had set, so he broke his fast, then he saw the sun after that.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no making up (qada) upon him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 397

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad, from al-Barqi, from Jafar ibn al-Muthanna, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I eat during the night in the month of Ramadan until I doubt?” Imam (a.s) said: “Eat until you do not doubt.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ اَلْمُثَنَّى عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ آكُلُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ بِاللَّيْلِ حَتَّى أَشُكَّ قَالَ» كُلْ حَتَّى لاَ تَشُكَّ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad, from al-Barqi, from Jafar ibn al-Muthanna, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I eat during the night in the month of Ramadan until I doubt?” Imam (a.s) said: “Eat until you do not doubt.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 397

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, who said: Al-Khalil ibn Hashim wrote to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘a man who heard the footsteps (al-wat) and the call in the month of Ramadan, so he thought that the call was for the pre-dawn meal (al-suhur), and he had intercourse and went out, and behold, the morning had become bright.’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in his handwriting: “He makes up (qada) that day, if Allah (swt) wills.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: كَتَبَ اَلْخَلِيلُ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ سَمِعَ اَلْوَطْءَ وَ اَلنِّدَاءَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَظَنَّ أَنَّ اَلنِّدَاءَ لِلسَّحُورِ فَجَامَعَ وَخَرَجَ فَإِذَا اَلصُّبْحُ قَدْ أَسْفَرَ فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِخَطِّهِ» يَقْضِي ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمَ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, who said: Al-Khalil ibn Hashim wrote to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘a man who heard the footsteps (al-wat) and the call in the month of Ramadan, so he thought that the call was for the pre-dawn meal (al-suhur), and he had intercourse and went out, and behold, the morning had become bright.’ So the Imam (a.s), peace be upon him, wrote in his handwriting: “He makes up (qada) that day, if Allah (swt) wills.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 398

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “It does not harm the fasting person whatever he does, if he avoids four qualities: (eating) food and drink, (intimacy with) women, and immersion in water (al-irtimas).”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:» مَا يَضُرُّ اَلصَّائِمَ مَا صَنَعَ إِذَا اِجْتَنَبَ أَرْبَعَ خِصَالٍ اَلطَّعَامَ وَ اَلشَّرَابَ وَ اَلنِّسَاءَ وَاَلاِرْتِمَاسَ فِي اَلْمَاءِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, saying: “It does not harm the fasting person whatever he does, if he avoids four qualities: (eating) food and drink, (intimacy with) women, and immersion in water (al-irtimas).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 398

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad and others, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: “Poetry is not to be recited at night, and it is not to be recited in the month of Ramadan, by night or by day.” So Ismail ibn Ja’far said to Imam (a.s): “O my father (a.s), even if it is concerning us?” Imam (a.s) said: “Even if it is concerning us.”
arabicText: عنه عن ابن ابي عمير عن حماد وغيره عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال قال: لا ينشد الشعر بالليل ولا ينشد في شهر رمضان بليل ولا نهار فقال له إسماعيل: يا ابتاه فانه فينا!؟ قال: وان كان فينا
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad and others, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “Poetry is not to be recited at night, and it is not to be recited in the month of Ramadan, by night or by day.” So Ismail ibn Ja’far said to Imam (a.s): “O my father (a.s), even if it is concerning us?” Imam (a.s) said: “Even if it is concerning us.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 398

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Abi Badr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘a man who is fasting, and it is said to him, ‘Are you fasting?’ So he says, ‘No.’ Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “This is a lie.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ أَبِي بَدْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: اَلرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ صَائِماً فَيُقَالُ لَهُ أَ صَائِمٌ أَنْتَ فَيَقُولُ لاَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» هَذَا كَذِبٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Abi Badr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) about ‘a man who is fasting, and it is said to him, ‘Are you fasting?’ So he says, ‘No.’ Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “This is a lie.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 398

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Zurah, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May the fasting person kiss (his wife)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and he may give her his tongue for her to suck.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلصَّائِمُ يُقَبِّلُ قَالَ» نَعَمْ وَ يُعْطِيهَا لِسَانَهُ تَمَصُّهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Zurah, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May the fasting person kiss (his wife)?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, and he may give her his tongue for her to suck.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 399

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from some of the Kufans, raising it to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who (intimately) comes to a woman in her anus while she is fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It does not invalidate her fast, and there is no ritual bath (ghusl) upon her.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ بَعْضِ اَلْكُوفِيِّينَ يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي اَلْمَرْأَةَ فِي دُبُرِهَا وَهِيَ صَائِمَةٌ قَالَ» لاَ يَنْقُضُ صَوْمَهَا وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا غُسْلٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from some of the Kufans, raising it to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who (intimately) comes to a woman in her anus while she is fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “It does not invalidate her fast, and there is no ritual bath (ghusl) upon her.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 399

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Wallad al-Hannat, who said:
I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I kiss my young daughter while I am fasting, and some of her saliva accidentally gets into my mouth/throat. Does that affect my fast?” He (narrator) said: “Imam (a.s) said to me: ‘There is no harm; there is nothing upon you.’”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدٍ اَلْحَنَّاطِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي أُقَبِّلُ بِنْتاً لِي صَغِيرَةً وَ أَنَا صَائِمٌ فَيَدْخُلُ فِي جَوْفِي مِنْ رِيقِهَا شَيْءٌ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي» لاَ بَأْسَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ شَيْءٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Wallad al-Hannat, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I kiss my young daughter while I am fasting, and some of her saliva accidentally gets into my mouth/throat. Does that affect my fast?” He (narrator) said: “Imam (a.s) said to me: ‘There is no harm; there is nothing upon you.’”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 399

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) said) about ‘a man who comes to the woman in the anus (dubr) while she is fasting, that it does not invalidate her fast, and no ritual bathing (ghusl) is upon her.’
arabicText: أحمد بن محمد عن علي بن الحكم عن رجل عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال: إذا اتى الرجل المرأة في الدبر وهي صائمة لم ينقض صومها وليس عليها غسل.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) said) about ‘a man who comes to the woman in the anus (dubr) while she is fasting, that it does not invalidate her fast, and no ritual bathing (ghusl) is upon her.’

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 400

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alawi, from al-Amraki al-Bufaki, from Ali ibn Jafar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fasting man, Is it permissible for him to suck the tongue of the woman, or for the woman to do that?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ اَلْبُوفَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ اَلصَّائِمِ أَ لَهُ أَنْ يَمَصَّ لِسَانَ اَلْمَرْأَةِ أَوْ تَفْعَلَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alawi, from al-Amraki al-Bufaki, from Ali ibn Jafar, from his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fasting man, Is it permissible for him to suck the tongue of the woman, or for the woman to do that?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 400

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Rifa'ah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who touched a slave-girl (jariyah) in the month of Ramadan and emitted pre-seminal fluid (madhy).’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it was unlawful, then let him seek forgiveness from Allah (swt) with the seeking of forgiveness of one who will never return, and let him fast a day in place of a day. And if it was lawful, he should seek forgiveness from Allah (swt) and not return, and fast a day in place of a day.”
arabicText: أحمد بن محمد عن ابن ابي عمير عن محمد بن ابى حمزة عن رفاعة قال: سألت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن رجل لامس جارية في شهر رمضان فامذى قال: ان كان حراما فليستغفر الله استغفار من لا يعود ابدا ويصوم يوما مكان يوم وان كان حلالا يستغفر الله ولا يعود ويصوم يوما مكان يوم.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Rifa'ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who touched a slave-girl (jariyah) in the month of Ramadan and emitted pre-seminal fluid (madhy).’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it was unlawful, then let him seek forgiveness from Allah (swt) with the seeking of forgiveness of one who will never return, and let him fast a day in place of a day. And if it was lawful, he should seek forgiveness from Allah (swt) and not return, and fast a day in place of a day.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 400

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who attached himself (was intimate) to his wife and ejaculated.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is the feeding of sixty needy persons, one mudd for each needy person.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ لَزِقَ بِأَهْلِهِ فَأَنْزَلَ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ إِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً مُدٌّ لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who attached himself (was intimate) to his wife and ejaculated.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is the feeding of sixty needy persons, one mudd for each needy person.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 401

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who placed his hand on something from the body of his wife and emitted semen.’ Imam (a.s) said: “His expiation is that he fast two consecutive months, or feed sixty needy persons, or free a slave.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ جَسَدِ اِمْرَأَتِهِ فَأَدْفَقَ فَقَالَ» كَفَّارَتُهُ أَنْ يَصُومَ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ أَوْ يُطْعِمَ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً أَوْ يُعْتِقَ رَقَبَةً«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from al-Qasim, from Ali, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who placed his hand on something from the body of his wife and emitted semen.’ Imam (a.s) said: “His expiation is that he fast two consecutive months, or feed sixty needy persons, or free a slave.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 401

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Saffar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from one of his retainers (mawali), who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the wet dream of the fasting person’. Imam (a.s) said: “If he has a wet dream in the month of Ramadan during the daytime, then it is not for him to sleep until he performs ritual bathing (ghusl). And whoever becomes ritually impure (junub) at night in the month of Ramadan must not sleep for even an hour until he performs ritual bathing (ghusl). So whoever becomes ritually impure in the month of Ramadan and sleeps until morning, then upon him is the freeing of a slave, or feeding sixty poor persons, and making up that day, and he must complete it, and he will never attain it (the rewards) ever.”
arabicText: الصفار عن إبراهيم بن هاشم عن عبد الرحمن بن حماد عن إبراهيم بن عبد الحميد عن بعض مواليه قال: سألته عن احتلام الصائم فقال: احتلم في شهر رمضان نهارا فليس له ان ينام حتى يغتسل، ومن اجنب ليلا في شهر رمضان فلا ينام إلى ساعة حتى يغتسل، فمن اجنب في شهر رمضان فنام حتى يصبح فعليه عتق رقبة أو اطعام ستين مسكينا وقضاء ذلك اليوم ويتمه ولن يدركه ابدا
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Saffar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from one of his retainers (mawali), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the wet dream of the fasting person’. Imam (a.s) said: “If he has a wet dream in the month of Ramadan during the daytime, then it is not for him to sleep until he performs ritual bathing (ghusl). And whoever becomes ritually impure (junub) at night in the month of Ramadan must not sleep for even an hour until he performs ritual bathing (ghusl). So whoever becomes ritually impure in the month of Ramadan and sleeps until morning, then upon him is the freeing of a slave, or feeding sixty poor persons, and making up that day, and he must complete it, and he will never attain it (the rewards) ever.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 401

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn Suqah, from one who mentioned him, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who plays (lustfully) with his wife or his slave-girl while he is making up the month of Ramadan, and the fluid overcomes him, so he ejaculates.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him, of expiation, is the like of what is upon the one who has intercourse in (month of) Ramadan.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُلاَعِبُ أَهْلَهُ أَوْ جَارِيَتَهُ وَ هُوَ فِي قَضَاءِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَيَسْبِقُهُ اَلْمَاءُ فَيُنْزِلُ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَلْكَفَّارَةِ مِثْلُ مَا عَلَى اَلَّذِي يُجَامِعُ فِي رَمَضَانَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn Suqah, from one who mentioned him, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who plays (lustfully) with his wife or his slave-girl while he is making up the month of Ramadan, and the fluid overcomes him, so he ejaculates.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him, of expiation, is the like of what is upon the one who has intercourse in (month of) Ramadan.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 401

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas, from Ibn al-Mughirah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who deliberately broke the fast in the month of Ramadan without an excuse.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He frees a person, or fasts two consecutive months, or feeds sixty needy persons. Then, if he is not able to do that, he gives in charity whatever he is able.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنِ اِبْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ أَفْطَرَ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّداً مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ قَالَ» يُعْتِقُ نَسَمَةً أَوْ يَصُومُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ أَوْ يُطْعِمُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ تَصَدَّقَ بِمَا يُطِيقُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-Abbas, from Ibn al-Mughirah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who deliberately broke the fast in the month of Ramadan without an excuse.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He frees a person, or fasts two consecutive months, or feeds sixty needy persons. Then, if he is not able to do that, he gives in charity whatever he is able.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 402

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who deliberately broke the fast of a day from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him are fifteen sa’ (of charity), for each needy person one mudd, like that which the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, did.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ ع عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَفْطَرَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّداً قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ صَاعاً لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ مُدٌّ مِثْلُ اَلَّذِي صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ ص«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who deliberately broke the fast of a day from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him are fifteen sa’ (of charity), for each needy person one mudd, like that which the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family, did.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 402

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Abdus, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who made a vow to Allah (swt) upon himself to fast a year, but he was not able.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts a month and part of the other month.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in cutting off the fast.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُبْدُوسٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ جَعَلَ لِلَّهِ عَلَيْهِ نَذْراً صِيَامَ سَنَةٍ فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ قَالَ» يَصُومُ شَهْراً وَ بَعْضَ اَلشَّهْرِ اَلْآخَرِ« ثُمَّ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يَقْطَعَ اَلصَّوْمَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Abdus, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding ‘a man who made a vow to Allah (swt) upon himself to fast a year, but he was not able.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts a month and part of the other month.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in cutting off the fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 402

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Adam ibn Ishaq, from a man, from Muhammad ibn al-Numan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who broke the fast of a day from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “His expiation is two jaribs (jariban) of food, and that is twenty sa’.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ آدَمَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَفْطَرَ يَوْماً مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» كَفَّارَتُهُ جَرِيبَانِ مِنْ طَعَامٍ وَ هُوَ عِشْرُونَ صَاعاً«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Adam ibn Ishaq, from a man, from Muhammad ibn al-Numan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man who broke the fast of a day from the month of Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “His expiation is two jaribs (jariban) of food, and that is twenty sa’.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 402

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Abdus, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abu Jamilah, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘a man who made a vow (nadhr) to Allah (swt) and did not name anything (conditions).’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts six days.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُبْدُوسٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ :فِي رَجُلٍ جَعَلَ لِلَّهِ نَذْراً وَ لَمْ يُسَمِّ شَيْئاً قَالَ» يَصُومُ سِتَّةَ أَيَّامٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Abdus, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abu Jamilah, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘a man who made a vow (nadhr) to Allah (swt) and did not name anything (conditions).’ Imam (a.s) said: “He fasts six days.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 403

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Abu Abdillah al-Razi, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Ismail al-Qasir, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man upon whom the sun rose while he was in a state of major ritual impurity (junub), then he wanted to fast after he had performed ghusl, and whatever had passed of the day had passed.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He may fast if he wishes, and he has the choice (to break fast) until midday.”
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلرَّازِيِّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلْقَصِيرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ ثُمَّ أَرَادَ اَلصِّيَامَ بَعْدَ مَا اِغْتَسَلَ وَ مَضَى مَا مَضَى مِنَ اَلنَّهَارِ قَالَ» يَصُومُ إِنْ شَاءَ وَ هُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِلَى نِصْفِ اَلنَّهَارِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Abu Abdillah al-Razi, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Ismail al-Qasir, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about ‘a man upon whom the sun rose while he was in a state of major ritual impurity (junub), then he wanted to fast after he had performed ghusl, and whatever had passed of the day had passed.’ Imam (a.s) said: “He may fast if he wishes, and he has the choice (to break fast) until midday.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 403

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who became in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) in (month of) Ramadan, then forgot to perform ghusl until (month of) Ramadan ended.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is the making up of the prayer and the fast.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَجْنَبَ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَنَسِيَ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ حَتَّى خَرَجَ رَمَضَانُ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ اَلصِّيَامِ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who became in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) in (month of) Ramadan, then forgot to perform ghusl until (month of) Ramadan ended.’ Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is the making up of the prayer and the fast.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 403

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘vomiting in (month of) Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it is something that overtakes him unexpectedly, then there is no harm, but if it is something that he forces himself to do, he has broken the fast, and upon him is the making up.” He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who played with water, rinsing his mouth with it because of thirst, and it entered his throat.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is its making up, but if it was during wudu, then there is no harm.”
arabicText: مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْقَيْءِ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ شَيْءٌ يَبْدُرُهُ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ شَيْئاً يُكْرِهُ نَفْسَهُ عَلَيْهِ أَفْطَرَ وَ عَلَيْهِ اَلْقَضَاءُ« قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَبِثَ بِالْمَاءِ يَتَمَضْمَضُ بِهِ مِنْ عَطَشٍ فَدَخَلَ حَلْقَهُ قَالَ» عَلَيْهِ قَضَاؤُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي وُضُوءٍ فَلاَ بَأْسَ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Samaah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘vomiting in (month of) Ramadan.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If it is something that overtakes him unexpectedly, then there is no harm, but if it is something that he forces himself to do, he has broken the fast, and upon him is the making up.” He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about ‘a man who played with water, rinsing his mouth with it because of thirst, and it entered his throat.’” Imam (a.s) said: “Upon him is its making up, but if it was during wudu, then there is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 403

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fasting person, May he clean his teeth with water?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, but he should not clean his teeth with the moist tooth-stick (siwak).”
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّائِمِ أَ يَسْتَاكُ بِالْمَاءِ قَالَ» لاَ بَأْسَ وَ لاَ يَسْتَاكُ بِالسِّوَاكِ اَلرَّطْبِ
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Imam (a.s) about ‘the fasting person, May he clean his teeth with water?’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm, but he should not clean his teeth with the moist tooth-stick (siwak).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 404

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May the fasting person clean his teeth (yastak) with water and a moist stick, while finding its taste?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”
arabicText: محمد عن محمد بن الحسين بن ابي الخطاب عن صفوان عن ابن مسكان عن الحلبي قال: سألت ابا عبد الله عليه السلام أيستاك الصائم بالماء والعود الرطب يجد طعمه؟ فقال: لا بأس
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May the fasting person clean his teeth (yastak) with water and a moist stick, while finding its taste?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 404

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Harun ibn Muslim, from Masadah ibn Sadaqah, from Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘a fly entering the throat of a fasting person.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no making up upon him; indeed, it is not food.”
arabicText: هَارُونُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلذُّبَابِ يَدْخُلُ فِي حَلْقِ اَلصَّائِمِ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِطَعَامٍ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Harun ibn Muslim, from Masadah ibn Sadaqah, from Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about ‘a fly entering the throat of a fasting person.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is no making up upon him; indeed, it is not food.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 404

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan, from Sa’ad ibn Abi Khalaf, who said: Ghiyath narrated to me, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in the fasting person swallowing his phlegm (nukhamah).”
arabicText: أَيُّوبُ بْنُ نُوحٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي غِيَاثٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:» لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يَزْدَرِدَ اَلصَّائِمُ نُخَامَتَهُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan, from Sa’ad ibn Abi Khalaf, who said: Ghiyath narrated to me, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in the fasting person swallowing his phlegm (nukhamah).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 404

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Saeed al-Madaini, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who rinses his mouth, and water enters his throat while he is fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him if he did not deliberately intend that.” I (narrator) asked: “So if he rinsed his mouth a second time, and water entered his throat?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him.” I (narrator) asked: “He rinsed his mouth a third time.” Imam (a.s) said: “He has acted badly (exceeded the allowed amount), but there is nothing upon him (about breaking his fast), and no making up (qada).”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَتَمَضْمَضُ فَيَدْخُلُ فِي حَلْقِهِ اَلْمَاءُ وَ هُوَ صَائِمٌ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ إِذَا لَمْ يَتَعَمَّدْ ذَلِكَ« قُلْتُ فَإِنْ تَمَضْمَضَ اَلثَّانِيَةَ فَدَخَلَ فِي حَلْقِهِ اَلْمَاءُ قَالَ» لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ« قُلْتُ تَمَضْمَضَ اَلثَّالِثَةَ قَالَ فَقَالَ» قَدْ أَسَاءَ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ لاَ قَضَاءٌ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Saeed al-Madaini, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about ‘a man who rinses his mouth, and water enters his throat while he is fasting.’ Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him if he did not deliberately intend that.” I (narrator) asked: “So if he rinsed his mouth a second time, and water entered his throat?” Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing upon him.” I (narrator) asked: “He rinsed his mouth a third time.” Imam (a.s) said: “He has acted badly (exceeded the allowed amount), but there is nothing upon him (about breaking his fast), and no making up (qada).”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 404

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: And Abu Jamilah narrated from Zayd al-Shahham concerning ‘a fasting man who rinsed his mouth (tamadmada).’ He said: ‘He must not swallow his saliva until he spits three times.’
arabicText: وروى أبو جميلة عن زيد الشحام في رجل صائم تمضمض قال: لا يبلع ريقه حتى يبزق ثلاث مرات
thaqalaynMatn: And Abu Jamilah narrated from Zayd al-Shahham concerning ‘a fasting man who rinsed his mouth (tamadmada).’ He said: ‘He must not swallow his saliva until he spits three times.’

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 405

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: And it has been narrated (in further addition to hadith 997): ‘(He must not swallow his saliva until he spits) One time.’
arabicText: وقد روي مرة واحدة
thaqalaynMatn: And it has been narrated (in further addition to hadith 997): ‘(He must not swallow his saliva until he spits) One time.’

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 4, p. 405

chapter: Chapter on Additions
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning ‘the fasting person who performs wudu (ablution) for prayer, and water enters his throat.’ Imam (a.s) said: “If his wudu (ablution) was for an obligatory prayer, then there is no making up upon him, but if his wudu was for a supererogatory prayer, then upon him is the making up.”
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلصَّائِمِ يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاَةِ فَيَدْخُلُ اَلْمَاءُ فِي حَلْقِهِ قَالَ» إِنْ كَانَ وُضُوؤُهُ لِصَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ وَ إِنْ كَانَ وُضُوؤُهُ لِصَلاَةٍ نَافِلَةٍ فَعَلَيْهِ اَلْقَضَاءُ«.
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
